1.name: Heaeleeng Seegnet
1.description: Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 82...172 Heaelt. Yuoo haefe-a -40 aermur vheele-a useeng thees skeell.
1.concise: Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 82...172 Heaelt. Yuoo haefe-a -40 aermur vheele-a useeng thees skeell.

2.name: Resoorrecshun Seegnet
2.description: Seegnet. Resoorrect taerget paerty member. Thaet paerty member is retoorned tu leeffe-a veet 100% Heaelt und 25% Inergy. Thees seegnet oonly rechaerges vhee yuoo gaeeen a muraele-a buust.
2.concise: Seegnet. Resoorrects taerget paerty member (100% Heaelt, 25% Inergy). Thees seegnet oonly rechaerges vhee yuoo gaeeen a muraele-a buust.

3.name: Seegnet ooff Caeptoore-a
3.description: Seegnet. Chuuse-a oone-a skeell frum a neaerby deaed Buss ooff yuoor pruffesseeun. Seegnet ooff Caeptoore-a is permunently replaeced by thaet skeell. Iff thaet skeell vaes ileete-a, gaeeen 250 XP fur ifery lefel yuoo haefe-a iaerned. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3.concise: Seegnet. Chuuse-a oone-a skeell frum a neaerby deaed Buss ooff yuoor pruffesseeun. Seegnet ooff Caeptoore-a is permunently replaeced by thaet skeell. Iff thaet skeell vaes ileete-a, gaeeen 250 XP fur ifery lefel yuoo haefe-a iaerned. Bork! Bork! Bork!

5.name: Pooer Bluck
5.description: Ileete-a Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell oor chunt, thaet skeell und aell skeells ooff zee saeme-a aettreeboote-a aere-a deesaebled fur 1...12 secunds und thaet skeell is interroopted.
5.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell oor chunt, thaet skeell und aell skeells ooff zee saeme-a aettreeboote-a aere-a deesaebled (1...12 secunds) und thaet skeell is interroopted.

6.name: Muntra ooff Iaert
6.description: Stunce-a. Fur 30...90 secunds, vhenefer yuoo taeke-a iaert daemaege-a, zee daemaege-a is redooced by 26...50% und yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy.
6.concise: Stunce-a. (30...90 secunds.) Redooces iaert daemaege-a yuoo taeke-a by 26...50%. Yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy vhee yuoo taeke-a iaert daemaege-a.

7.name: Muntra ooff Flaeme-a
7.description: Stunce-a. Fur 30...90 secunds, vhenefer yuoo taeke-a fure-a daemaege-a, zee daemaege-a is redooced by 26...50% und yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy.
7.concise: Stunce-a. (30...90 secunds.) Redooces fure-a daemaege-a yuoo taeke-a by 26...50%. Yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy vhee yuoo taeke-a fure-a daemaege-a.

8.name: Muntra ooff Frust
8.description: Stunce-a. Fur 30...90 secunds, vhenefer yuoo taeke-a culd daemaege-a, zee daemaege-a is redooced by 26...50% und yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy.
8.concise: Stunce-a. (30...90 secunds.) Redooces culd daemaege-a yuoo taeke-a by 26...50%. Yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy vhee yuoo taeke-a culd daemaege-a.

9.name: Muntra ooff Leeghtneeng
9.description: Stunce-a. Fur 30...90 secunds, vhenefer yuoo taeke-a leeghtneeng daemaege-a, zee daemaege-a is redooced by 26...50% und yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy.
9.concise: Stunce-a. (30...90 secunds.) Redooces leeghtneeng daemaege-a yuoo taeke-a by 26...50%. Yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy vhee yuoo taeke-a leeghtneeng daemaege-a.

10.name: Hex Breaeker
10.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...80 secunds, zee next teeme-a yuoo aere-a zee taerget ooff a hex, thaet hex faeeels und zee caester taekes 10...46 daemaege-a.
10.concise: Stunce-a. (5...80 secunds.) Zee next hex aegaeeenst yuoo faeeels und zee caester taekes 10...46 daemaege-a.

11.name: Deesturshun
11.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...5 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks. Vhenefer yuoo bluck un aettaeck thees vaey, yuoo luse-a 2 Inergy oor Deesturshun inds.
11.concise: Stunce-a. (1...5 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Bluck cust: yuoo luse-a 2 Inergy oor Deesturshun inds.

13.name: Muntra ooff Recufery
13.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 5...20 secunds, spells yuoo caest rechaerge-a 33% faester.
13.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoor spells rechaerge-a 33% faester.

14.name: Muntra ooff Perseestence-a
14.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...25 secunds, uny Illooseeun Maegeec hex yuoo caest laests 10...40% lunger.
14.concise: Stunce-a. (5...25 secunds.) Illooseeun hexes yuoo caest laest 10...40% lunger.

15.name: Muntra ooff Inscreepshuns
15.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...25 secunds, seegnets yuoo sooccessffoolly aecteefaete-a vheele-a in thees stunce-a rechaerge-a 10...40% faester.
15.concise: Stunce-a. (5...25 secunds.) Seegnets yuoo sooccessffoolly aecteefaete-a vheele-a in thees stunce-a rechaerge-a 10...40% faester.

16.name: Muntra ooff Cuncentraeshun
16.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...38 secunds, zee next teeme-a yuoo vuoold be-a interroopted, yuoo aere-a nut interroopted.
16.concise: Stunce-a. (1...38 secunds.) Zee next teeme-a yuoo vuoold be-a interroopted, yuoo aere-a nut interroopted.

17.name: Muntra ooff Resulfe-a
17.description: Stunce-a. Fur 30...90 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a interroopted, boot iaech teeme-a yuoo vuoold haefe-a beee interroopted, yuoo luse-a 10...4 Inergy oor Muntra ooff Resulfe-a inds.
17.concise: Stunce-a. (30...90 secunds.) Prefents interroopts aegaeeenst yuoo. Prefenshun cust: luse-a 10...4 Inergy oor Muntra ooff Resulfe-a inds.

18.name: Muntra ooff Seegnets
18.description: Stunce-a. Fur 10...40 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +3 aermur fur iaech seegnet yuoo haefe-a iqooeepped. Vhenefer yuoo use-a a seegnet, yuoo gaeeen 5...60 Heaelt.
18.concise: Stunce-a. (10...40 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +3 aermur fur iaech seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 5...60 Heaelt iaech teeme-a yuoo use-a a seegnet.

19.name: Fraegeeleety
19.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8...20 secunds, taerget und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 5...20 daemaege-a iaech teeme-a zeey sooffffer oor recufer frum a noo cundeeshun.
19.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (8...20 secunds). Zeese-a fues taeke-a 5...20 daemaege-a iaech teeme-a zeey gaeeen oor luse-a a cundeeshun.

21.name: Inspured Inchuntment
21.description: Spell. Remufe-a un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a und gaeeen 3...15 Inergy. Fur 20 secunds, Inspured Inchuntment is replaeced veet zee inchuntment remufed frum taerget fue-a.
21.concise: Spell. Remufes un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffects: yuoo gaeeen 3...15 Inergy; thees spell is replaeced veet thaet inchuntment (20 secunds).

22.name: Inspured Hex
22.description: Spell. Remufe-a a hex frum taerget aelly und gaeeen 4...10 Inergy. Fur 20 secunds, Inspured Hex is replaeced veet zee hex thaet vaes remufed.
22.concise: Spell. Remufes a hex frum taerget aelly. Remufael iffffects: yuoo gaeeen 4...10 Inergy; thees spell is replaeced veet thaet hex (20 secunds).

23.name: Pooer Speeke-a
23.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell oor a chunt, thaet skeell is interroopted und taerget fue-a taekes 30...120 daemaege-a.
23.concise: Spell. Interroopts a spell oor chunt. Interroopshun iffffect: deaels 30...120 daemaege-a.

24.name: Pooer Leaek
24.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell oor chunt, thaet skeell is interroopted und taerget fue-a luses 3...17 Inergy.
24.concise: Spell. Interroopts a spell oor chunt. Interroopshun iffffect: cooses 3...17 Inergy luss. Bork! Bork! Bork!

25.name: Pooer Draeeen
25.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell oor chunt, thaet skeell is interroopted und yuoo gaeeen 1...31 Inergy.
25.concise: Spell. Interroopts a spell oor chunt. Interroopshun iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 1...31 Inergy.

26.name: Impaethy
26.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a aettaecks, thaet fue-a taekes 10...55 daemaege-a und deaels 1...15 less daemaege-a.
26.concise: Hex Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Taerget fue-a's aettaecks deael 1...15 less daemaege-a, und thaet fue-a taekes 10...55 daemaege-a veet iaech aettaeck. Bork! Bork! Bork!

27.name: Shaetter Delooseeuns
27.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a Mesmer hex frum taerget fue-a. Iff a hex is remufed, thaet fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
27.concise: Spell. Remufes a Mesmer hex frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffect: 15...75 daemaege-a tu taerget und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu aell aedjaecent fues. Bork! Bork! Bork!

28.name: Baeckffure-a
28.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a caests a spell, thaet fue-a taekes 35...140 daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
28.concise: Hex Spell. (10 secunds.) Taerget fue-a taekes 35...140 daemaege-a vhenefer it caests a spell.

29.name: Blaeckuoot
29.description: Skeell. Fur 2...8 secunds, aell ooff tuooched taerget fue-a's skeells aere-a deesaebled, und aell ooff yuoor skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 5 secunds.
29.concise: Tuooch Skeell. (2...8 secunds.) Deesaebles skeells. Yuoor skeells aere-a deesaebled (5 secunds).

30.name: Deeferseeun
30.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a uses a skeell, thaet skeell taekes un aeddeeshunael 10...56 secunds tu rechaerge-a.
30.concise: Hex Spell. (6 secunds.) Taerget fue-a's next skeell taekes +10...56 secunds tu rechaerge-a.

31.name: Cunjoore-a Phuntaesm
31.description: Hex Spell. Fur 4...18 secunds, taerget fue-a ixpereeences -5 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
31.concise: Hex Spell. (4...18 secunds.) Cooses -5 Heaelt degeneraeshun.

32.name: Illooseeun ooff Veaekness
32.description: Inchuntment Spell. Yuoo luse-a 50...240 Heaelt. Illooseeun ooff Veaekness inds iff daemaege-a drups yuoor Heaelt beloo 25% ooff yuoor maexeemoom. Vhee Illooseeun ooff Veaekness inds, yuoo gaeeen 50...240 Heaelt.
32.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Luse-a 50...240 Heaelt. Ind iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 50...240 Heaelt. Inds iff daemaege-a drups yuoor Heaelt beloo 25% ooff yuoor maexeemoom.

33.name: Illooseeunaery Veaepunry
33.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, yuoor melee-a aettaecks neeezeer heet nur faeeel tu heet. Insteaed, Illooseeunaery Veaepunry deaels 20...60 daemaege-a tu yuoor taergets fur iaech melee-a aettaeck. Yuoo haefe-a +5 aermur fur iaech iqooeepped Illooseeun Maegeec skeell. Bork! Bork! Bork!
33.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Deaels 20...60 daemaege-a tu fues in plaece-a ooff oozeer daemaege-a oor iffffects frum melee-a aettaecks. Yuoo haefe-a +5 aermur fur iaech iqooeepped Illooseeun Maegeec skeell. Yuoor melee-a aettaecks neeezeer heet nur faeeel tu heet.

34.name: Sympaezeeteec Feesaege-a
34.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, vhenefer taerget aelly is heet by a melee-a aettaeck, aell aedjaecent fues luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a und 3 Inergy.
34.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (4...10 secunds.) Aell aedjaecent fues luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a und 3 Inergy vhenefer a melee-a aettaeck heets taerget aelly.

35.name: Ignurunce-a
35.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8...20 secunds taerget fue-a cunnut use-a seegnets.
35.concise: Hex Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Taerget fue-a cunnut use-a seegnets.

36.name: Aercune-a Cunoondroom
36.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, spells caest by taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a tveece-a aes lung tu caest. Vhee thees hex inds, yuoo gaeeen 1...7 inergy.
36.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (5...15 secunds). Duoobles spell caesteeng teeme-a. Ind iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 1...7 inergy.

37.name: Illooseeun ooff Haeste-a
37.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...11 secunds yuoo aere-a nu lunger Creeppled, und yuoo mufe-a 33% faester. Vhee Illooseeun ooff Haeste-a inds, yuoo becume-a Creeppled fur 3 secunds.
37.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester. Ineeteeael iffffect: remufes Creeppled cundeeshun. Ind iffffect: yuoo aere-a Creeppled (3 secunds).

38.name: Chunneleeng
38.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8...56 secunds, vhenefer yuoo caest a spell, yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy fur iaech fue-a in zee aerea.
38.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8...56 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy fur iaech fue-a in zee aerea vhenefer yuoo caest a spell.

39.name: Inergy Soorge-a
39.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a luses 1...10 Inergy. Fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust, thaet fue-a taekes 7 daemaege-a und aell neaerby fues taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a.
39.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Cooses 1...10 Inergy luss. Deaels 7 daemaege-a tu taerget fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu neaerby fues.

40.name: Izeer Feaest
40.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a luses 3 Inergy. Yuoo aere-a heaeled 20...65 fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust.
40.concise: Spell. Cooses 3 Inergy luss. Yuoo gaeeen 20...65 Heaelt fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust.

41.name: Izeer Lurd
41.description: Hex Spell. Yuoo luse-a aell Inergy. Fur 5...10 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1...3 Inergy degeneraeshun, und yuoo ixpereeence-a +1...3 Inergy regeneraeshun.
41.concise: Hex Spell. Yuoo luse-a aell Inergy. Taerget fue-a haes -1...3 Inergy degeneraeshun und yuoo haefe-a +1...3 Inergy regeneraeshun (5...10 secunds).

42.name: Inergy Boorn
42.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a luses 1...10 Inergy und taekes 9 daemaege-a fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust.
42.concise: Spell. Cooses 1...10 Inergy luss. Deaels 9 daemaege-a fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust.

43.name: Cloomseeness
43.description: Hex Spell. Fur 4 secunds, taerget und aedjaecent fues aere-a hexed veet Cloomseeness. Zee next teeme-a iaech fue-a aettaecks, zee aettaeck is interroopted und thaet fue-a sooffffers 10...80 daemaege-a.
43.concise: Hex Spell. (4 secunds.) Aelsu hexes aedjaecent fues. Interroopts next aettaeck. Interroopshun iffffect: deaels 10...80 daemaege-a.

44.name: Phuntum Paeeen
44.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Vhee Phuntum Paeeen inds, thaet fue-a sooffffers a Deep Vuoond, looereeng thaet fue-a's maexeemoom Heaelt by 20% fur 5...20 secunds.
44.concise: Hex Spell. (10 secunds.) Cooses -1...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Ind iffffect: inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

45.name: Izeereael Boordee
45.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6...12 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 50% slooer. Vhee Izeereael Boordee inds, yuoo gaeeen 10...18 Inergy.
45.concise: Hex Spell. (6...12 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 50% slooer. Ind iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 10...18 Inergy.

46.name: Gooeelt
46.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a caests a spell thaet taergets a fue-a, zee spell faeeels und yuoo steael up tu 5...14 Inergy frum thaet fue-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
46.concise: Hex Spell. (6 secunds.) Taerget fue-a's next spell faeeels und yuoo steael 5...14 Inergy. Nu iffffect unless thees fue-a's spell taergets oone-a ooff yuoor aelleees.

47.name: Inepteetoode-a
47.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 4 secunds, zee next teeme-a zee taerget fue-a oor uny aedjaecent fue-a aettaecks, zeey taeke-a 30...135 daemaege-a und aere-a Bleended fur 10 secunds.
47.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (4 secunds.) Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget. Deaels 30...135 daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (10 secunds). Nu iffffect unless hexed fue-a aettaecks.

48.name: Spureet ooff Faeeeloore-a
48.description: Hex Spell. Fur 30 secunds, taerget fue-a haes a 25% chunce-a tu meess veet aettaecks. Yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy vhenefer thaet fue-a faeeels tu heet in cumbaet.
48.concise: Hex Spell. (30 secunds.) Taerget fue-a haes 25% chunce-a tu meess. Yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy vhenefer thees fue-a meesses.

49.name: Meend Vraeck
49.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...40 secunds, vhenefer thees fue-a is zee taerget ooff uny ooff yuoor nun-hex Mesmer skeells, thaet fue-a luses 1 Inergy und taekes 5...25 daemaege-a per pueent ooff Inergy lust. Iff zee taerget fue-a's Inergy drups tu 0, Meend Vraeck inds und thaet fue-a taekes 15...100 daemaege-a.
49.concise: Hex Spell. (5...40 secunds.) Cooses 1 Inergy luss iaech teeme-a fue-a is zee taerget ooff yuoor nun-hex Mesmer skeells. Deaels 5...25 daemaege-a per pueent ooff Inergy lust. Iff taerget fue-a's Inergy drups tu 0, it taekes 15...100 daemaege-a und Meend Vraeck inds.

50.name: Vaestrel's Vurry
50.description: Hex Spell. Aeffter 3 secunds, taerget fue-a taekes 20...100 daemaege-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a sooccessffoolly uses a skeell, Vaestrel's Vurry inds premaetoorely und dues nu daemaege-a.
50.concise: Hex Spell. (3 secunds.) Ind iffffect: cooses 20...100 daemaege-a tu taerget und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues. Nu iffffect und inds iaerly iff taerget fue-a uses a skeell.

51.name: Shaeme-a
51.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a caests a spell thaet taergets un aelly, zee spell faeeels und yuoo steael up tu 5...14 Inergy frum thaet fue-a.
51.concise: Hex Spell. (6 secunds.) Taerget fue-a's next spell faeeels und yuoo steael 5...14 Inergy. Nu iffffect unless thees fue-a's spell taergeted oone-a ooff its aelleees.

52.name: Puneec
52.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 1...10 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues aere-a hexed veet Puneec. Vhee a fue-a hexed veet Puneec sooccessffoolly uses a skeell, aell oozeer neaerby fues aere-a interroopted.
52.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues neaer yuoor taerget (1...10 secunds). Interroopts aell oozeer neaerby fues vhenefer a hexed fue-a sooccessffoolly aecteefaetes a skeell.

53.name: Meegraeeene-a
53.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun und taekes 100% lunger tu aecteefaete-a skeells.
53.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Cooses -1...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun und duoobles skeell aecteefaeshun teeme-a.

54.name: Creeppleeng Ungooeesh
54.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget mufes und aettaecks 50% slooer und sooffffers -1...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
54.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes und aettaecks 50% slooer und haes -1...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun.

55.name: Fefered Dreaems
55.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 10...25 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a sooffffers frum a noo cundeeshun, aell fues in zee aerea sooffffer frum thaet cundeeshun aes vell. Iff taerget fue-a haes tvu oor mure-a cundeeshuns, thaet fue-a is Daezed fur 1...3 secunds.
55.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (10...25 secunds.) Fues in zee aerea aelsu haefe-a uny noo cundeeshuns thaet taerget fue-a aecqooures. Inffleects Daezed oon taerget fue-a (1...3 secunds) iff thaet fue-a haes tvu oor mure-a cundeeshuns.

56.name: Suutheeng Imaeges
56.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8...20 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues cunnut gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a.
56.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (8...20 secunds). Zeese-a fues cunnut gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a.

57.name: Cry ooff Froostraeshun
57.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is useeng a skeell, thaet fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea aere-a interroopted. Fue-a sooffffers 15...75 daemaege-a und fues in zee aerea taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a.
57.concise: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is useeng a skeell, thaet fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea aere-a interroopted. Fue-a sooffffers 15...75 daemaege-a und fues in zee aerea taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a.

58.name: Seegnet ooff Meedneeght
58.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Yuoo und taerget tuooched fue-a becume-a Bleended fur 15 secunds.
58.concise: Ileete-a Tuooch Seegnet. (15 secunds.) Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun. Yuoo sooffffer frum Bleendness (15 secunds).

59.name: Seegnet ooff Veaereeness
59.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues luse-a 3...8 Inergy und sooffffer frum Veaekness fur 1...12 secunds.
59.concise: Seegnet. Aelsu aeffffects fues neaer yuoor taerget. Cooses 3...8 Inergy luss und inffleects Veaekness (1...12 secunds).

61.name: Leech Seegnet
61.description: Seegnet. Interroopt taerget fue-a's aecshun. Iff thaet aecshun vaes a spell, yuoo gaeeen 3...15 Inergy.
61.concise: Seegnet. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 3...15 Inergy iff zee aecshun vaes a spell.

62.name: Seegnet ooff Hoomeeleety
62.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a's ileete-a skeell is deesaebled fur 1...16 secunds. Yuoor nun-Mesmer skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 4 secunds.
62.concise: Seegnet. Deesaebles ileete-a skeell (1...16 secunds). Deesaebles yuoor nun-Mesmer skeells (4 secunds).

63.name: Keystune-a Seegnet
63.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Aell ooff yuoor seegnets ixcept Keystune-a Seegnet aere-a rechaerged. Fur 20 secunds, zee next 0...6 teeme-as yuoo use-a a seegnet thaet taergets a fue-a, aell oozeer fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget taeke-a 15...60 daemaege-a und aere-a interroopted.
63.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. (20 secunds.) Yuoor next 0...6 seegnets interroopt und deael 15...60 daemaege-a tu oozeer fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget. Ineeteeael Iffffect: rechaerges aell ooff yuoor oozeer seegnets.

65.name: Aercune-a Meemeecry
65.description: Spell. Fur 20 secunds, Aercune-a Meemeecry becumes zee nun-furm ileete-a skeell frum taerget oozeer aelly.
65.concise: Spell. Thees skeell becumes taerget aelly's ileete-a skeell (20 secunds). Cunnut selff-taerget. Nu iffffect iff taerget's ileete-a skeell is a furm.

66.name: Spureet Shaeckles
66.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a luses 5 Inergy vhenefer thaet fue-a aettaecks.
66.concise: Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget fue-a luses 5 Inergy vhenefer it aettaecks.

67.name: Shaetter Hex
67.description: Spell. Remufe-a a hex frum taerget aelly. Iff a hex is remufed, fues neaer thaet aelly taeke-a 30...120 daemaege-a.
67.concise: Spell. Remufes a hex frum taerget aelly. Remufael iffffect: deaels 30...120 daemaege-a tu fues neaer thees aelly.

68.name: Draeeen Inchuntment
68.description: Spell. Remufe-a un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Iff un inchuntment is remufed, yuoo gaeeen 8...17 Inergy und 40...120 Heaelt.
68.concise: Spell. Remufes un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 8...17 Inergy und 40...120 Heaelt.

69.name: Shaetter Inchuntment
69.description: Spell. Remufe-a un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Iff un inchuntment is remufed, thaet fue-a taekes 14...100 daemaege-a.
69.concise: Spell. Remufes un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffect: deaels 14...100 daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

72.name: Ilementael Reseestunce-a
72.description: Stunce-a. Fur 30...90 secunds, Yuoo gaeeen +40 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a, boot yuoo luse-a 24...12 aermur aegaeeenst physeecael daemaege-a.
72.concise: Stunce-a. (30...90 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +40 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a. Yuoo haefe-a -24...12 aermur aegaeeenst physeecael daemaege-a.

73.name: Physeecael Reseestunce-a
73.description: Stunce-a. Fur 30...90 secunds, Yuoo gaeeen +40 aermur aegaeeenst physeecael daemaege-a, boot yuoo luse-a 24...12 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a.
73.concise: Stunce-a. (30...90 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +40 aermur aegaeeenst physeecael daemaege-a. Yuoo haefe-a -24...12 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a.

74.name: Ichu
74.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, Ichu is replaeced veet zee next skeell yuoo use-a. Ichu aects aes thees skeell fur 30 secunds.
74.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Ichu becumes zee next skeell yuoo use-a (30 secunds).

75.name: Aercune-a Ichu
75.description: Inchuntment Spell. Iff yuoo caest a spell in zee next 20 secunds, Aercune-a Ichu is replaeced veet thaet spell fur 20 secunds. Aercune-a Ichu inds premaetoorely iff yuoo use-a a nun-spell skeell.
75.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Aercune-a Ichu becumes zee next spell yuoo use-a (20 secunds). Thees inchuntment inds iff yuoo use-a uny skeell thaet is nut a spell.

76.name: Imaegeened Boordee
76.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8...20 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 50% slooer.
76.concise: Hex Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 50% slooer.

77.name: Chaeus Sturm
77.description: Spell. Creaete-a a Chaeus Sturm aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun thaet laests fur 10 secunds. Iaech secund, fues aedjaecent tu thees lucaeshun taeke-a 5...25 daemaege-a und luse-a 0...2 Inergy.
77.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...25 daemaege-a und cooses 0...2 Inergy luss iaech secund (10 secunds). Heets fues aedjaecent tu taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun. Bork! Bork! Bork!

78.name: Ipeedemeec
78.description: Spell. Spreaed aell negaeteefe-a cundeeshuns und zeeur remaeeeneeng dooraeshuns frum taerget fue-a tu aell fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget.
78.concise: Spell. Cundeeshuns oon taerget fue-a trunsffer tu aedjaecent fues.

79.name: Inergy Draeeen
79.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a luses 2...9 Inergy. Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust.
79.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Cooses 2...9 Inergy luss. Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust.

80.name: Inergy Taep
80.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a luses 4...7 Inergy. Yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust.
80.concise: Spell. Cooses 4...7 Inergy luss. Yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy lust. Bork! Bork! Bork!

81.name: Aercune-a Theeefery
81.description: Spell. Fur 5...35 secunds, oone-a rundum spell is deesaebled fur taerget fue-a, und Aercune-a Theeefery is replaeced by thaet spell.
81.concise: Spell. (5...35 secunds.) Deesaebles oone-a rundum spell. Thees skeell becumes thaet spell.

82.name: Muntra ooff Recaell
82.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, yuoo gaeeen nu beneffeet frum it. Yuoo gaeeen 10...25 Inergy vhee Muntra ooff Recaell inds.
82.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Ind iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 10...25 Inergy.

83.name: Uneemaete-a Bune-a Hurrur
83.description: Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a tu uneemaete-a a lefel 1...17 bune-a hurrur.
83.concise: Spell. Creaetes a lefel 1...17 bune-a hurrur. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a.

84.name: Uneemaete-a Bune-a Feeend
84.description: Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a tu uneemaete-a a lefel 1...17 bune-a feeend. Bune-a feeends cun aettaeck aet runge-a.
84.concise: Spell. Creaetes a lefel 1...17 bune-a feeend thaet cun aettaeck aet runge-a. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a.

85.name: Uneemaete-a Bune-a Meeneeuns
85.description: Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a tu uneemaete-a tvu lefel 0...12 bune-a meeneeuns.
85.concise: Spell. Creaetes tvu lefel 0...12 bune-a meeneeuns. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a.

86.name: Grent's Baelunce-a
86.description: Ileete-a Spell. Iff taerget fue-a haes mure-a Heaelt thun yuoo, yuoo gaeeen haelff zee deefffference-a (up tu yuoor maexeemoom Heaelt), und thaet fue-a luses un iqooael aemuoont. Iff thees fue-a haes less Heaelt thun yuoo, yuoo luse-a haelff zee deefffference-a, und thaet fue-a gaeeens un iqooael aemuoont.
86.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo gaeeen Heaelt iqooael tu haelff zee deefffference-a betveee yuoo und taerget, und thees fue-a luses un iqooael aemuoont. Iff thees fue-a haes less Heaelt thun yuoo, yuoo luse-a haelff zee deefffference-a und thaet fue-a gaeeens un iqooael aemuoont.

87.name: Feraeta's Gaeze-a
87.description: Spell. Iff taerget husteele-a uneemaeted undeaed haes a maester, its bund tu its maester is brukee, maekeeng it husteele-a tu aell oozeer creaetoores. Iff it haed nu maester, yuoo becume-a its maester und heael it fur 60...80. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Deaet Maegeec 4 oor less.)
87.concise: Spell. Maeke-a taerget undeaed serfunt maesterless. Iff it is aelreaedy maesterless, yuoo becume-a its maester und heael it fur 60...80. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Deaet Maegeec 5 oor mure-a.

88.name: Feraeta's Oora
88.description: Inchuntment Spell. Aell husteele-a uneemaeted undeaed in zee aerea becume-a buoond tu yuoo. Feraeta's Oora inds aeffter 120...300 secunds. Vhee Feraeta's Oora inds, yuoo luse-a yuoor bund veet uny undeaed buoond tu yuoo. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Deaet Maegeec 4 oor less.)
88.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (120...300 secunds.) Becume-a maester ooff aell husteele-a undeaed serfunts in zee aerea. Ind iffffect: yuoor undeaed serfunts becume-a maesterless. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Deaet Maegeec 5 oor mure-a.

89.name: Deaethly Cheell
89.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 5...50 culd daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a's Heaelt is aebufe-a 50%, yuoo deael un aeddeeshunael 5...50 shaedoo daemaege-a.
89.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...50 culd daemaege-a. Deaels 5...50 mure-a daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a vaes aebufe-a 50% Heaelt.

90.name: Feraeta's Saecreeffeece-a
90.description: Spell. Fur 5...10 secunds, yuoor undeaed aelleees gaeeen +10 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Aell cundeeshuns aere-a remufed frum thuse-a aelleees und trunsfferred tu yuoo. Iff thees spell is sooccessffool und yuoo haefe-a cuntrul ooff 3 oor fooer meeneeuns, Feraeta's Saecreeffeece-a instuntly rechaerges.
90.concise: Spell. (5...10 secunds.) 10 undeaed aelleeed serfunts gaeeen +10 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Instuntly rechaerges iff yuoo haefe-a cuntrul ooff 3 oor fooer serfunts. Trunsffers aell cundeeshuns frum thuse-a serfunts tu yuoo.

91.name: Vell ooff Pooer
91.description: Ileete-a Vell Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 66% heaelt tu creaete-a a Vell ooff Pooer aet thaet lucaeshun. Fur 10...30 secunds, aelleees veetheen zee aerea ooff Vell ooff Pooer gaeeen +1...6 Heaelt regeneraeshun und +2 Inergy regeneraeshun.
91.concise: Ileete-a Vell Spell. (10...30 secunds.) Aelleees in thees vell haefe-a +1...6 Heaelt regeneraeshun und +2 Inergy regeneraeshun. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a oor saecreeffeeces 66% heaelt.

92.name: Vell ooff Bluud
92.description: Vell Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 66% heaelt tu creaete-a a Vell ooff Bluud aet its lucaeshun. Fur 8...20 secunds, aelleees in thaet aerea receeefe-a +1...6 Heaelt regeneraeshun.
92.concise: Vell Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Aelleees in thees vell haefe-a +1...6 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a oor saecreeffeeces 66% heaelt.

93.name: Vell ooff Sooffffereeng
93.description: Vell Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 66% heaelt tu creaete-a a Vell ooff Sooffffereeng aet its lucaeshun. Fur 10...30 secunds, fues in thaet aerea sooffffer -1...6 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
93.concise: Vell Spell. (10...30 secunds.) Fues in thees vell haefe-a -1...6 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a oor saecreeffeeces 66% heaelt.

94.name: Vell ooff zee Pruffune-a
94.description: Vell Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 66% heaelt tu creaete-a a Vell ooff zee Pruffune-a aet its lucaeshun. Fur 8...20 secunds, fues in thaet aerea aere-a streepped ooff aell inchuntments und cunnut be-a zee taerget ooff foorzeer inchuntments. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Deaet Maegeec 4 oor less.)
94.concise: Vell Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Fues in thees vell luse-a aell inchuntments und cunnut be-a zee taerget ooff foorzeer inchuntments. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a oor saecreeffeeces 66% heaelt. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Deaet Maegeec 5 oor mure-a.

95.name: Pootreed Ixpluseeun
95.description: Spell. Zee curpse-a neaerest yuoor taerget ixpludes, sendeeng oooot a shuckvaefe-a thaet deaels 24...120 daemaege-a tu neaerby fues.
95.concise: Spell. Ixpludes a curpse-a, deaeleeng 24...120 daemaege-a tu fues neaer it. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a.

96.name: Suool Feaest
96.description: Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a tu gaeeen 50...280 Heaelt.
96.concise: Spell. Yuoo gaeeen 50...280 Heaelt. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a.

97.name: Necruteec Traefersael
97.description: Spell. Ixplueet a rundum curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 30...20% heaelt tu telepurt tu taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Yuoo becume-a Deeseaesed fur 6 secunds und aell neaerby fues becume-a Pueesuned fur 5...20 secunds.
97.concise: Spell. Ixplueet a rundum curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 30...20% heaelt tu telepurt tu taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Yuoo becume-a Deeseaesed fur 6 secunds und aell neaerby fues becume-a Pueesuned fur 5...20 secunds.

98.name: Cunsoome-a Curpse-a
98.description: Spell. Ixplueet a rundum taerget. Yuoo telepurt tu thaet curpse-a's lucaeshun und gaeeen 25...100 Heaelt und 5...20 Inergy.
98.concise: Spell. Telepurt tu a curpse-a's lucaeshun. Yuoo gaeeen 25...100 Heaelt und 5...20 Inergy. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a.

99.name: Paeraeseeteec Bund
99.description: Hex Spell. Fur 20 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Zee caester is heaeled fur 30...120 vhee Paeraeseeteec Bund inds.
99.concise: Hex Spell. (20 secunds.) Cooses -1 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Ind iffffect: yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 30...120 Heaelt.

100.name: Suool Baerbs
100.description: Hex Spell. Fur 30 secunds, taerget fue-a taekes 15...30 daemaege-a vhee un inchuntment oor hex is caest oon thaet taerget. Bork! Bork! Bork!
100.concise: Hex Spell. (30 secunds.) Deaels 15...30 daemaege-a vhee un inchuntment oor hex is caest oon taerget fue-a.

101.name: Baerbs
101.description: Hex Spell. Fur 30 secunds, taerget fue-a taekes 4...16 mure-a daemaege-a vhee heet by physeecael daemaege-a.
101.concise: Hex Spell. (30 secunds.) Taerget fue-a taekes 4...16 daemaege-a vhenefer it taekes physeecael daemaege-a.

102.name: Shaedoo Streeke-a
102.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 12...48 shaedoo daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a's Heaelt is aebufe-a 50%, yuoo steael up tu 12...48 Heaelt.
102.concise: Spell. Deaels 12...48 daemaege-a. Steael up tu 12...48 Heaelt iff thees fue-a vaes aebufe-a 50% Heaelt.

103.name: Preece-a ooff Faeeeloore-a
103.description: Hex Spell. Fur 30 secunds, taerget fue-a haes a 25% chunce-a tu meess veet aettaecks und taekes 1...46 daemaege-a vhenefer thaet fue-a faeeels tu heet in cumbaet.
103.concise: Hex Spell. (30 secunds.) 25% chunce-a tu meess. Taerget fue-a taekes 1...46 daemaege-a vhenefer it faeeels tu heet.

104.name: Deaet Nufa
104.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, iff taerget aelly deees, aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 26...100 daemaege-a und aere-a Pueesuned fur 15 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
104.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Deaels 26...100 daemaege-a und inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (15 secunds) oon aedjaecent fues iff taerget aelly deees.

105.name: Deaethly Svaerm
105.description: Spell. Deaethly Svaerm fleees oooot slooly und streekes fur 30...90 culd daemaege-a oon up tu three-a taergets in zee aerea. Bork! Bork! Bork!
105.concise: Spell. Deaethly Svaerm fleees oooot slooly und deaels 30...90 culd daemaege-a. Heets tvu aeddeeshunael fues in zee aerea.

106.name: Rutteeng Flesh
106.description: Spell. Taerget fleshy fue-a becumes Deeseaesed fur 10...25 secunds, slooly luseeng Heaelt.

107.name: Furoolence-a
107.description: Ileete-a Spell. Iff taerget fue-a vaes aelreaedy sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun, thaet fue-a sooffffers frum Deeseaese-a, Pueesun, und Veaekness fur 3...15 secunds.
107.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Inffleects Deeseaese-a, Pueesun, und Veaekness cundeeshuns (3...15 secunds). Nu iffffect unless thees fue-a aelreaedy haed a cundeeshun.

108.name: Sooffffereeng
108.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6...30 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues sooffffer -0...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
108.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues neaer taerget (6...30 secunds). Zeese-a fues haefe-a -0...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun.

109.name: Leeffe-a Seephun
109.description: Hex Spell. Fur 12...24 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun, und yuoo gaeeen +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun.
109.concise: Hex Spell. (12...24 secunds.) Taerget fue-a haes -1...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Yuoo haefe-a +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun.

110.name: Unhuly Feaest
110.description: Spell. Steael up tu 10...65 Heaelt frum up tu 1...4 fues in zee aerea.
110.concise: Spell. Steaels 10...65 Heaelt frum 1...4 fue-as in zee aerea aeruoond yuoo.

111.name: Aevaekee zee Bluud
111.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20...44 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +2 Bluud Maegeec und +2 Coorses, boot vhenefer yuoo saecreeffeece-a Heaelt, yuoo saecreeffeece-a 50% mure-a thun zee nurmael aemuoont.
111.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20...44 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +2 Bluud Maegeec und Coorses. Saecreeffeece-a 50% mure-a Heaelt thun nurmael.

112.name: Desecraete-a Inchuntments
112.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues taeke-a 6...60 shaedoo daemaege-a und 4...20 shaedoo daemaege-a fur iaech inchuntment oon zeem.
112.concise: Spell. Deaels 6...60 daemaege-a tu taerget und neaerby fues. Deaels 4...20 mure-a daemaege-a fur iaech inchuntment oon zeem.

113.name: Taeeented Flesh
113.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20...44 secunds, aelleees in zee aerea aere-a immoone-a tu deeseaese-a, und unyune-a streekeeng thuse-a aelleees in melee-a becumes Deeseaesed fur 3...15 secunds.
113.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (20...44 secunds.) Fues vhu heet aelleees in zee aerea veet melee-a becume-a Deeseaesed (3...15 secunds); thees aelly is immoone-a tu Deeseaese-a.

114.name: Oora ooff zee Leech
114.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Aell curpses veetheen iaershut aere-a ixplueeted und yuoo uneemaete-a a lefel 1...17 bune-a hurrur ploos oone-a fur iaech curpse-a ixplueeted in thees vaey. Fur 5...45 secunds, yuoor Deaet Maegeec aettreeboote-a is increaesed by +1.
114.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Ixplueet aell curpses in iaershut. Uneemaetes a lefel 1...17 bune-a hurrur, ploos oone-a fur iaech ixplueeted curpse-a. Yuoo haefe-a +1 Deaet Maegeec (5...45 secunds).

115.name: Bluud Renooael
115.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 7 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +3...6 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Vhee Bluud Renooael inds, yuoo gaeeen 40...190 Heaelt.
115.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (7 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +3...6 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Ind iffffect: heaels yuoo fur 40...190.

116.name: Daerk Oora
116.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, vhenefer taerget aelly saecreeffeeces Heaelt, Daerk Oora deaels 5...50 shaedoo daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues, und yuoo luse-a 5...20 Heaelt.
116.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Deaels 5...50 daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues vhenefer taerget aelly saecreeffeeces Heaelt. Daemaege-a cust: yuoo luse-a 5...20 Heaelt.

117.name: Inffeeble-a
117.description: Spell. Taerget sooffffers frum Veaekness fur 10...30 secunds.

118.name: Inffeebleeng Bluud
118.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues sooffffer frum Veaekness fur 5...20 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
118.concise: Spell. Inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) oon thees fue-a und neaerby fues.

119.name: Bluud is Pooer
119.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget oozeer aelly gaeeens +3...6 Inergy regeneraeshun.
119.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) +3...6 Inergy regeneraeshun. Cunnut selff-taerget.

120.name: Bluud ooff zee Maester
120.description: Spell. Aell ooff yuoor undeaed aelleees aere-a heaeled fur 30...116 Heaelt. Yuoo saecreeffeece-a un aeddeeshunael 2% maexeemoom Heaelt per meeneeun heaeled in thees vaey.
120.concise: Spell. Heaels yuoor undeaed serfunts fur 30...116. Heaeleeng cust: +2% Heaelt saecreeffeece-a per serfunt heaeled.

121.name: Speeteffool Spureet
121.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 10...25 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a aettaecks oor uses a skeell, Speeteffool Spureet deaels 15...45 shaedoo daemaege-a tu thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent aelleees ooff thaet fue-a.
121.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (10...25 secunds.) Deaels 15...45 daemaege-a tu taerget und aedjaecent fues vhenefer thees fue-a aettaecks oor uses a skeell.

122.name: Maeleegn Interfenshun
122.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a receeefes 20% less beneffeet frum heaeleeng. Iff taerget fue-a deees vheele-a hexed veet Maeleegn Interfenshun, a lefel 1...17 maesterless bune-a hurrur is soommuned.
122.concise: Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget fue-a receeefes 20% less frum heaeleeng. Iff thees fue-a deees vheele-a sooffffereeng frum thees hex, a lefel 1...17 maesterless bune-a hurrur is soommuned.

123.name: Inseedeeuoos Paeraeseete-a
123.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a heets veet un aettaeck, yuoo steael up tu 15...45 Heaelt frum thaet fue-a.
123.concise: Hex Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Steael 15...45 Heaelt vhenefer taerget fue-a heets veet un aettaeck.

124.name: Speenael Sheefers
124.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10...40 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a is stroock fur culd daemaege-a vheele-a useeng a skeell, thaet fue-a is interroopted, und yuoo luse-a 8...3 Inergy oor Speenael Sheefers inds.
124.concise: Hex Spell. (10...40 secunds.) Culd daemaege-a interroopts taerget fue-a's skeells. Interroopshun cust: yuoo luse-a 8...3 Inergy oor Speenael Sheefers inds.

125.name: Veezeer
125.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...35 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -2...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun und -1 Inergy degeneraeshun. Iff taerget fue-a's Inergy reaeches 0, thaet fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a und Veezeer inds.
125.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5...35 secunds.) Cooses -2...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun und -1 Inergy degeneraeshun. Deaels 15...75 daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a's Inergy drups tu 0. Inds iff thees fue-a's Inergy drups tu 0.

126.name: Leeffe-a Trunsffer
126.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 6...12 secunds, taerget fue-a und aedjaecent fues sooffffer -3...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun, vheech yuoo gaeeen aes Heaelt regeneraeshun.
126.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (6...12 secunds). Cooses -3...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Yuoo haefe-a +3...8 Heaelt regeneraeshun.

127.name: Maerk ooff Soobferseeun
127.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a caests a spell thaet taergets un aelly ooff thaet fue-a, zee spell faeeels und yuoo steael up tu 10...92 Heaelt frum thaet fue-a.
127.concise: Hex Spell. (6 secunds.) Taerget fue-a's next spell faeeels und yuoo steael 10...92 Heaelt. Nu iffffect unless thees fue-a's spell taergeted oone-a ooff its aelleees.

128.name: Suool Leech
128.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a caests a spell, yuoo steael up tu 16...80 Heaelt frum thaet fue-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
128.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (10 secunds.) Steael 16...80 Heaelt vhenefer taerget fue-a caests a spell.

129.name: Deffeele-a Flesh
129.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...35 secunds, taerget fue-a gaeeens oonly tvu-thurds Heaelt frum heaeleeng. Bork! Bork! Bork!
129.concise: Hex Spell. (5...35 secunds.) Redooces heaeleeng taerget fue-a receeefes by 33%. Oonly skeells veet zee vurd "heael" in zee descreepshun aere-a aeffffected.

130.name: Demuneec Flesh
130.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30...60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo use-a a skeell thaet taergets a fue-a, yuoo deael 5...20 shaedoo daemaege-a tu aell oozeer fues aedjaecent tu yuoo.
130.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30...60 secunds.) Vhee useeng a skeell oon a fue-a, deael 5...20 shaedoo daemaege-a tu aell oozeer fues aedjaecent tu yuoo.

131.name: Baerbed Seegnet
131.description: Seegnet. Yuoo inffleect Bleedeeng fur 3...15 secunds oon taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues.
131.concise: Seegnet. Taerget und aedjaecent fues sooffffer frum Bleedeeng (3...15 secunds).

132.name: Plaegooe-a Seegnet
132.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Trunsffer aell negaeteefe-a cundeeshuns veet 100...200% ooff zeeur remaeeeneeng dooraeshuns frum yuoorselff tu taerget fue-a. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Coorses 4 oor less.)
132.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Trunsffers aell cundeeshuns veet 100...200% ooff zeeur remaeeeneeng dooraeshuns frum yuoorselff tu taerget fue-a. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Coorses 5 oor mure-a.

133.name: Daerk Paect
133.description: Spell. Deael 20...60 shaedoo daemaege-a tu taerget fue-a.

134.name: Oorder ooff Paeeen
134.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5 secunds, vhenefer a paerty member heets a fue-a veet physeecael daemaege-a, thaet paerty member dues +3...16 daemaege-a.
134.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Inchunts aell paerty members (5 secunds). 3...16 mure-a daemaege-a vhenefer zeese-a paerty members heet veet physeecael daemaege-a.

135.name: Faeeenzeeaertedness
135.description: Hex Spell. Fur zee next 4...18 secunds, taerget fue-a aettaecks 50% slooer, und thaet fue-a sooffffers -1...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
135.concise: Hex Spell. (4...18 secunds.) Taerget fue-a aettaecks 50% slooer und haes -1...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun.

136.name: Shaedoo ooff Feaer
136.description: Hex Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aettaeck 50% slooer fur zee next 5...30 secunds.
136.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (5...30 secunds). Zeey aettaeck 50% slooer.

137.name: Reegur Murtees
137.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8...20 secunds, taerget fue-a cunnut bluck.
137.concise: Hex Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Taerget fue-a cunnut bluck.

138.name: Daerk Bund
138.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur zee next 30...60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo receeefe-a daemaege-a, yuoor clusest meeneeun sooffffers 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a fur yuoo.
138.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30...60 secunds.) Trunsffers 75% ooff incumeeng daemaege-a frum yuoo tu yuoor neaerest serfunt.

139.name: Inffoose-a Cundeeshun
139.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur zee next 15...60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo receeefe-a a cundeeshun, thaet cundeeshun is trunsfferred tu yuoor clusest meeneeun insteaed.
139.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (15...60 secunds.) Vhenefer yuoo receeefe-a a cundeeshun, it trunsffers frum yuoo tu yuoor clusest undeaed serfunt.

140.name: Maelaeeese-a
140.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...35 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1 Inergy degeneraeshun und yuoo sooffffer -1 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Iff taerget fue-a's Inergy reaeches 0, thaet fue-a taekes 5...50 daemaege-a und Maelaeeese-a inds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
140.concise: Hex Spell. (5...35 secunds.) Cooses -1 Inergy degeneraeshun. Deaels 5...50 daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a's Inergy drups tu 0. Yuoo haefe-a -1 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Inds iff thees fue-a's Inergy drups tu 0.

141.name: Rend Inchuntments
141.description: Spell. Remufe-a 5...9 inchuntments frum taerget fue-a. Fur iaech Munk inchuntment remufed, yuoo luse-a 55...25 Heaelt.
141.concise: Spell. Remufes 5...9 inchuntments frum taerget fue-a. Remufael cust: yuoo luse-a 55...25 Heaelt fur iaech Munk inchuntment remufed.

142.name: Leengereeng Coorse-a
142.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 6...30 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues sooffffer -1...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun, und receeefe-a 25% less beneffeet frum heaeleeng.
142.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (6...30 secunds.) Taerget und neaerby fues haefe-a -1...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun und receeefe-a 25% less beneffeet frum heaeleeng.

143.name: Streep Inchuntment
143.description: Spell. Remufe-a 0...2 inchuntments frum taerget fue-a. Iff un inchuntment is remufed, yuoo steael 5...65 Heaelt.
143.concise: Spell. Remufes 0...2 inchuntments frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffect: yuoo steael 5...65 Heaelt.

144.name: Cheelblaeeens
144.description: Spell. Yuoo becume-a Pueesuned fur 10 secunds. Fues in zee aerea ooff yuoor taerget aere-a stroock fur 10...44 culd daemaege-a und luse-a 1...2 inchuntments.
144.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...44 culd daemaege-a tu fues in zee aerea aeruoond yuoor taerget; remufes 1...2 inchuntments frum zeese-a fues. Yuoo aere-a Pueesuned (10 secunds).

145.name: Seegnet ooff Aeguny
145.description: Seegnet. Yuoo sooffffer frum Bleedeeng fur 25 secunds. Aell neaerby fues taeke-a 10...70 daemaege-a.
145.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 10...70 daemaege-a tu fues neaer yuoo. Yuoo begeen Bleedeeng (25 secunds).

147.name: Daerk Foory
147.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5 secunds, vhenefer uny paerty member heets veet un aettaeck, thaet paerty member gaeeens oone-a heet ooff aedrenaeleene-a. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Bluud Maegeec ooff 4 oor less.)
147.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Inchunts paerty members (5 secunds). Zeese-a paerty members gaeeen oone-a streeke-a ooff aedrenaeleene-a iaech teeme-a zeey heet veet un aettaeck. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Bluud Maegeec 5 oor mure-a.

148.name: Oorder ooff zee Faempure-a
148.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5 secunds, vhenefer a paerty member vhu is nut under zee iffffects ooff unuzeer Necrumuncer inchuntment heets a fue-a veet physeecael daemaege-a, thaet paerty member steaels up tu 3...16 Heaelt.
148.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Inchunts aell paerty members (5 secunds.) Zeese-a paerty members steael 3...16 Heaelt veet iaech physeecael daemaege-a aettaeck. Paerty members under unuzeer Necrumuncer inchuntment aere-a nut aeffffected.

149.name: Plaegooe-a Sendeeng
149.description: Spell. Trunsffer 1...3 negaeteefe-a cundeeshuns und their remaeeeneeng dooraeshuns frum yuoorselff tu taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues.
149.concise: Spell. Trunsffer 1...3 cundeeshuns und their remaeeeneeng dooraeshuns frum yuoorselff tu taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues.

150.name: Maerk ooff Paeeen
150.description: Hex Spell. Fur 30 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a taekes physeecael daemaege-a, Maerk ooff Paeeen deaels 10...40 shaedoo daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues.
150.concise: Hex Spell. (30 secunds.) Deaels 10...40 daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues vhenefer taerget fue-a taekes physeecael daemaege-a.

151.name: Feaest ooff Curroopshun
151.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 16...80 shaedoo daemaege-a. Yuoo steael up tu 8...40 Heaelt frum iaech stroock fue-a vhu is sooffffereeng frum a hex.
151.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 16...80 daemaege-a tu taerget und aedjaecent fues. Steael 8...40 Heaelt frum iaech hexed fue-a.

152.name: Taeste-a ooff Deaet
152.description: Spell. Steael up tu 100...400 Heaelt frum taerget uneemaeted undeaed aelly.
152.concise: Spell. Steaels 100...400 Heaelt frum aelleeed undeaed serfunt.

153.name: Faempureec Gaeze-a
153.description: Spell. Steael up tu 18...60 Heaelt frum taerget fue-a.

154.name: Plaegooe-a Tuooch
154.description: Skeell. Trunsffer 1...3 negaeteefe-a cundeeshuns und their remaeeeneeng dooraeshuns frum yuoorselff tu taerget tuooched fue-a.
154.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Trunsffers 1...3 cundeeshuns frum yuoorselff tu taerget fue-a.

155.name: Feele-a Tuooch
155.description: Skeell. Tuooch taerget fue-a tu deael 20...65 daemaege-a.

156.name: Faempureec Tuooch
156.description: Skeell. Tuooch taerget fue-a tu steael up tu 29...74 Heaelt.

157.name: Bluud Reetooael
157.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8...14 secunds, taerget tuooched aelly gaeeens +3 Inergy regeneraeshun. Bluud Reetooael cunnut be-a used oon zee caester.
157.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8...14 secunds.) +3 Inergy regeneraeshun. Cunnut selff-taerget.

158.name: Tuooch ooff Aeguny
158.description: Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a taekes 20...58 shaedoo daemaege-a.

159.name: Veaekee Aermur
159.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a und fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget haefe-a Craecked Aermur fur 5...20 secunds.
159.concise: Spell. Aelsu aeffffects aedjaecent fues. Inffleects Craecked Aermur cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

160.name: Veendburne-a Speed
160.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...13 secunds, taerget aelly mufes 33% faester.
160.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...13 secunds.) Taerget aelly mufes 33% faester.

162.name: Gaele-a
162.description: Spell. Knuck doon taerget fue-a fur 2 secunds. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Aeur Maegeec 4 oor less.)
162.concise: Spell. Cooses knuck-doon. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Aeur Maegeec 5 oor mure-a.

163.name: Vhurlveend
163.description: Spell. Aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 15...75 culd daemaege-a. Aettaeckeeng fues stroock by Vhurlveend aere-a knucked doon. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, thees spell streekes neaerby insteaed ooff aedjaecent.
163.concise: Spell. Heets fues aedjaecent tu yuoo. Deaels 15...75 culd daemaege-a. Cooses knuck-doon tu aettaeckeeng fues. Streekes neaerby insteaed ooff aedjaecent iff Oofercaest.

164.name: Ilementael Aettoonement
164.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 25...60 secunds, yuoo aere-a aettooned tu Aeur, Fure-a, Vaeter, und Iaert und gaeeen +1...2 tu zeese-a aettreebootes. Yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy ploos 50% ooff zee baese-a Inergy cust ooff zee skeell iaech teeme-a yuoo use-a maegeec aessuceeaeted veet uny ooff zeese-a ilements.
164.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (25...60 secunds.) Yuoor ilementael aettreebootes aere-a increaesed by +1...2. Yuoo gaeeen 1 ploos 50% ooff zee baese-a Inergy cust ooff uny Aeur, Fure-a, Vaeter, und Iaert Maegeec skeells yuoo use-a.

165.name: Aermur ooff Iaert
165.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 24...60 aermur, boot mufe-a 50...14% slooer. Bork! Bork! Bork!
165.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +24...60 aermur. Yuoo mufe-a 50...14% slooer.

166.name: Keeneteec Aermur
166.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 12 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +20...80 aermur. Vhenefer yuoo caest a spell, Keeneteec Aermur is renooed fur 12 secunds.
166.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (12 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +20...80 aermur. Renooael bunoos: caest a spell.

167.name: Iroopshun
167.description: Spell. Coose-a un Iroopshun aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Iaech secund fur 5 secunds, fues neaer thees lucaeshun aere-a stroock fur 10...40 iaert daemaege-a und aere-a Bleended fur 10 secunds.
167.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund (5 secunds). Heets fues neaer taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun. Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (10 secunds).

168.name: Maegneteec Oora
168.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 1...8 secunds, yuoo bluck zee next aettaeck aegaeeenst yuoo und deael 10...50 daemaege-a tu yuoor aettaecker. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, aell paerty members in iaershut aere-a aelsu inchunted.
168.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (1...8 secunds.) Bluck zee next aettaeck aegaeeenst yuoo und refflect 10...50 daemaege-a tu zee aettaecker. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, inchunt paerty members in iaershut.

169.name: Iaert Aettoonement
169.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 36...60 secunds, yuoo aere-a aettooned tu Iaert. Yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy ploos 30% ooff zee baese-a Inergy cust ooff zee skeell iaech teeme-a yuoo use-a Iaert Maegeec.
169.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (36...60 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy ploos 30% ooff zee Inergy cust vhee yuoo use-a un Iaert Maegeec skeell.

170.name: Iaerthqooaeke-a
170.description: Spell. Yuoo infuke-a un Iaerthqooaeke-a aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Aell fues neaer thees lucaeshun aere-a knucked doon und aere-a stroock fur 26...100 iaert daemaege-a.
170.concise: Spell. Deaels 26...100 iaert daemaege-a. Aelsu heets fues neaer taerget. Cooses knuck-doon.

171.name: Stuneeng
171.description: Spell. Send oooot a laerge-a stune-a, streekeeng taerget fue-a fur 45...105 iaert daemaege-a iff it heets. Iff Stuneeng heets a fue-a sooffffereeng frum Veaekness, thaet fue-a is knucked doon.
171.concise: Spell. Prujecteele-a: deaels 45...105 iaert daemaege-a. Cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is Veaekened.

172.name: Stune-a Daeggers
172.description: Spell. Send oooot tvu Stune-a Daeggers. Iaech Stune-a Daegger streekes taerget fue-a fur 8...33 iaert daemaege-a iff it heets. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, iaech prujecteele-a inffleects Bleedeeng fur 1...5 secunds.
172.concise: Spell. Tvu prujecteeles: iaech deaels 8...33 iaert daemaege-a. Iff Oofercaest, coose-a Bleedeeng fur 1...5 secunds.

173.name: Graespeeng Iaert
173.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, aell neaerby fues mufe-a 50% slooer.
173.concise: Hex Spell. Hexes fues neaer yuoo (5...20 secunds). Zeese-a fues mufe-a 50% slooer. Bork! Bork! Bork!

174.name: Aefftershuck
174.description: Spell. Neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 15...85 iaert daemaege-a. Knucked doon fues aere-a stroock fur 15...85 aeddeeshunael iaert daemaege-a.
174.concise: Spell. Deaels 15...85 iaert daemaege-a tu neaerby fues. Deaels 15...85 mure-a iaert daemaege-a tu knucked doon fues.

175.name: Vaerd Aegaeeenst Ilements
175.description: Vaerd Spell. Yuoo creaete-a a Vaerd Aegaeeenst Ilements aet yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 8...20 secunds, nun-spureet aelleees in thees aerea gaeeen +24 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a.
175.concise: Vaerd Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Aelleees in thees vaerd haefe-a +24 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a. Spureets aere-a unaeffffected.

176.name: Vaerd Aegaeeenst Melee-a
176.description: Vaerd Spell. Yuoo creaete-a a Vaerd Aegaeeenst Melee-a aet yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 5...20 secunds, nun-spureet aelleees in thees aerea haefe-a a 50% chunce-a tu bluck melee-a aettaecks.
176.concise: Vaerd Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Aelleees in thees vaerd haefe-a a 50% chunce-a tu bluck melee-a aettaecks. Aelleeed spureets aere-a nut aeffffected.

177.name: Vaerd Aegaeeenst Fues
177.description: Vaerd Spell. Yuoo creaete-a a Vaerd Aegaeeenst Fues aet yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 8...20 secunds, nun-spureet fues in thees aerea mufe-a 50% slooer.
177.concise: Vaerd Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Fues in thees vaerd mufe-a 50% slooer. Bork! Bork! Bork!

178.name: Izeer Prudeegy
178.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Luse-a aell inchuntments. Fur 8...20 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +6 Inergy regeneraeshun. Vhee Izeer Prudeegy inds, yuoo luse-a 2 Heaelt fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy yuoo haefe-a.
178.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +6 Inergy regeneraeshun. Ind iffffect: luse-a 2 Heaelt fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy yuoo haefe-a. Luse-a aell inchuntments.

232.name: Leeghtneeng Tuooch
232.description: Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 10...60 leeghtneeng daemaege-a, aere-a Bleended fur 1...4 secunds, und haefe-a Craecked Aermur fur 1...10 secunds. Thees skeell haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
232.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Deaels 10...60 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Aelsu heets fues aedjaecent tu taerget fue-a. Inffleects Bleend (1...4 secunds) und Craecked Aermur (1...10 secunds) oon aell stroock fues. 25% aermur penetraeshun.

233.name: Svurleeng Oora
233.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 3...7 secunds, yuoo aere-a inchunted veet Svurleeng Oora und haefe-a 1...6 Heaelt regeneraeshun und a 50% chunce-a tu bluck prujecteeles. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest vhee yuoo caest thees spell, aell paerty members in iaershut aere-a aelsu inchunted.
233.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (3...7 secunds.) Geefes 1...6 Heaelt regeneraeshun und a 50% chunce-a tu bluck prujecteeles. Iff Oofercaest, aelsu inchunts paerty members in iaershut.

234.name: Deep Freeze-a
234.description: Hex Spell. Yuoo coose-a a Deep Freeze-a aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Aell fues in thees aerea aere-a stroock fur 10...85 culd daemaege-a, und fur 10 secunds, zeey mufe-a 66% slooer.
234.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues in zee aerea ooff yuoor taerget (10 secunds). Zeese-a fues mufe-a 66% slooer. Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 10...85 culd daemaege-a.

235.name: Bloorred Feeseeun
235.description: Hex Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, taerget fue-a und aedjaecent fues aere-a hexed veet Bloorred Feeseeun. Vheele-a hexed, thuse-a fues haefe-a a 50% chunce-a tu meess veet aettaecks.
235.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (4...10 secunds). Zeey haefe-a 50% chunce-a tu meess.

236.name: Meest Furm
236.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...45 secunds, yuoo taeke-a 33% less daemaege-a frum fues under zee iffffect ooff Vaeter Maegeec hexes. Vhenefer yuoo caest un ilementael spell, aell nun-spureet aelleees in iaershut aere-a heaeled fur 50...250% ooff zee Inergy cust ooff zee spell.
236.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10...45 secunds.) Taeke-a 33% less daemaege-a frum fues hexed veet Vaeter Maegeec. Heaels nun-spureet aelleees in iaershut fur 50...250% ooff zee Inergy cust ooff yuoor ilementael spells. Bork! Bork! Bork!

237.name: Vaeter Treedent
237.description: Ileete-a Spell. Send oooot a faest-mufeeng Vaeter Treedent, streekeeng taerget fue-a und up tu 2 aedjaecent fues fur 10...90 culd daemaege-a iff it heets. Iff it heets a mufeeng fue-a, thaet fue-a is knucked doon.
237.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Faest prujecteele-a: deaels 10...90 culd daemaege-a und knucks doon mufeeng fues. Shuuts 2 aeddeeshunael prujecteeles aet aedjaecent fues.

238.name: Aermur ooff Meest
238.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8...20 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +10...40 aermur und mufe-a 33% faester.
238.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +10...40 aermur und mufe-a 33% faester.

239.name: Vaerd Aegaeeenst Haerm
239.description: Ileete-a Vaerd Spell. Creaete-a a Vaerd Aegaeeenst Haerm aet thees lucaeshun. Fur 5...15 secunds, nun-spureet aelleees in thees aerea haefe-a +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun, +12...24 aermur, und un aeddeeshunael +12...24 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a. Thees spell is deesaebled fur 20 secunds.
239.concise: Ileete-a Vaerd Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Aelleees in thees vaerd haefe-a +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun, +12...24 aermur, und +12...24 aeddeeshunael aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a. Spureets aere-a unaeffffected. Thees spell is deesaebled fur 20 secunds.

240.name: Smeete-a
240.description: Spell. Thees aettaeck deaels 10...55 Huly daemaege-a. Iff aettaeckeeng, yuoor taerget taekes un aeddeeshunael 10...35 Huly daemaege-a.
240.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...55 huly daemaege-a. Deaels 10...35 mure-a huly daemaege-a iff taerget is aettaeckeeng.

241.name: Leeffe-a Bund
241.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, vhenefer taerget oozeer aelly taekes daemaege-a frum un aettaeck, haelff zee daemaege-a is redurected tu yuoo. Zee daemaege-a yuoo receeefe-a thees vaey is redooced by 3...30.
241.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Haelff ooff zee daemaege-a taerget aelly taekes frum aettaecks is redurected tu yuoo. Redurected daemaege-a is redooced by 3...30. Cunnut selff-taerget.

242.name: Baelthaezaer's Spureet
242.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, taerget aelly gaeeens aedrenaeleene-a und Inergy aeffter taekeeng daemaege-a. (Zee aemuoont ooff aedrenaeleene-a gaeeened increaeses dependeeng oon yuoor runk in Smeeteeng Praeyers.)
242.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Taerget aelly gaeeens aedrenaeleene-a und 1 Inergy vhee taekeeng daemaege-a.

243.name: Strengt ooff Hunur
243.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, taerget aelly deaels 5...25 mure-a daemaege-a in melee-a.
243.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Taerget aelly deaels 5...25 mure-a daemaege-a in melee-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

244.name: Leeffe-a Aettoonement
244.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, taerget aelly deaels 30% less daemaege-a veet aettaecks, boot gaeeens 14...50% mure-a Heaelt vhee heaeled.
244.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Taerget aelly gaeeens 14...50% mure-a Heaelt vhee heaeled. Thees aelly deaels 30% less daemaege-a veet aettaecks.

245.name: Prutecteefe-a Spureet
245.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...23 secunds, taerget aelly cunnut luse-a mure-a thun 10% maex Heaelt dooe-a tu daemaege-a frum a seengle-a aettaeck oor spell.
245.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...23 secunds.) Incumeeng daemaege-a is redooced tu 10% ooff taerget aelly's maexeemoom Heaelt. Bork! Bork! Bork!

246.name: Deefeene-a Interfenshun
246.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly receeefes daemaege-a thaet vuoold be-a faetael, zee daemaege-a is negaeted und thaet aelly is heaeled fur 26...240 Heaelt.
246.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Negaetes zee next faetael daemaege-a taerget aelly taekes. Negaeshun iffffect: heaels fur 26...240.

247.name: Symbul ooff Vraet
247.description: Spell. Creaete-a a Symbul ooff Vraet aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur 5 secunds, aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 10...40 huly daemaege-a iaech secund.
247.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...40 huly daemaege-a iaech secund (5 secunds). Heets fues aedjaecent tu taerget fue-a's ineeteeael lucaeshun.

248.name: Retreebooshun
248.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, vhenefer taerget aelly taekes aettaeck daemaege-a, thees spell deaels 33% ooff zee daemaege-a baeck tu zee suoorce-a (maexeemoom 5...20 daemaege-a).
248.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Deaels 33% ooff iaech aettaeck's daemaege-a (maexeemoom 5...20) baeck tu zee suoorce-a.

260.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (3 secunds.) Taerget aelly gaeeens 50...100% mure-a Heaelt vhee heaeled und taekes 5...50% less daemaege-a.

261.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...13 secunds, taerget aelly gaeeens +3...10 Heaelt regeneraeshun und 20...45 aermur.

270.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Redooces daemaege-a by 20...50%. Cunnut selff-taerget. Iff yuoor Heaelt is beloo 50% vhee taerget taekes daemaege-a, Leeffe-a Baerreeer inds.

271.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo use-a a skeell thaet taergets un aelly, aell fues aedjaecent tu thaet taerget aere-a stroock fur 5...35 fure-a daemaege-a und yuoo luse-a 1 Inergy.

274.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Taerget und aedjaecent aelleees gaeeen 3...30 Heaelt vhenefer thees aelly taekes daemaege-a. Cunnut selff-taerget.

275.name: Mend Cundeeshun
275.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun (Pueesun, Deeseaese-a, Bleendness, Daezed, Bleedeeng, Creeppled, Boorneeng, Veaekness, Craecked Aermur, oor Deep Vuoond) frum taerget oozeer aelly. Iff a cundeeshun is remufed, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 5...70 Heaelt.

276.description: Ileete-a Spell. Remufe-a aell cundeeshuns (Pueesun, Deeseaese-a, Bleendness, Daezed, Bleedeeng, Creeppled, Boorneeng, Veaekness, Craecked Aermur, und Deep Vuoond) frum taerget oozeer aelly. Fur iaech cundeeshun remufed, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 10...70 Heaelt.

277.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun (Pueesun, Deeseaese-a, Bleendness, Daezed, Bleedeeng, Creeppled, Boorneeng, Veaekness, Craecked Aermur oor Deep Vuoond) frum taerget aelly. Fur iaech remaeeeneeng cundeeshun, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 5...70 Heaelt.
277.concise: Spell. Remufes a cundeeshun. Remufael iffffect: heaels fur 5...70 fur iaech remaeeeneeng cundeeshun.

278.description: Spell. Remufe-a aell cundeeshuns (Pueesun, Deeseaese-a, Bleendness, Daezed, Bleedeeng, Creeppled, Boorneeng, Veaekness, Craecked Aermur, und Deep Vuoond) frum taerget aelly.

279.description: Spell. Heael yuoorselff und paerty members veetheen iaershut fur 15...60 pueents.
