285.name: Heaeleeng Hunds
285.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, vhenefer taerget aelly taekes daemaege-a, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 5...35 Heaelt.
285.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Heaels fur 5...35 vhenefer taerget taekes daemaege-a.

286.name: Heael Oozeer
286.description: Spell. Heael taerget oozeer aelly fur 35...180 Heaelt. Bork! Bork! Bork!

287.name: Heael Paerty
287.description: Spell. Heael inture-a paerty fur 30...75 Heaelt.

288.name: Heaeleeng Breeze-a
288.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 15 secunds, taerget aelly gaeeens +4...9 Heaelt regeneraeshun.

289.name: Feetael Blesseeng
289.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, taerget aelly haes +40...200 maexeemoom Heaelt.

290.name: Mendeeng
290.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, taerget aelly gaeeens +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun.

291.name: Leefe-a Feecaereeuoosly
291.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, vhenefer taerget aelly heets a fue-a, yuoo gaeeen 2...17 Heaelt.
291.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Yuoo gaeeen 2...17 Heaelt vhenefer taerget aelly heets a fue-a.

292.name: Inffoose-a Heaelt
292.description: Spell. Luse-a haelff yuoor coorrent Heaelt. Taerget oozeer aelly is heaeled fur 100...136% ooff zee aemuoont yuoo lust.
292.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 100...136% ooff haelff yuoor coorrent Heaelt. Luse-a haelff yuoor coorrent Heaelt. Cunnut selff-taerget.

293.name: Seegnet ooff Defushun
293.description: Seegnet. Heael taerget aelly fur 20...120 Heaelt.

294.name: Seegnet ooff Joodgment
294.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Taerget fue-a is knucked doon. Thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 15...75 huly daemaege-a.
294.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Knucks doon taerget. Deaels 15...75 huly daemaege-a tu taerget und aedjaecent fues.

295.name: Poorge-a Seegnet
295.description: Seegnet. Remufe-a aell hexes und cundeeshuns frum taerget aelly. Yuoo luse-a 10 Inergy fur iaech hex und iaech cundeeshun remufed.
295.concise: Seegnet. Remufes aell hexes und cundeeshuns. Remufael cust: 10 Inergy iaech.

296.name: Bune-a Seegnet
296.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a taekes 30...60 huly daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a vaes aettaeckeeng, thaet fue-a is knucked doon.
296.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 30...60 huly daemaege-a. Cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is aettaeckeeng.

297.name: Blessed Seegnet
297.description: Seegnet. Fur iaech inchuntment yuoo aere-a maeeentaeeeneeng, yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy. Yuoo cunnut gaeeen mure-a thun 3...24 Inergy in thees vaey.
297.concise: Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy fur iaech inchuntment yuoo aere-a maeeentaeeeneeng. Yuoo cunnut gaeeen mure-a thun 3...24 Inergy in thees vaey.

298.name: Maertyr
298.description: Ileete-a Spell. Trunsffer aell cundeeshuns und zeeur remaeeeneeng dooraeshuns frum yuoor aelleees tu yuoo.
298.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Trunsffer aell cundeeshuns frum aell aelleees tu yuoo.

299.name: Sheeeldeeng Hunds
299.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8 secunds, daemaege-a und leeffe-a steael receeefed by taerget aelly is redooced by 3...18. Vhee Sheeeldeeng Hunds inds, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 5...50 Heaelt. Bork! Bork! Bork!
299.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8 secunds.) Redooces incumeeng daemaege-a und leeffe-a steael by 3...18. Ind iffffect: heaels fur 5...50.

300.name: Cuntemplaeshun ooff Pooreety
300.description: Skeell. Luse-a aell inchuntments. Fur iaech oone-a lust, yuoo gaeeen 0...80 Heaelt, luse-a oone-a hex, und luse-a oone-a cundeeshun (maexeemoom 1...8 hexes und cundeeshuns).
300.concise: Skeell. Yuoo gaeeen 0...80 Heaelt und luse-a oone-a hex und oone-a cundeeshun fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo (maexeemoom 1...8 hexes und cundeeshuns). Yuoo luse-a aell inchuntments.

301.name: Remufe-a Hex
301.description: Spell. Remufe-a a hex frum taerget aelly.
301.concise: Spell. Remufes a hex frum taerget aelly.

302.name: Smeete-a Hex
302.description: Spell. Remufe-a a hex frum taerget aelly. Iff a hex is remufed, fues in zee aerea sooffffer 10...85 huly daemaege-a.
302.concise: Spell. Remufes a hex frum taerget aelly. Remufael iffffect: deaels 10...85 huly daemaege-a tu fues in zee aerea ooff taerget aelly.

303.name: Cunfert Hexes
303.description: Spell. Remufe-a aell hexes frum taerget oozeer aelly. Fur 8...20 secunds, thaet aelly gaeeens +10 aermur fur iaech Necrumuncer hex thaet vaes remufed.
303.concise: Spell. Remufes aell hexes; +10 aermur fur iaech Necrumuncer hex remufed (8...20 secunds). Cunnut selff-taerget.

304.name: Leeght ooff Dvaeyna
304.description: Spell. Resoorrect aell deaed paerty members in zee aerea. Zeey aere-a retoorned tu leeffe-a veet 25% Heaelt und zeru Inergy.
304.concise: Spell. Resoorrects aell deaed paerty members in zee aerea (25% Heaelt, zeru Inergy).

305.name: Resoorrect
305.description: Spell. Resoorrect taerget paerty member. Taerget paerty member is retoorned tu leeffe-a veet 25% Heaelt und zeru Inergy.
305.concise: Spell. Resoorrects taerget paerty member (25% Heaelt, 0 Inergy).

306.name: Reburt
306.description: Spell. Resoorrect taerget paerty member. Taerget paerty member is retoorned tu leeffe-a veet 25% Heaelt und zeru Inergy, und is telepurted tu yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Aell ooff taerget's skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 10...3 secunds. Thees spell cunsoomes aell ooff yuoor remaeeeneeng Inergy.
306.concise: Spell. Resoorrects taerget paerty member (25% Heaelt, 0 Inergy). Telepurts taerget tu yuoo. Deesaebles taerget's skeells (10...3 secunds). Yuoo luse-a aell Inergy.

307.name: Refersael ooff Furtoone-a
307.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly vuoold taeke-a daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael, thaet aelly gaeeens thaet aemuoont ooff Heaelt insteaed, maexeemoom 15...80.
307.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8 secunds.) Cunferts zee next incumeeng daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael (maexeemoom 15...80) tu heaeleeng.

308.name: Sooccur
308.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, taerget oozeer aelly gaeeens +1 Heaelt und +1 Inergy regeneraeshun, boot yuoo luse-a 1 Inergy iaech teeme-a thaet aelly caests a spell.
308.concise: Inchuntment Spell. +1 Heaelt regeneraeshun und +1 Inergy regeneraeshun. Cunnut selff-taerget. Yuoo luse-a 1 Inergy iaech teeme-a taerget aelly caests a spell.

309.name: Huly Feeel
309.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, uny hex caest oon taerget aelly taekes tveece-a aes lung tu caest. Vhee Huly Feeel inds, oone-a hex is remufed frum taerget aelly.
309.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Duoobles caesteeng teeme-a ooff hexes caest oon taerget aelly. Ind iffffect: remufes a hex.

310.name: Deefeene-a Spureet
310.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 1...14 secunds, Munk spells cust yuoo 5 less Inergy tu caest. (Meeneemoom cust: 1 Inergy.)
310.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (1...14 secunds.) Munk spells cust yuoo 5 less Inergy. Meeneemoom cust: 1 Inergy.

311.name: Draev Cundeeshuns
311.description: Spell. Aell negaeteefe-a cundeeshuns aere-a trunsfferred frum taerget oozeer aelly tu yuoorselff. Fur iaech cundeeshun aecqooured, yuoo gaeeen 6...26 Heaelt.
311.concise: Spell. Trunsffers aell cundeeshuns frum taerget aelly tu yuoorselff. Trunsffer iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 6...26 Heaelt fur iaech cundeeshun. Cunnut selff-taerget.

312.name: Huly Streeke-a
312.description: Skeell. Tuooched taerget fue-a taekes 10...55 huly daemaege-a. Iff knucked doon, yuoor taerget taekes un aeddeeshunael 10...55 huly daemaege-a.
312.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Deaels 10...55 huly daemaege-a. Deaels 10...55 mure-a huly daemaege-a iff taerget is knucked-doon.

313.name: Heaeleeng Tuooch
313.description: Spell. Heael taerget tuooched aelly fur 20...80 Heaelt. Heaelt gaeeen frum Deefeene-a Faefur is duoobled fur thees spell.
313.concise: Tuooch Spell. Heaels fur 20...80. Duooble-a Heaelt gaeeen frum Deefeene-a Faefur fur thees spell.

314.name: Resture-a Leeffe-a
314.description: Spell. Tuooch zee budy ooff a faellee paerty member. Taerget paerty member is retoorned tu leeffe-a veet 20...65% Heaelt und 42...90% Inergy.
314.concise: Tuooch Spell. Resoorrects taerget paerty member (20...65% Heaelt, 42...90% Inergy). Bork! Bork! Bork!

315.name: Fengeunce-a
315.description: Inchuntment Spell. Breeng taerget deaed paerty member baeck tu leeffe-a aet fooll Heaelt und fooll Inergy. Fur 30 secunds, thaet paerty member deaels 25% mure-a daemaege-a. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, taerget paerty member deees. Deaeths vheele-a under zee iffffects ooff thees inchuntment du nut incoor a deaet penaelty.
315.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Resoorrects taerget paerty member (fooll Heaelt, fooll Inergy). Thees aelly deaels 25% mure-a daemaege-a und dues nut incoor deaet penaelty. Ind iffffect: thees aelly deees.

316.name: "Tu zee Leemeet!"
316.description: Shuoot. Fur iaech fue-a veetheen iaershut (maexeemoom 1...6), yuoo gaeeen oone-a streeke-a ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Fur 10...20 secunds, yuoor maexeemoom Heaelt is increaesed by 10...60.
316.concise: Shuoot. (10...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +10...60 maexeemoom Heaelt. Ineeteeael iffffect: yuoo gaeeen oone-a streeke-a ooff aedrenaeleene-a fur iaech fue-a veetheen iaershut (maexeemoom 1...6).

317.name: Baettle-a Raege-a
317.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 5...20 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und gaeeen duooble-a aedrenaeleene-a frum aettaecks. Baettle-a Raege-a inds iff yuoo use-a uny nun-aedrenael skeells.
317.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und gaeeen duooble-a aedrenaeleene-a frum yuoor aettaecks. Inds iff yuoo use-a uny nun-aedrenael skeells.

318.name: Deffy Paeeen
318.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a un aeddeeshunael 90...300 Heaelt, un aeddeeshunael 20 aermur, und yuoo taeke-a -1...10 less daemaege-a.
318.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +90...300 maexeemoom Heaelt, +20 aermur, und taeke-a -1...10 less daemaege-a.

319.name: Roosh
319.description: Stunce-a. Fur 8...20 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester.

320.name: Haemstreeng
320.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoor taerget is Creeppled fur 3...15 secunds, slooeeng hees mufement.
320.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...15 secunds).

321.name: Veeld Bloo
321.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck veell resoolt in a creeteecael heet und uny stunce-a beeeng used by yuoor taerget inds. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
321.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Aelvaeys a creeteecael heet. Remufes a stunce-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a.

322.name: Pooer Aettaeck
322.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a.

323.name: Desperaeshun Bloo
323.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a, und yuoor taerget sooffffers frum oone-a ooff zee fullooeeng cundeeshuns: Deep Vuoond (fur 20 secunds), Veaekness (fur 20 secunds), Bleedeeng (fur 25 secunds), oor Creeppled (fur 15 secunds). Aeffter maekeeng a Desperaeshun Bloo, yuoo aere-a knucked doon.
323.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Inffleects oone-a ooff zee fullooeeng rundum cundeeshuns: Deep Vuoond (20 secunds), Veaekness (20 secunds), Bleedeeng (25 secunds), oor Creeppled (15 secunds). Yuoo aere-a knucked-doon.

324.name: Threell ooff Feectury
324.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees bloo heets, yuoo deael +20...40 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a Heaelt thun taerget fue-a, yuoo gaeeen 1...2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.
324.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +20...40 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a Heaelt thun yuoor taerget, gaeeen 1...2 aedrenaeleene-a.

325.name: Deestraecteeng Bloo
325.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Sveepe-a yuoor veaepun aet zee taerget, deaeleeng nu daemaege-a boot deesroopteeng zee taerget's coorrent aecshun (und zee aecshuns ooff fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget).
325.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Aelsu aettaecks fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget. Interroopts un aecshun. Heets fur nu daemaege-a.

326.name: Prutectur's Streeke-a
326.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck streekes a mufeeng fue-a, yuoo streeke-a fur 10...40 mure-a daemaege-a.
326.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a iff taerget is mufeeng.

327.name: Greeffffun's Sveep
327.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff thees aettaeck is blucked, yuoor taerget is knucked doon und sooffffers 10...34 daemaege-a.
327.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Cooses knuck-doon und deaels 10...34 daemaege-a iff blucked.

328.name: Poore-a Streeke-a
328.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff Poore-a Streeke-a heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +1...30 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a nut useeng a stunce-a, Poore-a Streeke-a cunnut be-a blucked.
328.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +1...30 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a unless yuoo aere-a in a stunce-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

329.name: Skooll Craeck
329.description: Ileete-a Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck interroopts zee taerget's coorrent aecshun. Iff thaet fue-a vaes caesteeng a spell, thaet fue-a is Daezed fur 15 secunds.
329.concise: Ileete-a Melee-a Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Inffleects Daezed cundeeshun (15 secunds) iff taerget is caesteeng a spell.

330.name: Cyclune-a Aexe-a
330.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Perffurm a speenneeng aexe-a aettaeck streekeeng fur +4...12 daemaege-a tu aell aedjaecent ooppunents.
330.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +4...12 daemaege-a tu aell fues aedjaecent tu yuoo.

331.name: Haemmer Baesh
331.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. Iff Haemmer Baesh heets, yuoor taerget is knucked doon.
331.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Cooses knuck-doon. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a.

332.name: Booll's Streeke-a
332.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a mufeeng fue-a, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...30 daemaege-a, und yuoor taerget is knucked doon.
332.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...30 daemaege-a und cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is mufeeng.

333.name: "I Veell Aefenge-a Yuoo!"
333.description: Shuoot. Fur iaech deaed aelly, yuoo gaeeen 10 secunds ooff +3...7 Heaelt regeneraeshun und yuoor aettaeck speed increaeses by 25%.
333.concise: Shuoot. Yuoo haefe-a +3...7 Heaelt regeneraeshun und aettaeck 25% faester (10 secunds fur iaech deaed aelly).

334.name: Aexe-a Raeke-a
334.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a fue-a sooffffereeng frum a Deep Vuoond, yuoo streeke-a fur +4...16 daemaege-a, und thaet fue-a becumes Creeppled fur 15 secunds.
334.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +4...16 daemaege-a und inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (15 secunds) iff taerget fue-a haes a Deep Vuoond.

335.name: Cleaefe-a
335.description: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a und heet 1...2 aedjaecent fue-as fur 10...40 slaesheeng daemaege-a.
335.concise: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a und heets 1...2 aedjaecent fue-as fur 10...40 slaesheeng daemaege-a.

336.name: Ixecooshuner's Streeke-a
336.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +15...45 daemaege-a.

337.name: Deesmember
337.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aexe-a bloo veell inffleect a Deep Vuoond oon taerget fue-a, looereeng thaet fue-a's maexeemoom Heaelt by 20% fur 5...20 secunds.
337.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

338.name: Ifeesceraete-a
338.description: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff Ifeesceraete-a heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...45 daemaege-a und inffleect a Deep Vuoond, looereeng yuoor taerget's maexeemoom Heaelt by 20% fur 5...20 secunds.
338.concise: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...45 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

339.name: Penetraeteeng Bloo
339.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...25 daemaege-a. Thees aexe-a aettaeck haes 20% aermur penetraeshun.
339.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...25 daemaege-a. 20% aermur penetraeshun.

340.name: Deesroopteeng Chup
340.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck interroopts zee taerget's coorrent aecshun. Iff thaet aecshun vaes a skeell, thaet skeell is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 20 secunds.
340.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: interroopted skeell is deesaebled fur +20 secunds.

341.name: Sveefft Chup
341.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +1...20 daemaege-a. Iff Sveefft Chup is blucked, taerget fue-a taekes 1...20 daemaege-a und sooffffers a Deep Vuoond fur 20 secunds.
341.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +1...20 daemaege-a. Deaels 1...20 daemaege-a und inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (20 secunds) iff blucked.

342.name: Aexe-a Tveest
342.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a fue-a sooffffereeng frum a Deep Vuoond, yuoo streeke-a fur 5...25 mure-a daemaege-a und thaet fue-a sooffffers frum Veaekness fur 20 secunds.
342.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...25 daemaege-a und inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun (20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a haes a Deep Vuoond.

343.name: "Fur Greaet Joosteece-a!"
343.description: Shuoot. Fur 20 secunds, vhenefer yuoo gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a, yuoo gaeeen 100% mure-a.
343.concise: Shuoot. (20 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 100% mure-a aedrenaeleene-a.

344.name: Floorry
344.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5 secunds, yuoor aettaeck raete-a is increaesed by 33%, boot yuoo deael 25% less daemaege-a.
344.concise: Stunce-a. (5 secunds). Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Yuoo du 25% less daemaege-a.

345.name: Deffenseefe-a Stunce-a
345.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...5 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck melee-a und prujecteele-a aettaecks. Vhee Deffenseefe-a Stunce-a inds, yuoo gaeeen oone-a streeke-a ooff aedrenaeleene-a fur iaech melee-a aettaeck skeell yuoo haefe-a (maexeemoom 0...4).
345.concise: Stunce-a. (1...5 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Ind iffffect: gaeeen oone-a aedrenaeleene-a fur iaech melee-a aettaeck skeell yuoo haefe-a (maexeemoom 0...4). Bork! Bork! Bork!

346.name: Frenzy
346.description: Stunce-a. Fur 8 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester boot taeke-a 175...125%daemaege-a.
346.concise: Stunce-a. (8 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Yuoo taeke-a 175...125% daemaege-a.

347.name: Indoore-a Paeeen
347.description: Skeell. Fur 7...18 secunds yuoo haefe-a un aeddeeshunael 90...300 Heaelt.
347.concise: Skeell. (7...18 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +90...300 maexeemoom Heaelt.

348.name: "Vaetch Yuoorselff!"
348.description: Shuoot. Paerty members veetheen iaershut gaeeen +5...25 aermur fur 10 secunds. Thees shuoot inds aeffter 10 incumeeng aettaecks.
348.concise: Shuoot. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut haefe-a +5...25 aermur. Inds aeffter 10 incumeeng aettaecks.

349.name: Spreent
349.description: Stunce-a. Fur 8...14 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester.

350.name: Belly Smaesh
350.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck streekes a fue-a vhu is knucked doon, zee resoolteeng doost cluood veell bleend aedjaecent fues fur 3...7 secunds.
350.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun tu aedjaecent fues (3...7 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is knucked doon.

351.name: Meeghty Bloo
351.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a.

352.name: Croosheeng Bloo
352.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +1...20 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo heet a knucked-doon fue-a yuoo inffleect a Deep Vuoond, looereeng yuoor taerget's maexeemoom Heaelt by 20% fur 5...20 secunds.
352.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +1...20 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun iff taerget fue-a is knucked-doon (5...20 secunds).

353.name: Croode-a Sveeng
353.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Aettaeck aell aedjaecent fues. Iaech fue-a yuoo heet is stroock fur +1...20 daemaege-a.
353.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Aettaeck aell aedjaecent fues fur +1...20 daemaege-a.

354.name: Iaert Shaeker
354.description: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a knucked doon. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Haemmer Maestery 4 oor less.)
354.concise: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Knucks doon taerget und aedjaecent fues. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Haemmer Maestery 5 oor mure-a.

355.name: Defaestaeteeng Haemmer
355.description: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Defaestaeteeng Haemmer heets, yuoor taerget is knucked doon und sooffffers frum Veaekness fur 5...20 secunds.
355.concise: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Cooses knuck-doon. Inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

356.name: Irreseesteeble-a Bloo
356.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff Irreseesteeble-a Bloo is blucked, yuoor taerget is knucked doon und taekes 5...20 daemaege-a.
356.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Deaels 5...20 daemaege-a und cooses knuck-doon iff blucked.

357.name: Cuoonter Bloo
357.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets un aettaeckeeng fue-a, thaet fue-a is knucked doon. Bork! Bork! Bork!
357.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is aettaeckeeng.

358.name: Baeckbreaeker
358.description: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Baeckbreaeker heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +1...20 daemaege-a und yuoor taerget is knucked doon. Iff yuoo haefe-a 8 Strengt oor heegher, thees knuckdoon laests 4 secunds.
358.concise: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +1...20 daemaege-a. Cooses knuckdoon. Knuckdoon laests 4 secunds veet Strengt 8 oor heegher.

359.name: Heaefy Bloo
359.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. Iff thees aettaeck heets a fue-a sooffffereeng frum Veaekness, thaet fue-a is knucked doon und yuoo streeke-a fur +1...30 daemaege-a.
359.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +1...30 daemaege-a und cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is Veaekened. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a.

360.name: Staeggereeng Bloo
360.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees haemmer bloo heets, yuoor taerget veell sooffffer frum Veaekness fur 5...20 secunds.
360.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

361.name: Dulyaek Seegnet
361.description: Seegnet. Fur 8...20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +10...40 aermur und cunnut be-a knucked doon, boot yuoor mufement is slooed by 75%.
361.concise: Seegnet. (8...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +10...40 aermur und cunnut be-a knucked-doon. Yuoo mufe-a 75% slooer.

362.name: Vaerreeur's Coonneeng
362.description: Skeell. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoor melee-a aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked.
362.concise: Skeell. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoor melee-a aettaecks aere-a unbluckaeble-a.

363.name: Sheeeld Baesh
363.description: Skeell. Fur 5...11 secunds, vheele-a veeeldeeng a sheeeld, zee next melee-a aettaeck skeell used aegaeeenst yuoo is blucked, yuoor aettaecker is knucked doon, und thaet skeell is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 15 secunds.
363.concise: Skeell. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo bluck zee next melee-a aettaeck skeell. Cooses knuck-doon und +15 secund rechaerge-a. Nu iffffect unless yuoo aere-a veeeldeeng a sheeeld.

364.name: "Chaerge-a!"
364.description: Ileete-a Shuoot. Aell aelleees veetheen iaershut luse-a zee Creeppled cundeeshun. Fur 5...13 secunds, zeese-a aelleees mufe-a 33% faester.
364.concise: Ileete-a Shuoot. (5...13 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut mufe-a 33% faester. Ineeteeael iffffect: zeese-a aelleees luse-a zee Creeppled cundeeshun.

365.name: "Feectury Is Meene-a!"
365.description: Ileete-a Shuoot. Yuoo gaeeen 10...68 Heaelt und 3...7 Inergy fur iaech cundeeshun sooffffered by taerget fue-a.
365.concise: Ileete-a Shuoot. Yuoo gaeeen 10...68 Heaelt und 3...7 Inergy fur iaech cundeeshun oon taerget fue-a.

366.name: "Feaer Me-a!"
366.description: Shuoot. Aell neaerby fues luse-a 2...6 Inergy. Fur 1...15 secunds, yuoor melee-a aettaecks gaeeen +5...30% chunce-a ooff a creeteecael heet aegaeeenst staeshunaery fues.
366.concise: Shuoot. (1...15 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +5...30% chunce-a ooff a creeteecael heet veet melee-a aettaecks aegaeeenst staeshunaery fues. Ineeteeael iffffect: neaerby fues luse-a 2...6 Inergy.

367.name: "Sheeelds Up!"
367.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo und aell paerty members veetheen iaershut gaeeen +60 aermur aegaeeenst incumeeng prujecteele-a aettaecks.
367.concise: Shuoot. (5...11 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut haefe-a +60 aermur aegaeeenst prujecteele-a aettaecks.

368.name: "I Veell Soorfeefe-a!"
368.description: Shuoot. Yuoo gaeeen +3 Heaelt regeneraeshun fur iaech cundeeshun yuoo aere-a sooffffereeng. Thees regeneraeshun ixpures aeffter 5...11 secunds.
368.concise: Shuoot. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +3 Heaelt regeneraeshun fur iaech cundeeshun oon yuoo.

370.name: Berserker Stunce-a
370.description: Stunce-a. Fur 8...14 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester und gaeeen 100% mure-a aedrenaeleene-a. Berserker Stunce-a inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.
370.concise: Stunce-a. (8...14 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester und gaeeen 100% mure-a aedrenaeleene-a. Inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.

371.name: Baelunced Stunce-a
371.description: Stunce-a. Fur 8...20 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a knucked doon und yuoo du nut sooffffer ixtra daemaege-a frum a creeteecael aettaeck.
371.concise: Stunce-a. (8...20 secunds.) Yuoo cunnut be-a knucked-doon und du nut taeke-a ixtra daemaege-a frum creeteecael heets.

372.name: Glaedeeaetur's Deffense-a
372.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks. Vhenefer yuoo bluck a melee-a aettaeck thees vaey, zee aettaecker sooffffers 5...35 daemaege-a.
372.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Yuoor aettaecker taekes 5...35 daemaege-a vhenefer yuoo bluck a melee-a aettaeck thees vaey.

373.name: Defflect Aerroos
373.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...6 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks. Iff yuoo bluck a prujecteele-a aettaeck, aedjaecent fues sooffffer frum Bleedeeng fur 5...15 secunds.
373.concise: Stunce-a. (1...6 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks. Aedjaecent fues sooffffer Bleedeeng (5...15 secunds) vhee yuoo bluck a prujecteele-a aettaeck.

374.name: Vaerreeur's Indoorunce-a
374.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 5...35 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy iaech teeme-a yuoo heet veet a melee-a aettaeck. Vaerreeur's Indoorunce-a cunnut raeeese-a yuoor Inergy aebufe-a 10...25.
374.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (5...35 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy iaech teeme-a yuoo heet veet a melee-a aettaeck. Nu Inergy gaeeen iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a thun 10...25 Inergy.

375.name: Dvaerfee Baettle-a Stunce-a
375.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, iff yuoo aere-a veeeldeeng a haemmer, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester, yuoo gaeeen +40 aermur, und yuoor aettaeck skeells interroopt fues vhee zeey heet.
375.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester, yuoo gaeeen +40 aermur, und yuoor aettaeck skeells interroopt aecshuns. Nu iffffect unless yuoo haefe-a a haemmer iqooeepped.

376.name: Deesceepleened Stunce-a
376.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...4 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +10 aermur und haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks. Deesceepleened Stunce-a inds iff yuoo use-a un aedrenael skeell.
376.concise: Stunce-a. (1...4 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck und +10 aermur. Inds iff yuoo use-a un aedrenael skeell.

377.name: Vaery Stunce-a
377.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...6 secunds, yuoo bluck uny aettaeck skeells used aegaeeenst yuoo. Fur iaech sooccessffool bluck, yuoo gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a und 5 Inergy. Vaery Stunce-a inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.
377.concise: Stunce-a. (1...6 secunds). Yuoo bluck aettaeck skeells. Gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a und 5 Inergy fur iaech bluck. Inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.

378.name: Sheeeld Stunce-a
378.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...6 secunds, vheele-a useeng a sheeeld, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks, und daemaege-a is redooced by 2 fur iaech runk ooff Strengt (maexeemoom 15 daemaege-a redoocshun).
378.concise: Stunce-a. (1...6 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Daemaege-a is redooced by 2 fur iaech runk ooff Strengt (maexeemoom 15 daemaege-a redoocshun). Nu iffffect unless yuoo haefe-a a sheeeld iqooeepped.

379.name: Booll's Chaerge-a
379.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 1...7 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 50% faester und iff yuoo streeke-a a mufeeng fue-a in melee-a, thaet fue-a is knucked doon. Booll's Chaerge-a inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.
379.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (1...7 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 50% faester. Cooses knuck-doon iff yuoo heet a mufeeng fue-a in melee-a. Inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.

380.name: Bunettee's Deffense-a
380.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck melee-a und prujecteele-a aettaecks. Yuoo gaeeen 5 Inergy fur iaech sooccessffool melee-a aettaeck blucked. Bunettee's Deffense-a inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.
380.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Gaeeen 5 Inergy fur iaech melee-a aettaeck blucked. Inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.

381.name: Hoondred Blaedes
381.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 15 secunds, vhenefer yuoo aettaeck veet a svurd, aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...35 slaesheeng daemaege-a.
381.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (15 secunds.) Deaels 10...35 slaesheeng daemaege-a tu aell aedjaecent fues vhenefer yuoo aettaeck veet a svurd.

382.name: Sefer Aertery
382.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, zee ooppunent begeens Bleedeeng fur 5...25 secunds, luseeng Heaelt oofer teeme-a.
382.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...25 secunds).

383.name: Gaelraet Slaesh
383.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Thees aettaeck streekes fur +1...40 daemaege-a iff it heets.

384.name: Gaesh
384.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a Bleedeeng fue-a, yuoo streeke-a fur 5...20 mure-a daemaege-a und thaet fue-a sooffffers a Deep Vuoond, looereeng thaet fue-a's maexeemoom Heaelt by 20% fur 5...20 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
384.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a und inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) iff yuoor taerget is Bleedeeng.

385.name: Feenael Throost
385.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. Iff Feenael Throost heets, yuoo deael 5...40 mure-a daemaege-a. Thees daemaege-a is duoobled iff yuoor taerget vaes beloo 50% Heaelt.
385.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +5...40 daemaege-a. Deaels +5...40 mure-a daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is beloo 50% Heaelt. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a.

386.name: Seekeeng Blaede-a
386.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets yuoo streeke-a fur +1...20 daemaege-a. Iff Seekeeng Blaede-a is blucked, yuoor taerget begeens Bleedeeng fur 25 secunds und taekes 1...20 daemaege-a.
386.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +1...20 daemaege-a. Deaels 1...20 daemaege-a und inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (25 secunds) iff blucked.

387.name: Reepuste-a
387.description: Skeell. Fur 8 secunds, vheele-a yuoo haefe-a a svurd iqooeepped, yuoo bluck zee next melee-a aettaeck aegaeeenst yuoo und yuoor aettaecker is stroock fur 20...80 daemaege-a.
387.concise: Skeell. (8 secunds.) Yuoo bluck zee next melee-a aettaeck und yuoor aettaecker taekes 20...80 daemaege-a. Nu iffffect unless yuoo haefe-a a svurd iqooeepped.

388.name: Deaedly Reepuste-a
388.description: Skeell. Fur 8 secunds, vheele-a yuoo haefe-a a svurd iqooeepped, yuoo bluck zee next melee-a aettaeck aegaeeenst yuoo, und yuoor aettaecker is stroock fur 15...90 daemaege-a und begeens Bleedeeng fur 3...25 secunds.
388.concise: Skeell. (8 secunds.) Yuoo bluck zee next melee-a aettaeck und yuoor aettaecker taekes 15...90 daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (3...25 secunds). Nu iffffect unless yuoo haefe-a a svurd iqooeepped.

389.name: Fluooreesh
389.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Aell ooff yuoor aettaeck skeells becume-a rechaerged. Yuoo gaeeen 2...7 Inergy fur iaech skeell rechaerged by Fluooreesh.
389.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. Rechaerges yuoor aettaeck skeells. Yuoo gaeeen 2...7 Inergy fur iaech skeell rechaerged.

390.name: Saefaege-a Slaesh
390.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, it interroopts taerget fue-a's aecshun. Iff thaet aecshun vaes a spell, yuoo deael 1...40 ixtra daemaege-a.
390.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: deaels +1...40 daemaege-a iff aecshun vaes a spell.

391.name: Hoonter's Shut
391.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Hoonter's Shut heets, yuoor taerget begeens Bleedeeng fur 3...25 secunds.
391.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (3...25 secunds).

392.name: Peen Doon
392.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Peen Doon heets, yuoor taerget is Creeppled fur 3...15 secunds.
392.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...15 secunds).

393.name: Creeppleeng Shut
393.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Iff Creeppleeng Shut heets, yuoor taerget becumes Creeppled fur 4...14 secunds. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
393.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Unbluckaeble-a. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (4...14 secunds).

394.name: Pooer Shut
394.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Pooer Shut heets, taerget fue-a taekes 25...50 daemaege-a.
394.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Taerget fue-a taekes 25...50 daemaege-a.

395.name: Baerraege-a
395.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Aell yuoor prepaeraeshuns aere-a remufed. Shuut aerroos aet taerget fue-a und up tu 5 fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget. Zeese-a aerroos streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a iff zeey heet. Bork! Bork! Bork!
395.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Heets 5 fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget. Aell yuoor prepaeraeshuns aere-a remufed.

396.name: Dooael Shut
396.description: Boo Aettaeck. Shuut tvu aerroos seemooltuneuoosly aet taerget fue-a. Zeese-a aerroos deael 25% less daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
396.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Yuoo shuut tvu aerroos seemooltuneuoosly aet taerget fue-a. Zeese-a aerroos deael 25% less daemaege-a.

397.name: Qooeeck Shut
397.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Shuut un aerroo thaet mufes tveece-a aes faest.
397.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Yuoo shuut un aerroo thaet mufes tveece-a aes faest.

398.name: Penetraeteeng Aettaeck
398.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Penetraeteeng Aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...25 daemaege-a und thees aettaeck haes 10% aermur penetraeshun.
398.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...25 daemaege-a. 10% aermur penetraeshun. Bork! Bork! Bork!

399.name: Deestraecteeng Shut
399.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Deestraecteeng Shut heets, it interroopts taerget fue-a's aecshun boot deaels oonly 1...16 daemaege-a. Iff zee interroopted aecshun vaes a skeell, thaet skeell is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 20 secunds.
399.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: interroopted skeell is deesaebled fur +20 secunds. Heets fur oonly 1...16 daemaege-a.

400.name: Preceeseeun Shut
400.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Preceeseeun Shut heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +3...10 daemaege-a. Preceeseeun Shut cunnut be-a blucked. Thees aecshun is iaeseely interroopted.
400.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +3...10 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Iaeseely interroopted.

402.name: Determeened Shut
402.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Determeened Shut heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff Determeened Shut faeeels tu heet, aell ooff yuoor aettaeck skeells aere-a rechaerged.
402.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Rechaerges yuoor aettaeck skeells iff it faeeels tu heet.

403.name: Caelled Shut
403.description: Boo Aettaeck. Shuut un aerroo thaet mufes 3 teemes faester und cunnut be-a blucked. Bork! Bork! Bork!
403.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Yuoo shuut un aerroo thaet mufes 3 teemes faester. Unbluckaeble-a.

404.name: Pueesun Aerroo
404.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Iff Pueesun Aerroo heets, yuoor taerget becumes Pueesuned fur 5...20 secunds.
404.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

405.name: Ooaet Shut
405.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Iff Ooaet Shut heets, aell ooff yuoor skeells ixcept Ooaet Shut aere-a rechaerged. Iff it meesses, aell ooff yuoor skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 10...4 secunds. (50% meess chunce-a veet Ixperteese-a 7 oor less.)
405.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Rechaerges aell skeells ixcept Ooaet Shut iff it heets. Deesaebles aell skeells iff it meesses (10...4 secunds). 50% meess chunce-a unless Ixperteese-a 8 oor heegher.

406.name: Debeeleetaeteeng Shut
406.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Debeeleetaeteeng Shut heets, yuoor taerget luses 1...10 Inergy.

407.name: Pueent Blunk Shut
407.description: Boo Aettaeck. Shuut un aerroo thaet haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a, boot streekes fur +10...40 daemaege-a.
407.concise: Haelff Runge-a Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a.

408.name: Cuncoosseeun Shut
408.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Cuncoosseeun Shut heets vheele-a taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell, zee spell is interroopted und yuoor taerget is Daezed fur 5...20 secunds. Thees aettaeck deaels oonly 1...16 daemaege-a.
408.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Interroopts a spell. Interroopshun iffffect: inffleects Daezed cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Heets fur oonly 1...16 daemaege-a.

409.name: Pooneesheeng Shut
409.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Iff Pooneesheeng Shut heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...20 daemaege-a und yuoor taerget is interroopted.
409.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +10...20 daemaege-a. Interroopts un aecshun.

411.name: Chaerm Uneemael
411.description: Skeell. Chaerm taerget uneemael. Oonce-a chaermed, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun veell traefel veet yuoo vhenefer yuoo haefe-a Chaerm Uneemael iqooeepped. Yuoo cunnut chaerm un uneemael thaet is mure-a thun 4 lefels aebufe-a yuoo.
411.concise: Skeell. Chaerm taerget uneemael. Oonce-a chaermed, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun veell traefel veet yuoo vhenefer yuoo haefe-a Chaerm Uneemael iqooeepped. Yuoo cunnut chaerm un uneemael thaet is mure-a thun 4 lefels aebufe-a yuoo.

412.name: Caell ooff Prutecshun
412.description: Shuoot. Fur 120 secunds, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun haes a 5...20 baese-a daemaege-a redoocshun.
412.concise: Shuoot. (120 secunds.) Yuoor pet haes 5...20 daemaege-a redoocshun.

415.name: Caell ooff Haeste-a
415.description: Shuoot. Fur 30 secunds, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun haes a 33% faester aettaeck speed und mufes 33% faester.
415.concise: Shuoot. (30 secunds.) Yuoor pet mufes und aettaecks 33% faester.

422.name: Refeefe-a Uneemael
422.description: Skeell. Resoorrect aell aelleeed uneemael cumpuneeuns in zee aerea. Zeey cume-a baeck tu leeffe-a veet 10...94% Heaelt.
422.concise: Skeell. Resoorrects aell aelleeed pets in zee aerea (10...94% Heaelt). Bork! Bork! Bork!

423.name: Symbeeuteec Bund
423.description: Shuoot. Fur 120...300 secunds, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun gaeeens 1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun, und haelff ooff aell daemaege-a deaelt tu yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun is redurected tu yuoo.
423.concise: Shuoot. (120...300 secunds.) Yuoor pet haes +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Haelff ooff aell daemaege-a deaelt tu yuoor pet is redurected tu yuoo.

424.name: Throo Durt
424.description: Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a und fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget becume-a Bleended fur 3...15 secunds.
424.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (3...15 secunds). Aelsu aeffffects fues aedjaecent tu taerget fue-a.

425.name: Dudge-a
425.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a a 27...75% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng prujecteeles. Dudge-a inds iff yuoo aettaeck.
425.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a 27...75% chunce-a tu bluck prujecteele-a aettaecks. Inds iff yuoo aettaeck.

426.name: Saefaege-a Shut
426.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Saefaege-a Shut heets, yuoor taerget's aecshun is interroopted. Iff thaet aecshun vaes a spell, yuoo streeke-a fur +13...28 daemaege-a.
426.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: deaels +13...28 daemaege-a iff aecshun vaes a spell.

427.name: Unteedute-a Seegnet
427.description: Seegnet. Cleunse-a yuoorselff ooff Pueesun, Deeseaese-a, Bleendness, und oone-a aeddeeshunael cundeeshun.
427.concise: Seegnet. Remufe-a Pueesun, Deeseaese-a, Bleendness, und oone-a aeddeeshunael cundeeshun frum yuoorselff.

428.name: Incendeeaery Aerroos
428.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Shuut aerroos aet taerget fue-a und up tu 2 fue-as neaer yuoor taerget. Thuse-a fues aere-a set oon fure-a fur 1...3 secunds.
428.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Heets 2 fue-as neaer yuoor taerget und inffleects Boorneeng (1...3 secunds).

429.name: Melundroo's Aerroos
429.description: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. Fur 18 secunds, vhenefer yuoor aerroos heet, zeey coose-a Bleedeeng fur 3...25 secunds, und iff zeey heet a taerget vhu is under un inchuntment, zeey du +8...28 daemaege-a.
429.concise: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. (18 secunds.) Yuoor aerroos inffleect Bleedeeng cundeeshun (3...25 secunds) und deael +8...28 daemaege-a tu inchunted fues.

430.name: Maerksmun's Vaeger
430.description: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. Fur 18 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 5...10 Inergy vhenefer yuoor aerroos heet, boot luse-a 10 Inergy vhenefer yuoor aerroos faeeel tu streeke-a.
430.concise: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. (18 secunds.) Gaeeen 5...10 Inergy vhenefer yuoor aerroos heet. Luse-a 10 Inergy vhenefer yuoo faeeel tu heet.

431.name: Igneete-a Aerroos
431.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 24 secunds, yuoor aerroos ixplude-a oon cuntaect, deaeleeng 3...18 fure-a daemaege-a tu taerget und aell aedjaecent fues.
431.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (24 secunds.) Yuoor aerroos deael 3...18 fure-a daemaege-a tu taerget und fues aedjaecent tu taerget.

432.name: Reaed zee Veend
432.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 24 secunds, yuoor aerroos mufe-a tveece-a aes faest und deael 3...10 ixtra daemaege-a.
432.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (24 secunds.) +3...10 daemaege-a. Yuoor aerroos mufe-a tveece-a aes faest.

433.name: Keendle-a Aerroos
433.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 24 secunds, yuoor aerroos deael fure-a daemaege-a und heet fur un aeddeeshunael 3...24 fure-a daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
433.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (24 secunds.) +3...24 fure-a daemaege-a. Yuoor aerroos deael fure-a daemaege-a.

434.name: Chukeeng Gaes
434.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 1...12 secunds, yuoor aerroos deael 1...8 mure-a daemaege-a und spreaed Chukeeng Gaes tu aell aedjaecent fues oon impaect. Chukeeng Gaes interroopts fues aettempteeng tu caest spells.
434.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (1...12 secunds.) +1...8 daemaege-a. Spreaeds Chukeeng Gaes tu fues aedjaecent tu taerget. Chukeeng Gaes interroopts spells.

435.name: Aepply Pueesun
435.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 24 secunds, fues stroock by yuoor physeecael aettaecks becume-a Pueesuned fur 3...15 secunds.
435.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (24 secunds.) Yuoor physeecael aettaecks inffleect Pueesuned cundeeshun (3...15 secunds).

436.name: Cumffurt Uneemael
436.description: Skeell. Yuoo heael yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun fur 40...120 Heaelt. Iff yuoor cumpuneeun is deaed, it is resoorrected veet 10...58% Heaelt. Iff yuoo haefe-a Cumffurt Uneemael iqooeepped, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun veell traefel veet yuoo.
436.concise: Skeell. Yuoor pet gaeeens 40...120 Heaelt. Resoorrects yuoor pet (10...58% Heaelt). Iff yuoo haefe-a Cumffurt Uneemael iqooeepped, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun veell traefel veet yuoo.

437.name: Besteeael Puoonce-a
437.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Besteeael Puoonce-a thaet deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff zee aettaeck streekes a fue-a vhu is caesteeng a spell, thaet fue-a is knucked doon.
437.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell.

438.name: Maeeemeeng Streeke-a
438.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Maeeemeeng Streeke-a thaet deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff thaet aettaeck heets thaet fue-a becumes Creeppled fur 3...15 secunds.
438.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...15 secunds) oon heet.

439.name: Ferael Loonge-a
439.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Ferael Loonge-a thaet deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Iff zee aettaeck streekes a fue-a vhu is aettaeckeeng, thaet fue-a sooffffers frum Bleedeeng fur 5...25 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
439.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun iff taerget fue-a is aettaeckeeng (5...25 secunds).

440.name: Scaefenger Streeke-a
440.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Scaefenger Streeke-a thaet deaels +10...25 daemaege-a. Iff zee aettaeck streekes a fue-a vhu is sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun, yuoo gaeeen 3...15 Inergy.
440.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +10...25 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 3...15 Inergy iff taerget fue-a haes a cundeeshun.

441.name: Melundroo's Aessoolt
441.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Melundroo's Aessoolt thaet deaels +5...20 daemaege-a tu aell neaerby fues.
441.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a tu neaerby fues.

442.name: Feruceeuoos Streeke-a
442.description: Ileete-a Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Feruceeuoos Streeke-a thaet deaels +13...28 daemaege-a. Iff thaet aettaeck heets, yuoo gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a und 3...10 Inergy.
442.concise: Ileete-a Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +13...28 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a und 3...10 Inergy.

443.name: Predaetur's Puoonce-a
443.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Predaetur's Puoonce-a thaet deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Iff thaet aettaeck heets, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun gaeeens 5...50 Heaelt.
443.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Yuoor pet gaeeens 5...50 Heaelt iff thees aettaeck heets.

444.name: Brootael Streeke-a
444.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Brootael Streeke-a thaet deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Iff thaet aettaeck streekes a fue-a vhuse-a Heaelt is beloo 50%, thaet fue-a taekes un aeddeeshunael +5...35 daemaege-a.
444.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Deaels +5...35 mure-a daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is under 50% Heaelt.

445.name: Deesroopteeng Loonge-a
445.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Deesroopteeng Loonge-a thaet deaels +1...12 daemaege-a. Iff thaet aettaeck streekes a fue-a useeng a skeell thaet skeell is interroopted und is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 20 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
445.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +1...12 daemaege-a. Interroopts a skeell. Interroopshun iffffect: interroopted skeell is deesaebled fur +20 secunds.

446.name: Trull Ungooent
446.description: Skeell. Fur 13 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +3...10 Heaelt regeneraeshun.
446.concise: Skeell. (13 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +3...10 Heaelt regeneraeshun.

447.name: Ootyoogh's Cry
447.description: Shuoot. Fur 10...25 secunds, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun gaeeens +24 aermur und cunnut be-a blucked. Bork! Bork! Bork!
447.concise: Shuoot. (10...25 secunds.) Yuoor pet haes +24 aermur und is unbluckaeble-a.

448.name: Iscaepe-a
448.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 1...8 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks.
448.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (1...8 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck.

449.name: Praecteeced Stunce-a
449.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 20...35 secunds, yuoor prepaeraeshuns rechaerge-a 50% faester und laest 30...300% lunger.
449.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (20...35 secunds.) Yuoor prepaeraeshuns rechaerge-a 50% faester und laest 30...300% lunger.

450.name: Vhurleeng Deffense-a
450.description: Stunce-a. Fur 8...20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks. Vhenefer yuoo bluck a prujecteele-a in thees vaey, aedjaecent fues taeke-a 5...11 daemaege-a.
450.concise: Stunce-a. (8...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Deaels 5...11 daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues vhenefer yuoo bluck a prujecteele-a aettaeck.

451.name: Melundroo's Reseeleeence-a
451.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 8...20 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +4 Heaelt regeneraeshun und +1 Inergy regeneraeshun fur iaech cundeeshun und hex yuoo aere-a sooffffereeng.
451.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (8...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +4 Heaelt regeneraeshun und +1 Inergy regeneraeshun fur iaech cundeeshun und hex oon yuoo.

452.name: Dryder's Deffenses
452.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks und 34...60 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
452.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck und +34...60 aermur aegaeeenst ilementael daemaege-a.

453.name: Leeghtneeng Refflexes
453.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck melee-a und prujecteele-a aettaecks, und yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Bork! Bork! Bork!
453.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester und haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck.

454.name: Teeger's Foory
454.description: Stunce-a. Aell yuoor nun-aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 5 secunds. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 25% faester.
454.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 25% faester. Deesaebles yuoor nun-aettaeck skeells (5 secunds).

455.name: Sturm Chaeser
455.description: Stunce-a. Fur 8...20 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester, und yuoo gaeeen 1...5 Inergy vhenefer yuoo taeke-a ilementael daemaege-a.
455.concise: Stunce-a. (8...20 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 25% faester und gaeeen 1...5 Inergy vhenefer yuoo taeke-a ilementael daemaege-a.

456.name: Serpent's Qooeeckness
456.description: Stunce-a. Fur 15...30 secunds, rechaerge-a teemes fur yuoor skeells aere-a redooced by 33%. Serpent's Qooeeckness inds iff yuoor Heaelt drups beloo 50%.
456.concise: Stunce-a. (15...30 secunds.) Yuoor skeells rechaerge-a 33% faester. Inds iff yuoor Heaelt drups beloo 50%.

457.name: Doost Traep
457.description: Traep. Vhee Doost Traep is treeggered, ifery secund (fur 5 secunds tutael), aell neaerby fues aere-a Bleended fur 3...8 secunds und taeke-a 10...25 daemaege-a. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted. Doost Traep inds aeffter 90 secunds.
457.concise: Traep. (90 secunds.) Aeffffects neaerby fues. Deaels 10...25 daemaege-a ifery secund (5 secunds). Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (3...8 secunds) ifery secund (5 secunds). Iaeseely interroopted.

458.name: Baerbed Traep
458.description: Traep. Vhee Baerbed Traep is treeggered, aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 7...23 peeerceeng daemaege-a, becume-a Creeppled, und begeen Bleedeeng fur 3...25 secunds. Baerbed Traep inds aeffter 90 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
458.concise: Traep. (90 secunds.) Aeffffects neaerby fues. Deaels 7...23 peeerceeng daemaege-a. Inffleects Creeppled und Bleedeeng cundeeshuns (3...25 secunds). Iaeseely interroopted.

459.name: Flaeme-a Traep
459.description: Traep. Vhee Flaeme-a Traep is treeggered, ifery secund (fur 3 secunds tutael), aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 5...20 fure-a daemaege-a und set oon fure-a fur 1...3 secunds. Flaeme-a Traep inds aeffter 90 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
459.concise: Traep. (90 secunds.) Aeffffects neaerby fues. Deaels 5...20 fure-a daemaege-a ifery secund (3 secunds). Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...3 secunds). Iaeseely interroopted.

460.name: Heaeleeng Spreeng
460.description: Traep. Fur 10 secunds, aell aedjaecent aelleees aere-a heaeled fur 15...60 ifery 2 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
460.concise: Traep. (10 secunds.) Aeffffects aedjaecent aelleees. Heaels fur 15...60 ifery 2 secunds. Iaeseely interroopted.

461.name: Speeke-a Traep
461.description: Ileete-a Traep. Vhee Speeke-a Traep is treeggered, ifery secund (fur 2 secunds tutael), aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 10...40 peeerceeng daemaege-a, becume-a Creeppled fur 3...25 secunds, und aere-a knucked doon. Speeke-a Traep inds aeffter 90 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
461.concise: Ileete-a Traep. (90 secunds.) Aeffffects neaerby fues. Ifery secund (fur 2 secunds), thees traep deaels 10...40 peeerceeng daemaege-a, cooses knuck-doon, und inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...25 secunds). Iaeseely interroopted.

462.name: Veenter
462.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Fur creaetoores veetheen its runge-a, aell ilementael daemaege-a is culd daemaege-a insteaed. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
462.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Cunferts ilementael daemaege-a tu culd daemaege-a fur creaetoores in runge-a. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

463.name: Veennooeeng
463.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Nun-spureet creaetoores veetheen runge-a taeke-a 4 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a vhenefer zeey taeke-a physeecael daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
463.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Increaese-a physeecael daemaege-a by +4 fur creaetoores in runge-a. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

464.name: Idge-a ooff Ixteencshun
464.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Iff a nun-spureet creaetoore-a veetheen runge-a deees, Idge-a ooff Ixteencshun deaels 14...50 daemaege-a tu aell creaetoores ooff zee saeme-a type-a thaet aere-a beloo 90% Heaelt und veetheen runge-a ooff zee spureet. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
464.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Deaels 14...50 daemaege-a tu creaetoores in its runge-a vhenefer a creaetoore-a ooff zee saeme-a type-a deees. Dues nut aeffffect spureets. Nu daemaege-a tu creaetoores aebufe-a 90% Heaelt.

465.name: Greaeter Cunfflaegraeshun
465.description: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Fur nun-spureet creaetoores veetheen its runge-a, aell physeecael daemaege-a is fure-a daemaege-a insteaed. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
465.concise: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Cunferts physeecael daemaege-a tu fure-a daemaege-a fur creaetoores in runge-a. Dues nut aeffffect spureets. Bork! Bork! Bork!

466.name: Cunfflaegraeshun
466.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Fur nun-spureet creaetoores veetheen its runge-a, aell aerroos thaet heet streeke-a fur fure-a daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
466.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Aell aerroos deael fure-a daemaege-a fur creaetoores in runge-a. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

467.name: Ferteele-a Seaesun
467.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Nun-spureet creaetoores veetheen runge-a haefe-a +50...150 maexeemoom Heaelt und gaeeen +8 aermur. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...90 secunds.
467.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (15...90 secund leeffespun). Creaetoores in runge-a haefe-a +50...150 maexeemoom Heaelt und +8 aermur. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

468.name: Symbeeusees
468.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Fur iaech inchuntment oon a nun-spureet creaetoore-a veetheen runge-a, thaet creaetoore-a haes +27...150 maexeemoom Heaelt. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
468.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Creaetoores in runge-a haefe-a +27...150 maexeemoom Heaelt fur iaech inchuntment oon zeem. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

469.name: Preemael Ichues

570.name: Maerk ooff Insecooreety
570.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...25 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers frum -1...5 Heaelt degeneraeshun, und inchuntments und stunces oon thaet fue-a ixpure-a 20...60% faester. Aell ooff yuoor nun-Aessaesseen skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 5 secunds.

571.name: Deesroopteeng Daegger

572.description: Stunce-a. Aell ooff yuoor aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 10 secunds. Fur 5...15 secunds, yuoor Aessaesseen skeells aecteefaete-a und rechaerge-a 33% faester.

763.description: Inchuntment Spell. Remufe-a un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Iff un inchuntment is remufed, fur zee next 1...20 secunds, yuoor next inchuntment spell caests 0...1 secunds faester und custs 1...10 less Inergy.
763.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Remufes un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffect: yuoor next inchuntment caests 0...1 secunds faester und custs 1...10 less Inergy. (1...20 secunds)

764.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 2...6 secunds, aell ooff taerget fue-a's aettreebootes aere-a set tu 0.
764.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (2...6 secunds.) Taerget fue-a's aettreebootes aere-a 0.

766.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a haes mure-a thun 50% Heaelt, thaet fue-a luses aell inchuntments.

769.description: Spell. Aell aedjaecent fues aere-a Pueesuned fur 5...20 secunds. Shaedoo Step tu a neaerby lucaeshun durectly aevaey frum yuoor taerget.
769.concise: Spell. Inffleect Pueesuned cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) oon aell aedjaecent fues und Shaedoo Step tu a neaerby lucaeshun durectly aevaey frum yuoor taerget. Bork! Bork! Bork!

771.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Vhee yuoo caest Oora ooff Deesplaecement, Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Vhee yuoo stup maeeentaeeeneeng Oora ooff Deesplaecement yuoo retoorn tu yuoor ooreegeenael lucaeshun. Bork! Bork! Bork!

804.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (1...10 secunds.) Taerget fue-a's spells coose-a 10 Oofercaest.

805.concise: Spell. Creaetes a lefel 1...17 faempureec hurrur. Yuoo gaeeen Heaelt iqooael tu zee daemaege-a it deaels. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a.

806.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5 secunds ploos 3 secunds mure-a fur ifery runk ooff Suool Reaepeeng.) Yuoor Necrumuncer spells cust 1...6 less Inergy. Yuoo sooffffer frum Bleedeeng (10 secunds) iaech teeme-a yuoo caest a Necrumuncer spell.

808.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (30 secunds.) Cooses -1...5 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Yuoo gaeeen 5...15 Inergy iff taerget fue-a deees vheele-a sooffffereeng frum thees hex.

809.name: Shaetterstune-a

809.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (3 secunds.) Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 25...100 culd daemaege-a und taerget mufes 66% slooer. Ind iffffect: deaels 25...100 culd daemaege-a tu taerget und aell neaerby fues.

810.concise: Skeell. (5...11 secunds.) Aelleees aedjaecent tu yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Inds iff yuoo mufe-a.

811.name: Roon aes Oone-a
811.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...15 secunds, yuoo und yuoor pet roon 25% faester.
811.concise: Stunce-a. (5...15 secunds.) Yuoo und yuoor pet mufe-a 25% faester.

812.name: Deffeeunt Vaes Xeenraee-a
812.description: Ileete-a Item Spell. Huld Xeenraee-a's aeshes fur up tu 15...60 secunds. Vheele-a yuoo huld her aeshes, yuoo cunnut luse-a mure-a thun 20% ooff yuoor maex Heaelt frum a seengle-a heet. Vhee yuoo drup her aeshes, yuoo steael 5...50 Heaelt frum aell neaerby fues.
812.concise: Ileete-a Item Spell. (15...60 secunds.) Yuoo cunnut luse-a mure-a thun 20% ooff yuoor maex Heaelt frum a seengle-a heet. Drup iffffect: steael 5...50 Heaelt frum neaerby fues.

813.name: Lyssa's Oora
813.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +0...5 Inergy regeneraeshun. Thees inchuntment reaeppleees itselff ifery teeme-a yuoo caest a spell oon a fue-a.
813.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +0...5 Inergy regeneraeshun. Renooael: ifery teeme-a yuoo caest a spell oon un inemy.

814.name: Shaedoo Reffooge-a
814.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 6 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 5...10 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Vhee Shaedoo Reffooge-a inds, yuoo gaeeen 40...100 Heaelt iff yuoo aere-a aettaeckeeng.
814.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (6 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +5...10 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Ind iffffect: heaels yuoo fur 40...100 iff yuoo aere-a aettaeckeeng.

815.name: Scurpeeun Vure-a
815.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8...20 secunds, zee next teeme-a yuoo und taerget fue-a aere-a mure-a thun 75' aepaert, yuoo Shaedoo Step tu thaet fue-a und thaet fue-a is knucked doon. Thees spell haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a.
815.concise: Haelff Runge-a Hex Spell. (8...20 secunds.) Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a und coose-a knuck-doon zee next teeme-a thees fue-a is mure-a thun 75' aevaey frum yuoo.

816.name: Murrured Stunce-a
816.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10...35 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a inters a stunce-a, yuoo inter zee saeme-a stunce-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
816.concise: Hex Spell. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoo inter uny stunce-a used by taerget fue-a.

817.name: Deescurd
817.description: Ileete-a Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun und under zee iffffects ooff a hex oor un inchuntment, thaet fue-a sooffffers 30...110 daemaege-a.
817.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 30...110 daemaege-a. Nu iffffect unless taerget fue-a haes a cundeeshun und is ieezeer hexed oor inchunted.

818.name: Vell ooff Veaereeness
818.description: Vell Spell. Ixplueet taerget curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 66% heaelt tu creaete-a a Vell ooff Veaereeness fur 10...55 secunds. Inemeees veetheen zee Vell ooff Veaereeness sooffffer -1 Inergy degeneraeshun.
818.concise: Vell Spell. (10...55 secunds.) Fues in thees vell haefe-a -1 Inergy degeneraeshun. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a oor saecreeffeeces 66% heaelt.

819.name: Faempureec Spureet
819.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Steael up tu 15...60 Heaelt frum taerget fue-a. Fur 10 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +5...10 Heaelt regeneraeshun.
819.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Steael 15...60 Heaelt frum taerget fue-a. Yuoo haefe-a +5...10 Heaelt regeneraeshun (10 secunds).

820.name: Depraefeety
820.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a caests a spell, thaet fue-a und oone-a neaerby fue-a luse-a 1...5 Inergy.
820.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Cooses 1...5 Inergy luss vhenefer taerget fue-a caests a spell. Oone-a fue-a neaer yuoor taerget aelsu luses Inergy.

821.name: Icy Feeens
821.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 10...90 culd daemaege-a. Fur 10...35 secunds, iff taerget fue-a deees aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 20...110 culd daemaege-a.
821.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (10...35 secunds.) Deaels 20...110 culd daemaege-a tu neaerby fues iff taerget fue-a deees. Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 10...90 culd daemaege-a.

822.name: Veaekee Knees
822.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 1...16 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun und taekes 5...20 daemaege-a vheele-a mufeeng.
822.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (1...16 secunds.) Taerget fue-a haes -1...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun und taekes 5...20 daemaege-a vheele-a mufeeng.

823.name: Boorneeng Speed
823.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 7 secunds, yuoo aere-a set oon fure-a und mufe-a 30...45% faester. Vhee Boorneeng Speed inds, aell aedjaecent fues aere-a set oon fure-a fur 3...9 secunds.
823.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (7 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 30...45% faester. Yuoo sooffffer frum Boorneeng (7 secunds). Ind iffffect: inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (3...9 secunds) oon aedjaecent fues.

824.name: Laefa Aerroos
824.description: Spell. Laefa Aerroos fly tooaerd up tu 3 fues neaer yuoor taerget und streeke-a fur 20...65 fure-a daemaege-a iff zeey heet.
824.concise: Spell. Prujecteele-a: deaels 20...65 fure-a daemaege-a. Bunoos iffffect: sends prujecteeles aet 2 oozeer fues neaer yuoor taerget.

825.name: Bed ooff Cuaels
825.description: Spell. Creaete-a a Bed ooff Cuaels aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur 5 secunds, fues aedjaecent tu taerget fue-a aere-a stroock fur 5...29 fure-a daemaege-a iaech secund. Uny fue-a knucked doon oon zee Bed ooff Cuaels is set oon fure-a fur 3...7 secunds.
825.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...29 fure-a daemaege-a iaech secund (5 secunds) tu lucaeshun ooff taerget fue-a. Heets fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget. Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (3...7 secunds) oon knucked doon fues.

826.name: Shaedoo Furm
826.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...21 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a zee taerget ooff inemy spells, und yuoo gaeeen 5 daemaege-a redoocshun fur iaech Aessaesseen inchuntment oon yuoo. Yuoo cunnut deael mure-a thun 5...25 daemaege-a veet a seengle-a skeell oor aettaeck. Bork! Bork! Bork!
826.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5...21 secunds.) Inemy spells cunnut taerget yuoo. Gaeeen 5 daemaege-a redoocshun fur iaech Aessaesseen inchuntment oon yuoo. Yuoo cunnut deael mure-a thun 5...25 daemaege-a veet a seengle-a skeell oor aettaeck.

827.name: Seephun Strengt
827.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a deaels -5...50 daemaege-a veet aettaecks und aell ooff yuoor aettaecks aegaeeenst thaet fue-a haefe-a un aeddeeshunael 50% chunce-a ooff beeeng a creeteecael heet.
827.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget fue-a deaels -5...50 aettaeck daemaege-a. Yuoo haefe-a +50% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet oon thees fue-a.

828.name: Feele-a Meeaesma
828.description: Hex Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 10...65 culd daemaege-a. Iff sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun, thaet fue-a is hexed veet Feele-a Meeaesma und sooffffers -1...5 Heaelt degeneraeshun fur 10 secunds.
828.concise: Hex Spell. Cooses -1...5 Heaelt degeneraeshun (10 secunds). Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 10...65 culd daemaege-a. Hex is oonly aeppleeed iff taerget fue-a haes a cundeeshun.

830.name: Raey ooff Joodgment
830.description: Ileete-a Spell. Infuke-a a Raey ooff Joodgment aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur 5 secunds, fues aedjaecent tu thaet lucaeshun aere-a stroock fur 10...50 huly daemaege-a und begeen Boorneeng fur 1...3 secunds ifery secund.
830.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 10...50 huly daemaege-a und inffleects Boorneeng (1...3 secunds) ifery secund (5 secunds). Heets fues aedjaecent tu taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun.

831.name: Preemael Raege-a
831.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 1...9 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester und mufe-a 33% faester, boot yuoo taeke-a 150...125% daemaege-a.
831.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (1...9 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester und mufe-a 33% faester. Yuoo taeke-a 150...125% daemaege-a.

832.name: Uneemaete-a Flesh Gulem
832.description: Ileete-a Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a tu uneemaete-a a lefel 3...25 Flesh Gulem. Zee Flesh Gulem leaefes 1...4 ixplueetaeble-a curpse-as. Yuoo cun haefe-a oonly oone-a Flesh Gulem aet a teeme-a.
832.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Creaetes a lefel 3...25 flesh gulem vheech leaefes 1...4 fresh curpse-as vhee it deees. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a. Yuoo cun haefe-a oonly oone-a flesh gulem aet a teeme-a.

834.name: Reckless Haeste-a
834.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6...12 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a hexed veet Reckless Haeste-a. Vheele-a hexed, zeey aettaeck 25% faester boot haefe-a a 50% chunce-a tu meess veet aettaecks.
834.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget (6...12 secunds). Zeese-a fues haefe-a 50% chunce-a tu meess, boot aettaeck 25% faester.

835.name: Bluud Bund
835.description: Hex Spell. Fur 3...12 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a hexed veet Bluud Bund. Vhenefer un aelly heets oone-a ooff zeem veet un aettaeck, thaet aelly gaeeens 5...20 Heaelt. Iff oone-a ooff zeese-a fues deees vheele-a hexed, aell aelleees aedjaecent tu thaet fue-a aere-a heaeled fur 20...100 Heaelt.
835.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget (3...12 secunds). Aelleees heetteeng zeese-a fues gaeeen 5...20 Heaelt. Iff uny ooff zeese-a fues deees vheele-a hexed, aedjaecent aelleees aere-a heaeled fur 20...100.

836.name: Reede-a zee Leeghtneeng
836.description: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo Reede-a zee Leeghtneeng tu taerget. Aell aedjaecent fues aere-a Bleended fur 1...5 secunds. Iff yuoor taerget is a fue-a, it is stroock fur 10...70 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Thees spell haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
836.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 10...70 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. 25% aermur penetraeshun. Bleends aell aedjaecent fues (1...5 secunds). Yuoo instuntly mufe-a tu yuoor taerget. Maey taerget aelleees.

837.name: Inergy Buun
837.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 36...60 secunds, Inergy Buun raeeeses zee maexeemoom Heaelt ooff yuoo und taerget aelly by 1...3 fur iaech pueent ooff yuoor respecteefe-a maexeemoom Inergy. Vhee thees inchuntment is furst aeppleeed, yuoo und yuoor taerget gaeeen 1...12 Inergy. Yuoo gaeeen un aeddeeshunael 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 pueents yuoo haefe-a in Inergy Sturaege-a.
837.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (36...60 secunds.) Maexeemoom Heaelt fur yuoo und taerget aelly is increaesed by 1...3 fur iaech pueent ooff maexeemoom Inergy. Ineeteeael iffffect: But gaeeen 1...12 Inergy. Yuoo gaeeen +1 Inergy fur ifery 2 pueents ooff Inergy Sturaege-a.

838.name: Dvaeyna's Surroo
838.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, taerget aelly und aell neaerby aelleees aere-a inchunted veet Dvaeyna's Surroo. Iff un aelly deees vheele-a under zee iffffects ooff Dvaeyna's Surroo, yuoor paerty is heaeled fur 5...50.
838.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Inchunts aelleees neaer yuoor taerget (30 secunds). Yuoor paerty is heaeled fur 5...50 vhenefer oone-a ooff zeese-a aelleees deees.

839.name: "Retreaet!"
839.description: Shuoot. Iff zeere-a aere-a uny deaed aelleees veetheen iaershut, yuoor paerty mufes 33% faester fur 5...11 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
839.concise: Shuoot. (5...11 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut mufe-a 33% faester. Nu iffffect unless zeere-a aere-a deaed aelleees veetheen iaershut.

840.name: Pueesuned Heaert
840.description: Spell. Yuoo und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a Pueesuned fur 5...15 secunds.
840.concise: Spell. Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (5...15 secunds) tu aedjaecent fues. Yuoo aere-a aelsu Pueesuned.

841.name: Feteed Gruoond
841.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 15...65 culd daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is knucked doon, thaet fue-a becumes Pueesuned fur 5...20 secunds.
841.concise: Spell. Deaels 15...65 culd daemaege-a. Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is knucked-doon.

842.name: Aerc Leeghtneeng
842.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 5...40 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, tvu fues neaer yuoor taerget aere-a stroock fur 15...85 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Daemaege-a frum Aerc Leeghtneeng haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
842.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...40 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Deaels 15...85 leeghtneeng daemaege-a tu tvu neaerby fues iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest. 25% aermur penetraeshun.

843.name: Goost
843.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...11 secunds, but yuoo und taerget aelly mufe-a 33% faester. Vhee yuoo caest thees spell, aell fues aedjaecent tu yuoo und yuoor taerget taeke-a 15...70 culd daemaege-a. Fues stroock by Goost vheele-a aettaeckeeng oor mufeeng aere-a knucked doon.
843.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo und taerget aelly mufe-a 33% faester. Ineeteeael iffffect: Fues aedjaecent tu yuoo und taerget aelly aere-a stroock fur 15...70 culd daemaege-a. Aettaeckeeng oor mufeeng fues aere-a knucked doon.

844.name: Choorneeng Iaert
844.description: Spell. Creaete-a Choorneeng Iaert aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur zee next 5 secunds, Choorneeng Iaert streekes fues neaer thaet lucaeshun fur 10...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund. Uny fue-a mufeeng faester thun nurmael vhee stroock by Choorneeng Iaert is knucked doon.
844.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund (5 secunds). Heets fues neaer taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun. Cooses knuck-doon tu fues mufeeng faester thun nurmael.

845.name: Leeqooeed Flaeme-a
845.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 7...112 fure-a daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is aettaeckeeng oor caesteeng a spell, neaerby fues aere-a aelsu stroock fur 7...112 fure-a daemaege-a.
845.concise: Spell. Deaels 7...112 fure-a daemaege-a. Deaels 7...112 fure-a daemaege-a tu fues neaer yuoor taerget iff thees fue-a is aettaeckeeng oor caesteeng.

846.name: Steaem
846.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 20...60 culd daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is oon fure-a, Steaem Bleends thaet fue-a fur 5...10 secunds und zeey taeke-a un aeddeeshunael 20...60 fure-a daemaege-a.
846.concise: Spell. Deaels 20...60 culd daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (5...10 secunds) und dues 20...60 fure-a daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is Boorneeng.

847.name: Buun Seegnet
847.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Heael taerget aelly fur 20...80 Heaelt. Yuoor next Heaeleeng oor Prutecshun Praeyer spell thaet taergets un aelly heaels fur un aeddeeshunael 20...100 Heaelt.
847.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Heaels fur 20...80. Yuoor next Heaeleeng oor Prutecshun Praeyer spell thaet taergets un aelly heaels fur +20...100 Heaelt.

848.name: Referse-a Hex
848.description: Inchuntment Spell. Remufe-a oone-a hex frum taerget aelly. Iff a hex vaes remufed in thees vaey, fur 5...10 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly vuoold taeke-a daemaege-a, thaet daemaege-a is redooced by 5...50.
848.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...10 secunds.) Remufes oone-a hex frum taerget aelly. Zee next daemaege-a thees aelly taekes is redooced by 5...50. Nu iffffect unless thees aelly is hexed.

849.name: Laeceraeteeng Chup
849.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff Laeceraeteeng Chup heets, yuoo deael +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff it streekes a knucked doon fue-a yuoor taerget sooffffers frum Bleedeeng fur 5...20 secunds.
849.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is knucked-doon.

850.name: Feeerce-a Bloo
850.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Feeerce-a Bloo heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a vaes sooffffereeng frum Veaekness, thaet fue-a aelsu sooffffers frum a Deep Vuoond fur 1...8 secunds.
850.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond (1...8 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is Veaekened.

851.name: Soon und Muun Slaesh
851.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Aettaeck taerget fue-a tveece-a. Zeese-a aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked.
851.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Yuoo aettaeck taerget fue-a tveece-a. Unbluckaeble-a.

852.name: Spleenter Shut
852.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Spleenter Shut heets, yuoo deael +3...15 daemaege-a. Iff Spleenter Shut is blucked, aell fues in zee aerea ooff yuoor taerget taeke-a 5...65 daemaege-a.
852.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +3...15 daemaege-a. Deaels 5...65 daemaege-a tu fues in zee aerea iff blucked.

853.name: Melundroo's Shut
853.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Iff Melundroo's Shut heets, yuoor taerget begeens Bleedeeng fur 5...25 secunds. Iff it heets a fue-a thaet is mufeeng oor knucked doon, thaet fue-a taekes +10...25 daemaege-a und is Creeppled fur 5...15 secunds.
853.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Inffleects Bleedeeng (5...25 secunds). Deaels +10...25 daemaege-a und inffleects Creeppled (5...15 secunds) iff taerget fue-a vaes mufeeng oor knucked doon.

854.name: Snaere-a
854.description: Traep. Vhee Snaere-a is treeggered, aell neaerby fues becume-a Creeppled fur 3...15 secunds. Snaere-a inds aeffter 90 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
854.concise: Traep. (90 secunds.) Aeffffects neaerby fues. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...15 secunds). Iaeseely interroopted.

858.name: Dunceeng Daeggers
858.description: Spell. Send oooot three-a Dunceeng Daeggers aet taerget fue-a, iaech streekeeng fur 5...35 iaert daemaege-a iff zeey heet. Dunceeng Daeggers haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a. Thees skeell cuoonts aes a leaed aettaeck.
858.concise: Haelff Runge-a Spell. Three-a prujecteeles: iaech deaels 5...35 iaert daemaege-a. Cuoonts aes a leaed aettaeck.

859.name: Cunjoore-a Neeghtmaere-a
859.description: Hex Spell. Fur 2...16 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -8 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
859.concise: Hex Spell. (2...16 secunds.) Cooses -8 Heaelt degeneraeshun.

860.name: Seegnet ooff Deesroopshun
860.description: Seegnet. Iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell, zee spell is interroopted und thaet fue-a sooffffers 10...51 daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is hexed, Seegnet ooff Deesroopshun cun interroopt uny nun-spell skeells.
860.concise: Seegnet. Interroopts a spell. Cun interroopt uny skeell iff taerget fue-a is hexed. Interroopshun iffffect: deaels 10...51 daemaege-a.

862.name: Raefenuoos Gaeze-a
862.description: Ileete-a Spell. Deael 20...40 daemaege-a und steael 20...40 Heaelt frum taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues.
862.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 20...40 daemaege-a und steaels 20...40 Heaelt frum taerget und neaerby fues.

863.name: Oorder ooff Aepustaesy
863.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5 secunds, vhenefer a paerty member heets a fue-a veet physeecael daemaege-a, thaet fue-a luses oone-a inchuntment. Fur iaech Munk inchuntment remufed, yuoo luse-a 10...3% maexeemoom Heaelt.
863.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Inchunts aell paerty members (5 secunds). Zeese-a paerty members remufe-a oone-a inchuntment vhee zeey deael physeecael daemaege-a. Remufael cust: fur iaech Munk inchuntment, yuoo luse-a 10...3% maexeemoom Heaelt.

864.name: Ooppresseefe-a Gaeze-a
864.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...30 shaedoo daemaege-a. Fues aelreaedy sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun aere-a Pueesuned und Veaekened fur 3...12 secunds.
864.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...30 daemaege-a tu taerget und aedjaecent fues. Inffleects Pueesun und Veaekness (3...12 secunds) oon fues sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun.

865.name: Leeghtneeng Haemmer
865.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 10...100 leeghtneeng daemaege-a und aeppleees Craecked Aermur fur 5...20 secunds. Leeghtneeng Haemmer haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
865.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...100 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Aeppleees Craecked Aermur (5...20 secunds). 25% aermur penetraeshun.

866.name: Faepur Blaede-a
866.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 15...135 culd daemaege-a. Faepur Blaede-a deaels haelff daemaege-a iff thaet fue-a haes uny inchuntments oon zeem.
866.concise: Spell. Deaels 15...135 culd daemaege-a. Haelff daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is inchunted.

867.name: Heaeleeng Leeght
867.description: Ileete-a Spell. Heael taerget aelly fur 40...120 Heaelt. Iff yuoor taerget haes un inchuntment, yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy. Bork! Bork! Bork!
867.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Heaels fur 40...120. Yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy iff taerget aelly is inchunted.

869.name: "Cooaerd!"
869.description: Ileete-a Shuoot. Iff taerget fue-a is mufeeng, thaet fue-a is knucked doon.
869.concise: Ileete-a Shuoot. Cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is mufeeng.

870.name: Pesteelence-a
870.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Vhee uny nun-spureet creaetoore-a veetheen its runge-a deees, cundeeshuns oon thaet creaetoore-a spreaed tu uny creaetoore-a in zee aerea aelreaedy sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...180 secunds.
