870.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...180 secund leeffespun). Vhee uny creaetoore-a in runge-a deees, cundeeshuns oon thees creaetoore-a spreaed tu uny creaetoore-a in zee aerea veet a cundeeshun. Spureets aere-a nut aeffffected.

871.name: Shaedoosung
871.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Thees spureet's aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und coose-a Bleendness fur 1...6 secunds. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30 secunds.
871.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30-secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und inffleect Bleendness cundeeshun (1...6 secunds).

876.name: Seegnet ooff Shaedoos
876.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a taekes 5...35 daemaege-a. Iff yuoor taerget vaes Bleended, thaet fue-a sooffffers un aeddeeshunael 15...60 daemaege-a.
876.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 5...35 daemaege-a. Deaels 15...60 mure-a daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is Bleended.

877.name: Lyssa's Baelunce-a
877.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a luses oone-a inchuntment. Iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a inchuntments thun taerget fue-a, thees skeell haes nu iffffect.
877.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Nu iffffect iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a inchuntments thun thees fue-a.

878.name: Feeseeuns ooff Regret
878.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 15...45 daemaege-a vhenefer zeey use-a a skeell und 5...50 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a iff nut under zee iffffects ooff unuzeer Mesmer hex.
878.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (10 secunds). Zeese-a fues taeke-a 15...45 daemaege-a vhenefer zeey use-a a skeell und 5...50 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a iff nut under zee iffffects ooff unuzeer Mesmer hex.

879.name: Illooseeun ooff Paeeen
879.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8 secunds, taerget fue-a haes -3...10 Heaelt degeneraeshun und taekes 3...10 daemaege-a iaech secund. Vhee Illooseeun ooff Paeeen inds, thaet fue-a is heaeled fur 36...120.
879.concise: Hex Spell. (8 secunds.) Cooses -3...10 Heaelt degeneraeshun und taerget fue-a taekes 3...10 daemaege-a iaech secund. Ind iffffect: thaet fue-a is heaeled fur 36...120.

880.name: Stulee Speed
880.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 1...10 secunds, spells caest by zee taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 100% lunger tu caest. Spells taergeteeng zeese-a fues thaet aere-a caest by yuoo oor yuoor aelleees taeke-a 50% less teeme-a tu caest.
880.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes aedjaecent fues (1...10 secunds). Duoobles spell caesteeng teeme-a. Spells caest by yuoo oor yuoor aelleees oon hexed fues haefe-a -50% caesteeng teeme-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

881.name: Izeer Seegnet
881.description: Seegnet. Iff yuoo haefe-a less thun 5...10 Inergy, gaeeen 10...20 Inergy.
881.concise: Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 10...20 Inergy. Nu iffffect unless yuoo haefe-a less thun 5...10 Inergy.

882.name: Seegnet ooff Deesenchuntment
882.description: Seegnet. Luse-a aell Inergy. Taerget fue-a luses oone-a inchuntment.
882.concise: Seegnet. Remufes oone-a inchuntment. Yuoo luse-a aell Inergy.

883.name: Fucael Meenureety
883.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues cunnut use-a shuoots oor chunts.
883.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues neaer taerget (5...20 secunds). Zeese-a fues cunnut use-a shuoots oor chunts.

884.name: Seaereeng Flaemes
884.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock veet Seaereeng Flaemes. Fues aelreaedy oon fure-a vhee thees skeell is caest aere-a stroock fur 10...100 fure-a daemaege-a. Fues nut aelreaedy oon fure-a begeen Boorneeng fur 1...7 secunds.
884.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Heets fues neaer yuoor taerget. Deaels 10...100 fure-a daemaege-a tu fues aelreaedy Boorneeng. Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...7 secunds) tu fues nut Boorneeng.

885.name: Sheeeld Gooaerdeeun
885.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 2...6 secunds, aell paerty members in iaershut haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks. Iff un aettaeck is blucked, aell aelleees in iaershut aere-a heaeled fur 10...40 Heaelt und Sheeeld Gooaerdeeun inds.
885.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (2...6 secunds). Paerty members in iaershut haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks. Bluck iffffect: Aelleees in iaershut aere-a heaeled fur 10...40 und Sheeeld Gooaerdeeun inds.

886.name: Restffool Breeze-a
886.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8...18 secunds, taerget aelly haes +10 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Thees inchuntment inds iff thaet aelly aettaecks oor uses a skeell.
886.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8...18 secunds.) +10 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Inds iff taerget aelly aettaecks oor uses a skeell.

887.name: Seegnet ooff Rejoofenaeshun
887.description: Seegnet. Heael taerget aelly fur 15...75. Iff taerget aelly is caesteeng a spell oor aettaeckeeng, thaet aelly is heaeled fur un aeddeeshunael 15...75 Heaelt.
887.concise: Seegnet. Heaels fur 15...75. Heaels fur 15...75 mure-a iff taerget aelly is caesteeng a spell oor aettaeckeeng.

888.name: Vhurleeng Aexe-a
888.description: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff Vhurleeng Aexe-a heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a und uny stunce-a beeeng used by yuoor taerget inds. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
888.concise: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a und remufes a stunce-a. Unbluckaeble-a.

889.name: Furceffool Bloo
889.description: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Furceffool Bloo heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...30 daemaege-a und uny stunce-a beeeng used by taerget fue-a inds. Taerget fue-a sooffffers frum Veaekness fur 5...20 secunds. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
889.concise: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +10...30 daemaege-a. Remufes taerget fue-a's stunce-a. Inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Unbluckaeble-a.

891.name: "Nune-a Shaell Paess!"
891.description: Shuoot. Aell neaerby fues thaet aere-a mufeeng aere-a knucked doon. Thees skeell rechaerges 1...8 secunds faester fur iaech fue-a knucked doon (maexeemoom 25 secunds).
891.concise: Shuoot. Knucks doon aell neaerby mufeeng fues. Rechaerges 1...8 secunds faester fur iaech aeffffected fue-a (maexeemoom 25 secunds).

892.name: Qooeefereeng Blaede-a
892.description: Ileete-a Svurd Aettaeck. Iff Qooeefereeng Blaede-a heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a. Iff thees aettaeck heets a mufeeng fue-a, thaet fue-a is Daezed fur 10 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
892.concise: Ileete-a Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Inffleects Daezed cundeeshun (10 secunds) iff taerget fue-a vaes mufeeng.

893.name: Seekeeng Aerroos
893.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 3...14 secunds, yuoor aerroos cunnut be-a blucked. Seekeeng Aerroos inds iff yuoo faeeel tu heet.
893.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (3...14 secunds.) Yuoor aerroos aere-a unbluckaeble-a. Inds iff yuoo faeeel tu heet.

898.name: Ooferluaed
898.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Iff taerget fue-a is useeng a skeell, Ooferluaed deaels 15...75 daemaege-a tu thaet fue-a und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu aell aedjaecent fues.
898.concise: Hex Spell. (5 secunds.) Cooses -1...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Iff taerget fue-a is useeng a skeell, thaet fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a.

899.name: Imaeges ooff Remurse-a
899.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...10 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Iff thaet fue-a vaes aettaeckeeng, thaet fue-a taekes 10...52 daemaege-a.
899.concise: Hex Spell. (5...10 secunds.) Cooses -1...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Ineeteeael iffffect: 10...52 daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is aettaeckeeng.

900.name: Shaered Boordee
900.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea aettaeck, caest spells, und mufe-a 50% slooer.
900.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues in zee aerea ooff yuoor taerget (5...20 secunds). Zeese-a fues aettaeck, caest spells, und mufe-a 50% slooer.

901.name: Suool Beend
901.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 30 secunds, ifery teeme-a taerget fue-a is heaeled, zee heaeler taekes 20...80 daemaege-a. Thees hex inds iff taerget is sooffffereeng frum a Smeeteeng Praeyers hex.
901.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (30 secunds.) Ifery teeme-a taerget fue-a is heaeled, zee heaeler taekes 20...80 daemaege-a. Inds iff taerget is sooffffereeng frum a Smeeteeng Praeyers hex.

902.name: Bluud ooff zee Aeggressur
902.description: Spell. Steael up tu 5...45 Heaelt frum taerget fue-a. Iff thaet fue-a vaes aettaeckeeng, thaet fue-a sooffffers Veaekness fur 3...12 secunds.
902.concise: Spell. Steaels 5...45 Heaelt. Inffleects Veaekness (3...12 secunds) iff taerget fue-a vaes aettaeckeeng.

903.name: Icy Preesm
903.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 15...75 culd daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a haes a Vaeter Maegeec hex, Icy Preesm deaels +15...75 culd daemaege-a tu aell oozeer neaerby fues.
903.concise: Spell. Deaels 15...75 culd daemaege-a. Deaels +15...75 culd daemaege-a tu oozeer neaerby fues iff taerget haes a Vaeter Maegeec hex.

904.name: Fooreeuoos Aexe-a
904.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff Fooreeuoos Aexe-a heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...35 daemaege-a. Iff it is blucked yuoo gaeeen 3 streekes vurt ooff aedrenaeleene-a.
904.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Geefes yuoo 3 streekes ooff aedrenaeleene-a iff blucked.

905.name: Oospeeceeuoos Bloo
905.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Oospeeceeuoos Bloo heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a und gaeeen 3...8 Inergy. Iff taerget fue-a is sooffffereeng frum Veaekness, thees aettaeck is unbluckaeble-a.
905.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a und yuoo gaeeen 3...8 Inergy. Unbluckaeble-a iff taerget fue-a is Veaekened.

906.name: "Oon Yuoor Knees!"
906.description: Shuoot. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. Iff uny aedjaecent fues aere-a knucked doon, aell ooff yuoor stunces aere-a rechaerged. Bork! Bork! Bork!
906.concise: Shuoot. Rechaerges aell yuoor stunces iff yuoo aere-a aedjaecent tu a knucked-doon fue-a. Yuoo luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a.

907.name: Draegun Slaesh
907.description: Ileete-a Svurd Aettaeck. Iff Draegun Slaesh heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a und gaeeen 1...5 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.
907.concise: Ileete-a Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 1...5 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a iff it heets.

908.name: Maerooder's Shut
908.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Maerooder's Shut heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +25...55 daemaege-a und aell yuoor nun-aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 5 secunds.
908.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +25...55 daemaege-a. Yuoor nun-aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled (5 secunds) iff thees aettaeck heets.

909.name: Fucoosed Shut
909.description: Boo Aettaeck. Thees shut mufes three-a teemes faester, cunnut be-a blucked, und streekes fur +10...40 daemaege-a boot aell ooff yuoor oozeer aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 8...4 secunds.
909.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Thees shut mufes three-a teemes faester.Yuoor oozeer aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled (8...4 secunds).

910.name: Spureet Reefft
910.description: Spell. Oopee a Spureet Reefft aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Aeffter 3 secunds, aell aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 25...125 leeghtneeng daemaege-a und sooffffer frum Craecked Aermur fur 1...20 secunds.
910.concise: Spell. Aeffter 3 secunds, aeffffects fues aedjaecent tu taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun. Deaels 25...125 leeghtneeng daemaege-a und inffleects Craecked Aermur (1...20 secunds).

911.name: Uneeun
911.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet. Vhenefer a nun-spureet aelly in its runge-a taekes daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael, it is redooced by 15 und zee spureet taekes 15 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.
911.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Vhenefer a nun-spureet aelly veetheen runge-a taekes daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael, it is redooced by 15 und zee spureet taekes 15 daemaege-a.

913.name: Trunqooeel Vaes Tunaesee
913.description: Ileete-a Item Spell. Huld Tunaesee's aeshes fur up tu 5...20 secunds. Vheele-a yuoo huld hees aeshes, yuoo haefe-a +10...25 aermur und cunnut be-a interroopted. Bork! Bork! Bork!
913.concise: Ileete-a Item Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +10...25 aermur. Yuoo cunnut be-a interroopted.

914.name: Cunsoome-a Suool
914.description: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo steael 5...70 Heaelt frum taerget fue-a. Aell husteele-a soommuned creaetoores in iaershut ooff thaet fue-a taeke-a 25...125 daemaege-a.
914.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Steaels 5...70 Heaelt. Deael 25...125 daemaege-a tu husteele-a soommuned creaetoores veetheen iaershut ooff taerget fue-a.

915.name: Spureet Leeght
915.description: Spell. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 60...180. Iff uny spureets aere-a veetheen iaershut, yuoo dun't saecreeffeece-a Heaelt.
915.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 60...180. Yuoo dun't saecreeffeece-a Heaelt iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff uny spureets.

916.name: Laementaeshun
916.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues sooffffer -0...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Vhee thees hex is aeppleeed, zeese-a fues taeke-a 10...50 daemaege-a iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet oor curpse-a.
916.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues neaer taerget (5...20 secunds). Cooses -0...3 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 10...50 daemaege-a tu zeese-a fues iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet oor curpse-a.

917.name: Rooptoore-a Suool
917.description: Spell. Taerget aelleeed spureet is destruyed. Aell neaerby inemeees aere-a stroock fur 50...140 leeghtneeng daemaege-a und becume-a bleended fur 3...12 secunds.
917.concise: Spell. Destruys taerget aelleeed spureet. Deaels 50...140 leeghtneeng daemaege-a und inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (3...12 secunds) tu neaerby fues.

918.name: Spureet tu Flesh
918.description: Spell. Taerget tuooched aelleeed spureet is destruyed. Aell neaerby aelleees aere-a heaeled fur 30...240.
918.concise: Tuooch Spell. Destruys taerget tuooched aelleeed spureet. Heaels neaerby aelleees fur 30...240.

919.name: Spureet Boorn
919.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 5...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Iff uny spureets aere-a veetheen iaershut, Spureet Boorn cooses Boorneeng fur 1...5 secunds.
919.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...5 secunds) iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.

920.name: Destroocshun
920.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...14 Spureet thaet deees aeffter 30 secunds. Vhee thees Spureet deees, aell fues in zee aerea taeke-a 5...25 daemaege-a fur iaech secund zee Spureet vaes aeleefe-a (maexeemoom 150 daemaege-a).
920.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...14 Spureet thaet deees aeffter 30 secunds. Vhee thees Spureet deees, aell fues in zee aerea taeke-a 5...25 daemaege-a fur iaech secund zee Spureet vaes aeleefe-a (maexeemoom 150 daemaege-a).

921.name: Deessununce-a
921.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet. Thees spureet deaels 5...20 daemaege-a und unyune-a stroock by its aettaeck is interroopted. Thees spureet deees aeffter 10...25 secunds.
921.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (10...25 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und interroopt aecshuns.

923.name: Deesenchuntment
923.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet. Thees spureet deaels 5...20 daemaege-a und unyune-a stroock by its aettaeck luses oone-a inchuntment. Thees spureet deees aeffter 10...35 secunds.
923.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (10...35 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und remufe-a oone-a inchuntment.

925.name: Recaell
925.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen Recaell, nutheeng haeppens. Vhee Recaell inds, yuoo Shaedoo Step tu zee aelly yuoo taergeted vhee yuoo aecteefaeted thees skeell, und aell ooff yuoor skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 3 secunds.
925.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Ind iffffect: Shaedoo Step tu taerget aelly. Cunnut selff-taerget und deesaebles aell ooff yuoor skeells fur 3 secunds vhee it inds.

926.name: Shaerpee Daeggers
926.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...30 secunds, yuoor daegger aettaecks coose-a Bleedeeng fur 5...15 secunds.
926.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...30 secunds.) Yuoor daegger aettaecks inffleect zee Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...15 secunds).

927.name: Shaemeffool Feaer
927.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 10% faester thun nurmael. Fur iaech secund, iff thaet fue-a is mufeeng, thaet fue-a taekes 5...20 daemaege-a.
927.concise: Hex Spell. (10 secunds.) Taerget fue-a taekes 5...20 daemaege-a iaech secund vheele-a mufeeng, boot mufes 10% faester.

928.name: Shaedoo Shruood
928.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 3...9 secunds, taerget fue-a cunnut be-a zee taerget ooff inchuntments.
928.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (3...9 secunds.) Taerget fue-a cunnut be-a zee taerget ooff inchuntments.

929.name: Shaedoo ooff Haeste-a
929.description: Stunce-a. Fur 10...40 secunds yuoo mufe-a 15% faester thun nurmael. Vhee Shaedoo ooff Haeste-a inds, yuoo Shaedoo Step tu yuoor ooreegeenael lucaeshun.
929.concise: Stunce-a. (10...40 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 15% faester. Ind iffffect: retoorn tu yuoor ooreegeenael lucaeshun.

930.name: Oospeeceeuoos Incuntaeshun
930.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, zee next spell yuoo caest is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 10...5 secunds, und yuoo gaeeen 110...200% ooff thaet spell's Inergy cust.
930.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Yuoor next spell geefes yuoo 110...200% ooff its Inergy cust. Thaet spell taekes 10...5 secunds lunger tu rechaerge-a.

931.name: Pooer Retoorn
931.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell oor chunt, thaet skeell is interroopted und taerget fue-a gaeeens 10...5 Inergy.
931.concise: Spell. Interroopts a spell oor chunt. Interroopshun iffffect: taerget fue-a gaeeens 10...5 Inergy.

932.name: Cumpleecaete-a
932.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is useeng a skeell, thaet skeell is interroopted und deesaebled fur taerget fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea fur un aeddeeshunael 5...12 secunds.
932.concise: Spell. Interroopts a skeell. Interroopshun iffffect: deesaebles interroopted skeell (+5...12 secunds) fur taerget fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea.

933.name: Shaetter Sturm
933.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a luses aell inchuntments. Fur iaech inchuntment remufed thees vaey, Shaetter Sturm is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 7 secunds.
933.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Remufes aell inchuntments. Remufael cust: Shaetter Sturm is deesaebled fur +7 secunds fur iaech inchuntment remufed.

934.name: Unnaetoorael Seegnet
934.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is under zee iffffects ooff a hex oor inchuntment, fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget taeke-a 5...50 daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
934.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 15...75 daemaege-a. Deaels 5...50 daemaege-a tu oozeer aedjaecent fues iff zee taerget is hexed oor inchunted.

935.name: Reeseeng Beele-a
935.description: Hex Spell. Fur 20 secunds, thees hex dues nutheeng. Vhee Reeseeng Beele-a inds, thaet fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea taeke-a 1...6 daemaege-a fur iaech secund Reeseeng Beele-a vaes in iffffect.
935.concise: Hex Spell. (20 secunds.) Ind iffffect: deaels 1...6 daemaege-a fur iaech secund Reeseeng Beele-a vaes in iffffect. Aelsu daemaeges oozeer fues in zee aerea.

936.name: Infenum Inchuntments
936.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a luses oone-a inchuntment. Fur ifery remaeeeneeng inchuntment, taerget fue-a is pueesuned fur 3...10 secunds.
936.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (3...10 secunds fur iaech remaeeeneeng inchuntment oon thaet fue-a).

937.name: Shuckvaefe-a
937.description: Ileete-a Spell. Aell fues in zee aerea taeke-a 15...60 iaert daemaege-a und aere-a Veaekened fur 1...10 secunds. Neaerby fues aelsu taeke-a +15...60 iaert daemaege-a und haefe-a Craecked Aermur fur 1...10 secunds. Aedjaecent fues sooffffer zee prefeeuoos iffffects, taeke-a +15...60 iaert daemaege-a, und aere-a Bleended fur 1...10 secunds.
937.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Fues in zee aerea taeke-a 15...60 iaert daemaege-a und aere-a Veaekened (1...10 secunds). Neaerby fues aelsu taeke-a +15...60 iaert daemaege-a und haefe-a Craecked Aermur (1...10 secunds). Aedjaecent fues aelsu taeke-a +15...60 iaert daemaege-a und aere-a Bleended (1...10 secunds).

938.name: Vaerd ooff Staebeeleety
938.description: Vaerd Spell. Creaete-a a Vaerd ooff Staebeeleety aet yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 10...25 secunds, nun-spureet aelleees cunnut be-a knucked doon. Bork! Bork! Bork!
938.concise: Vaerd Spell. (10...25 secunds.) Aelleees in thees vaerd cunnut be-a knucked-doon. Aelleeed spureets aere-a nut aeffffected.

939.name: Icy Shaeckles
939.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 1...10 secunds, taerget fue-a's mufement speed is redooced by 66%. Vheele-a under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, thaet fue-a's mufement is redooced by 90%.
939.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (1...10 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 66% slooer. Thees fue-a mufes 90% slooer iff inchunted.

941.name: Blessed Leeght
941.description: Ileete-a Spell. Heael taerget aelly fur 10...120 Heaelt und remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun und oone-a hex.
941.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Heaels fur 10...120. Remufes oone-a cundeeshun und oone-a hex.

942.name: Veethdraev Hexes
942.description: Ileete-a Spell. Remufe-a aell hexes frum taerget aelly und aell aedjaecent aelleees. Thees spell taekes un aeddeeshunael 2 secunds tu rechaerge-a fur iaech hex remufed in thees vaey. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Deefeene-a Faefur 4 oor less.)
942.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Remufes aell hexes. Aelsu aeffffects aedjaecent aelleees. Remufael cust: +2 secunds rechaerge-a fur iaech hex remufed. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Deefeene-a Faefur 5 oor mure-a.

943.name: Ixteengooeesh
943.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun frum iaech paerty member. Paerty members releeefed ooff Boorneeng aere-a heaeled fur 10...100 Heaelt.
943.concise: Spell. Aeffffects aell paerty members. Remufes oone-a cundeeshun. Paerty members releeefed ooff Boorneeng aere-a heaeled fur 10...100.

944.name: Seegnet ooff Strengt
944.description: Seegnet. Yuoor next 1...16 aettaecks deael +5 daemaege-a.
944.concise: Seegnet. Yuoor aettaecks deael +5 daemaege-a. Inds aeffter 1...16 aettaecks.

946.name: Traepper's Fucoos
946.description: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. Fur 12...36 secunds, yuoor traep skeells aere-a nut iaeseely interroopteeble-a und yuoor Veelderness Soorfeefael aettreeboote-a is increaesed by 0...4.
946.concise: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. (12...36 secunds.) Yuoor traep skeells aere-a nu lunger iaesy tu interroopt. Yuoo gaeeen +0...4 tu yuoor Veelderness Soorfeefael aettreeboote-a.

947.name: Braembles
947.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Nun-spureet creaetoores thaet aere-a knucked doon in its runge-a taeke-a 5 daemaege-a und begeen Bleedeeng fur 5...20 secunds. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
947.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Knucked-doon creaetoores taeke-a 5 daemaege-a und begeen Bleedeeng (5...20 secunds). Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

948.name: Desperaete-a Streeke-a
948.description: Leaed Aettaeck. Iff yuoo haefe-a less thun 50...80% Heaelt, yuoo deael +15...60 daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
948.concise: Leaed Aettaeck. Deaels +15...60 daemaege-a iff yuoo haefe-a less thun 50...80% Heaelt.

949.name: Vaey ooff zee Fux
949.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...35 secunds, yuoor next 1...6 aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked.
949.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoor aettaecks aere-a unbluckaeble-a. Inds aeffter 1...6 aettaecks.

950.name: Shaedooy Boordee
950.description: Hex Spell. Fur 3...15 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 25% slooer und vheele-a taerget fue-a haes nu oozeer hexes, thaet fue-a haes 20...30 less aermur aegaeeenst yuoor aettaecks.
950.concise: Hex Spell. (3...15 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 25% slooer und haes 20...30 less aermur aegaeeenst yuoor aettaecks. Aermur redoocshun oonly aeffffects thees fue-a vheele-a it haes nu oozeer hexes.

951.name: Seephun Speed
951.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 33% slooer und yuoo mufe-a 33% faester. Thees spell rechaerges 50% faester iff caest oon a mufeeng fue-a.
951.concise: Hex Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 33% slooer und yuoo mufe-a 33% faester. Rechaerges 50% faester iff caest oon a mufeeng fue-a.

952.name: Deaet's Chaerge-a
952.description: Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Iff thaet fue-a haes mure-a Heaelt thun yuoo, yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 65...200.
952.concise: Spell. Yuoo Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 65...200 iff thees fue-a haes mure-a Heaelt thun yuoo.

953.name: Pooer Floox
953.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell oor chunt, thaet skeell is interroopted und fur 4...10 secunds, thaet fue-a haes -2 Inergy degeneraeshun.
953.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Interroopts a spell oor chunt. Interroopshun iffffect: -2 Inergy degeneraeshun (4...10 secunds).

954.name: Ixpel Hexes
954.description: Ileete-a Spell. Remufe-a up tu 2 hexes frum taerget aelly.
954.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Remufes 2 hexes frum taerget aelly.

955.name: Reep Inchuntment
955.description: Spell. Remufe-a 1 inchuntments frum taerget fue-a. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, thaet fue-a sooffffers frum Bleedeeng fur 5...25 secunds.
955.concise: Spell. Remufes 1 inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: inffleects Bleedeeng (5...25 secunds).

957.name: Spell Sheeeld
957.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, vheele-a yuoo aere-a caesteeng spells, fues cunnut taerget yuoo veet spells. Vhee Spell Sheeeld inds, aell yuoor skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 8...4 secunds.
957.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Vheele-a caesteeng spells, yuoo cunnut be-a zee taerget ooff spells. Ind iffffect: yuoor skeells aere-a deesaebled (8...4 secunds).

958.name: Heaeleeng Vheesper
958.description: Spell. Taerget oozeer aelly is heaeled fur 40...100. Thees spell haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a.
958.concise: Haelff Runge-a Spell. Heaels fur 40...100. Cunnut selff-taerget.

959.name: Izeereael Leeght
959.description: Spell. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 25...100. Thees spell is iaeseely interroopted. Bork! Bork! Bork!

960.name: Releaese-a Inchuntments
960.description: Spell. Luse-a aell inchuntments. Iaech paerty member is heaeled fur 5...35 Heaelt fur iaech Munk inchuntment lust.
960.concise: Spell. Remufes aell ooff yuoor inchuntments. Heaels aell paerty members fur 5...35 fur iaech Munk inchuntment remufed.

961.name: Laeceraete-a
961.description: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Bleedeeng creaetoores veetheen its runge-a sooffffer -2 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Vhee thees spureet deees, aell nun-spureet creaetoores veetheen its runge-a thaet haefe-a less thun 90% Heaelt begeen Bleedeeng fur 5...25 secunds. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
961.concise: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Bleedeeng creaetoores in runge-a haefe-a -2 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Ind iffffect: inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...25 secunds) oon creaetoores in runge-a thaet haefe-a less thun 90% Heaelt. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

962.name: Spureet Trunsffer
962.description: Spell. Zee spureet neaerest yuoo luses 5...50 Heaelt. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 5 fur iaech pueent ooff Heaelt lust.
962.concise: Spell. Zee spureet neaerest yuoo luses 5...50 Heaelt. Heaels taerget aelly fur 5 fur iaech pueent ooff Heaelt lust.

963.name: Resturaeshun
963.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...14 spureet. Vhee thees spureet deees, aell paerty members in zee aerea aere-a resoorrected veet 5...50% Heaelt und zeru Inergy. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30 secunds.
963.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...14 spureet (30 secund leeffespun). Ind iffffect: resoorrects paerty members in zee aerea veet 5...50% Heaelt und zeru Inergy.

964.name: Fengeffool Veaepun
964.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 8 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly taekes daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael frum a fue-a, thaet aelly steaels up tu 15...60 Heaelt frum thaet fue-a.
964.concise: Veaepun Spell. (8 secunds.) Steaels 15...60 Heaelt frum zee next fue-a thaet deaels daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael tu taerget aelly.

973.name: Bleendeeng Pooder
973.description: Spell. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck. Taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues becume-a Bleended fur 3...15 secunds.
973.concise: Spell. Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (3...15 secunds) oon taerget und aedjaecent fues. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

974.name: Muntees Tuooch
974.description: Skeell. Taerget fue-a becumes Creeppled fur 5...20 secunds. Thees skeell cuoonts aes un ooffff-hund aettaeck.
974.concise: Skeell. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Thees skeell cuoonts aes un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

975.name: Ixhoosteeng Aessoolt
975.description: Dooael Aettaeck. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck. Taerget fue-a's aecshun is interroopted. Iff thaet aecshun vaes caesteeng a spell, taerget fue-a sooffffers 10 Oofercaest.
975.concise: Dooael Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Inffleects 10 Oofercaest iff zee interroopted aecshun vaes a spell. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck.

976.name: Repeaeteeng Streeke-a
976.description: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +10...30 daemaege-a. Iff it meesses, it taekes un aeddeeshunael 15 secunds tu rechaerge-a.
976.concise: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Deaels +10...30 daemaege-a. Thees skeell haes +15 secund rechaerge-a teeme-a iff it meesses. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

977.name: Vaey ooff zee Lutoos
977.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, zee next teeme-a yuoo heet veet a dooael aettaeck skeell, yuoo gaeeen 5...20 Inergy.
977.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 5...20 Inergy zee next teeme-a yuoo heet veet a dooael aettaeck.

978.name: Maerk ooff Instaebeeleety
978.description: Hex Spell. Fur 20 secunds, zee next teeme-a yuoo heet taerget fue-a veet a dooael aettaeck skeell thaet fue-a is knucked doon.
978.concise: Hex Spell. (20 secunds.) Cooses knuck-doon zee next teeme-a yuoo heet taerget fue-a veet a dooael aettaeck.

979.name: Meestroost
979.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6 secunds, zee next spell thaet taerget fue-a caests oon oone-a ooff yuoor aelleees faeeels und deaels 10...80 daemaege-a tu thaet fue-a und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu aell neaerby fues.
979.concise: Hex Spell. (6 secunds.) Zee next spell thaet taerget fue-a caests oon oone-a ooff yuoor aelleees faeeels und deaels 10...80 daemaege-a tu taerget und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu neaerby fues.

980.name: Feaest ooff Suools
980.description: Spell. Destruy aell neaerby aelleees' spureets. Fur iaech spureet destruyed in thees vaey, aell paerty members aere-a heaeled fur 50...100 Heaelt.
980.concise: Spell. Heaels aell paerty members fur 50...100 fur iaech neaerby aelleeed spureet. Aell neaerby aelleeed spureets aere-a destruyed.

981.name: Recooperaeshun
981.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...14 spureet. Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen its runge-a gaeeen +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...45 secunds.
981.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...14 spureet (15...45 secund leeffespun). Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen runge-a haefe-a +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun.

982.name: Shelter
982.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet. Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen its runge-a cunnut luse-a mure-a thun 10% maexeemoom Heaelt frum a seengle-a aettaeck. Vhee thees spureet prefents daemaege-a, it luses 75...45 Heaelt. Thees spureet laests 30...60 secunds.
982.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen runge-a cunnut luse-a mure-a thun 10% maexeemoom Heaelt frum a seengle-a aettaeck. Daemaege-a prefenshun cust: thees spureet luses 75...45 Heaelt.

983.name: Veaepun ooff Shaedoo
983.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 1...7 secunds, taerget aelly haes a Veaepun ooff Shaedoo. Vhenefer thaet aelly is stroock by un aettaeck, thaet aelly's aettaecker becumes Bleended fur 5 secunds. Zee next 1...3 teemes thaet aelly heets veet un aettaeck, hees taerget is Bleended fur 5 secunds.
983.concise: Veaepun Spell. (1...7 secunds.) Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (5 secunds) oon unyune-a vhu aettaecks taerget aelly. Taerget aelly's next 1...3 aettaecks inffleect Bleendness (5 secunds) iff zeey heet.

985.name: Caeltrups
985.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget aere-a Creeppled und Bleedeeng fur 5...15 secunds. Caeltrups haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a.
985.concise: Haelff Runge-a Spell. Inffleects Creeppled und Bleedeeng cundeeshuns (5...15 secunds) oon taerget und aedjaecent fues.

986.name: Neene-a Taeeel Streeke-a
986.description: Dooael Aettaeck. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck. Neene-a Taeeel Streeke-a cunnut be-a blucked und streekes fur +15...40 daemaege-a iff it heets.
986.concise: Dooael Aettaeck. Deaels +15...40 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

987.name: Vaey ooff zee Impty Paelm
987.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, ooffff-hund und dooael aettaecks cust nu Inergy und rechaerge-a 25...50% faester.
987.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Yuoor ooffff-hund und dooael aettaecks cust nu Inergy und rechaerge-a 25...50% faester.

988.name: Temple-a Streeke-a
988.description: Ileete-a Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a is Daezed und Bleended fur 1...10 secunds, und iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell, thaet fue-a is interroopted.
988.concise: Ileete-a Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Interroopts a spell. Inffleects Daezed und Bleendness cundeeshuns (1...10 secunds). Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck.

989.name: Guldee Phueneex Streeke-a
989.description: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Iff yuoo aere-a nut under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, thees skeell meesses. Iff it heets, Guldee Phueneex Streeke-a deaels +10...30 daemaege-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...30 daemaege-a.
989.concise: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Deaels +10...30 daemaege-a tu taerget und deaels 10...30 daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues. Faeeels iff yuoo aere-a nut inchunted.

990.name: Ixpoonge-a Inchuntments
990.description: Skeell. Taerget fue-a luses 1 inchuntment. Aell ooff yuoor oozeer nun-aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 8...4 secunds. Fur iaech skeell deesaebled in thees vaey, taerget tuooched fue-a luses 1 aeddeeshunael inchuntment.
990.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment fur iaech nun-aettaeck skeell yuoo haefe-a. Aell yuoor nun-aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled (8...4 secunds).

991.name: Deny Hexes
991.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a hex frum taerget aelly und oone-a aeddeeshunael hex fur iaech rechaergeeng Deefeene-a Faefur skeell yuoo haefe-a.
991.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a hex frum taerget aelly und oone-a aeddeeshunael hex fur iaech rechaergeeng Deefeene-a Faefur skeell yuoo haefe-a.

992.name: Treeple-a Chup
992.description: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Aettaeck taerget fue-a und aedjaecent fues. Iaech aettaeck thaet heets deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
992.concise: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Aelsu heets aedjaecent fues.

993.name: Inraeged Smaesh
993.description: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Inraeged Smaesh heets, yuoo gaeeen 1...4 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Iff yuoo heet a mufeeng fue-a, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a, und yuoor taerget is knucked doon.
993.concise: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Geefes yuoo 1...4 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a iff yuoo heet. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a und cooses knuckdoon iff yuoor taerget vaes mufeeng.

994.name: Renooeeng Smaesh
994.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Renooeeng Smaesh heets, it deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo heet a knucked-doon fue-a, yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy und thees aettaeck rechaerges instuntly.
994.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy und thees aettaeck rechaerges instuntly iff taerget fue-a vaes knucked doon.

995.name: Teeger Stunce-a
995.description: Stunce-a. Fur 4...10 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Teeger Stunce-a inds iff uny ooff yuoor aettaecks faeeel tu heet.
995.concise: Stunce-a. (4...10 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Inds iff yuoo faeeel tu heet.

996.name: Stundeeng Slaesh
996.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff it heets, Stundeeng Slaesh deaels +5...20 daemaege-a ploos un aeddeeshunael 5...20 daemaege-a iff yuoo aere-a in a stunce-a.
996.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Deaels 5...20 mure-a daemaege-a iff yuoo aere-a in a stunce-a.

997.name: Faemeene-a
997.description: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Vhenefer a nun-spureet creaetoore-a in its runge-a reaeches 0 Inergy, thaet creaetoore-a taekes 20...70 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...180 secunds.
997.concise: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...180 secund leeffespun). Deaels 20...70 daemaege-a tu creaetoores in runge-a thaet reaech 0 Inergy. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

1018.name: Creeteecael Iye-a
1018.description: Skeell. Fur 10...35 secunds, yuoo haefe-a un aeddeeshunael 3...15% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet vhee aettaeckeeng. Yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy vhenefer yuoo scure-a a creeteecael heet.
1018.concise: Skeell. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +3...15% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet. Yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy vhenefer yuoo lund a creeteecael heet.

1019.name: Creeteecael Streeke-a
1019.description: Dooael Aettaeck. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +10...30 daemaege-a, resoolts in a creeteecael heet, und yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy.
1019.concise: Dooael Aettaeck. Deaels +10...30 daemaege-a. Ootumaeteec creeteecael heet. Yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

1020.name: Blaedes ooff Steel
1020.description: Dooael Aettaeck. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +5...16 daemaege-a (maexeemoom bunoos 60) fur iaech rechaergeeng daegger aettaeck.
1020.concise: Dooael Aettaeck. Deaels +5...16 daemaege-a (maexeemoom 60) fur iaech rechaergeeng daegger aettaeck. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

1021.name: Joongle-a Streeke-a
1021.description: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +10...25 daemaege-a. Iff it heets a fue-a thaet vaes Creeppled, thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 1...31 daemaege-a.
1021.concise: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Deaels +10...25 daemaege-a. Deaels 1...31 daemaege-a tu taerget und aedjaecent fues iff taerget fue-a is Creeppled. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck.

1022.name: Veeld Streeke-a
1022.description: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +10...35 daemaege-a und uny stunce-a beeeng used by taerget fue-a inds. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1022.concise: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Deaels +10...35 daemaege-a. Remufes taerget fue-a's stunce-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck.

1023.name: Leaepeeng Muntees Steeng
1023.description: Leaed Aettaeck. Iff Muntees Steeng heets, taerget fue-a taekes +5...15 daemaege-a. Iff thees aettaeck streekes a mufeeng fue-a, thaet fue-a is Creeppled fur 3...15 secunds.
1023.concise: Leaed Aettaeck. Deaels +5...15 daemaege-a. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...15 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is mufeeng.

1024.name: Blaeck Muntees Throost
1024.description: Leaed Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +8...20 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is sooffffereeng frum a hex, thaet fue-a is Creeppled fur 3...15 secunds.
1024.concise: Leaed Aettaeck. Deaels +8...20 daemaege-a. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...15 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is hexed.

1025.name: Deesroopteeng Staeb
1025.description: Leaed Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, it interroopts taerget fue-a's aecshun. Iff thaet aecshun vaes a spell, it is deesaebled fur 3...10 secunds.
1025.concise: Leaed Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Iff zee interroopted aecshun vaes a spell, it is deesaebled (3...10 secunds).

1026.name: Guldee Lutoos Streeke-a
1026.description: Leaed Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, yuoo gaeeen 5...8 Inergy. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1026.concise: Leaed Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 5...8 Inergy iff yuoo aere-a inchunted.

1027.name: Creeteecael Deffenses
1027.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Creeteecael Deffenses reffreshes ifery teeme-a yuoo lund a creeteecael heet.
1027.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (4...10 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Renooael: ifery teeme-a yuoo lund a creeteecael heet.

1028.name: Vaey ooff Perffecshun
1028.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo sooccessffoolly lund a creeteecael heet, yuoo gaeeen 10...40 Heaelt.
1028.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (60 secunds.) Yuoor creeteecael heets heael yuoo fur 10...40.

1029.name: Daerk Aepustaesy
1029.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 3...17 secunds, ifery teeme-a yuoo sooccessffoolly lund a creeteecael heet, yuoo remufe-a oone-a inchuntment frum yuoor taerget. Iff yuoo remufe-a un inchuntment in thees vaey, yuoo luse-a 10...3 Inergy oor Daerk Aepustaesy inds.
1029.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (3...17 secunds.) Yuoor creeteecael heets remufe-a un inchuntment. Remufael cust: luse-a 10...3 Inergy oor Daerk Aepustaesy inds.

1030.name: Lucoost's Foory
1030.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...35 secunds, yuoo haefe-a un aeddeeshunael 50% chunce-a tu duooble-a streeke-a vheele-a useeng daeggers.
1030.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +50% chunce-a tu duooble-a streeke-a. Nu iffffect unless yuoo aere-a veeeldeeng daeggers.

1031.name: Shruood ooff Deestress
1031.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30...60 secunds, iff yuoo aere-a beloo 50% Heaelt, yuoo haefe-a +3...8 Heaelt regeneraeshun und a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks.
1031.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30...60 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +3...8 Heaelt regeneraeshun und 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Nu iffffect unless yuoor Heaelt is beloo 50%.

1032.name: Heaert ooff Shaedoo
1032.description: Spell. Yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 30...150. Shaedoo Step tu a neaerby lucaeshun durectly aevaey frum yuoor taerget.
1032.concise: Spell. Yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 30...150 und yuoo Shaedoo Step tu a neaerby lucaeshun durectly aevaey frum yuoor taerget.

1033.name: Impaele-a
1033.description: Skeell. Moost fulloo a dooael aettaeck. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 25...100 iaert daemaege-a und sooffffers frum a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds.
1033.concise: Skeell. Deaels 25...100 iaert daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Moost fulloo a dooael aettaeck.

1034.name: Seepeeng Vuoond
1034.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 1...7 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 33% slooer. Thaet fue-a taekes 5...25 daemaege-a iaech secund vheele-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun.
1034.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (1...7 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 33% slooer. Thees fue-a taekes 5...25 daemaege-a iaech secund vheele-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun.

1035.name: Aessaesseen's Prumeese-a
1035.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, iff taerget fue-a deees, yuoo gaeeen 5...20 Inergy und aell yuoor skeells aere-a rechaerged.
1035.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 5...20 Inergy und aell yuoor skeells rechaerge-a iff taerget fue-a deees.

1036.name: Seegnet ooff Maeleece-a
1036.description: Seegnet. Fur iaech cundeeshun sooffffered by taerget fue-a, yuoo luse-a oone-a cundeeshun.
1036.concise: Seegnet. Yuoo luse-a oone-a cundeeshun fur iaech cundeeshun oon taerget fue-a.

1037.name: Daerk Iscaepe-a
1037.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...15 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester und taeke-a haelff daemaege-a. Daerk Iscaepe-a inds iff yuoo sooccessffoolly heet veet un aettaeck.
1037.concise: Stunce-a. (5...15 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 25% faester und taeke-a haelff daemaege-a. Inds iff yuoo heet veet un aettaeck.

1038.name: Creeppleeng Daegger
1038.description: Spell. Send oooot a Creeppleeng Daegger aet taerget fue-a. Creeppleeng Daegger streekes fur 15...60 iaert daemaege-a iff it heets, und Creepples mufeeng fues fur 3...15 secunds. Thees spell haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a.
1038.concise: Haelff Runge-a Spell. Prujecteele-a: deaels 15...60 iaert daemaege-a. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...15 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is mufeeng.

1040.name: Spureet Vaelk
1040.description: Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget spureet.
1040.concise: Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget Spureet.

1041.name: Unseee Foory
1041.description: Stunce-a. Aell aedjaecent fues aere-a Bleended fur 3...10 secunds. Fur 10...30 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a blucked by Bleended fues.
1041.concise: Stunce-a. Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun oon aedjaecent fues (3...10 secunds). Yuoo cunnut be-a blucked by Bleended fues (10...30 secunds).

1042.name: Flaesheeng Blaedes
1042.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 5...30 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks vheele-a aettaeckeeng. Iff yuoo bluck un aettaeck in thees vaey, yuoor aettaecker taekes 5...20 daemaege-a.
1042.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (5...30 secunds.) 75% chunce-a tu bluck vheele-a aettaeckeeng. Bluck iffffect: 5...20 daemaege-a tu yuoor aettaecker.

1043.name: Daesh
1043.description: Stunce-a. Fur 3 secunds, yuoo roon 50% faester.

1044.name: Daerk Preesun
1044.description: Hex Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Fur 1...6 secunds, thaet fue-a mufes 33% slooer.
1044.concise: Hex Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Thees fue-a mufes 33% slooer (1...6 secunds).

1045.name: Paelm Streeke-a
1045.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a taekes 10...65 daemaege-a und is Creeppled fur 1...5 secunds. Thees skeell cuoonts aes un ooffff-hund aettaeck. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1045.concise: Ileete-a Tuooch Skeell. Deaels 10...65 daemaege-a und inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (1...5 secunds). Thees skeell cuoonts aes un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

1048.name: Refeaeled Inchuntment
1048.description: Spell. Remufe-a un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a und gaeeen 3...15 Inergy. Fur 20 secunds, Refeaeled Inchuntment is replaeced veet zee inchuntment remufed frum taerget fue-a.
1048.concise: Spell. Remufes un inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffects: yuoo gaeeen 3...15 Inergy; thees spell is replaeced veet thaet inchuntment (20 secunds).

1049.name: Refeaeled Hex
1049.description: Spell. Remufe-a a hex frum taerget aelly und gaeeen 4...10 Inergy. Fur 20 secunds, Refeaeled Hex is replaeced veet zee hex thaet vaes remufed.
1049.concise: Spell. Remufes a hex frum taerget aelly. Remufael iffffects: yuoo gaeeen 4...10 Inergy; thees spell is replaeced veet thaet hex (20 secunds).

1052.name: Aeccoomoolaeted Paeeen
1052.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is sooffffereeng frum 2 oor mure-a hexes, thaet fue-a sooffffers a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds.
1052.concise: Spell. Deaels 15...75 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a haes 2 oor mure-a hexes. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1053.name: Psycheec Deestraecshun
1053.description: Ileete-a Spell. Aell ooff yuoor oozeer skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 8 secunds. Iff taerget fue-a is useeng a skeell, thaet skeell is interroopted und deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 5...12 secunds.
1053.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Interroopts a skeell. Interroopshun iffffect: deesaebles interroopted skeell (+5...12 secunds). Yuoor oozeer skeells aere-a deesaebled (8 secunds).

1054.name: Uncestur's Feesaege-a
1054.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, vhenefer taerget aelly is heet by a melee-a aettaeck, aell aedjaecent fues luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a und 3 Inergy.
1054.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (4...10 secunds.) Aell aedjaecent fues luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a und 3 Inergy vhenefer a melee-a aettaeck heets taerget aelly.

1055.name: Recoorreeng Insecooreety
1055.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers frum -1...6 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Iff thaet fue-a haes unuzeer hex vhee Recoorreeng Insecooreety vuoold ind, it is reaeppleeed.
1055.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5 secunds.) Cooses -1...6 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Renooael: iff taerget fue-a haes unuzeer hex vhee Recoorreeng Insecooreety vuoold ind.

1056.name: Keetaeh's Boordee
1056.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6...12 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 50% slooer. Vhee Keetaeh's Boordee inds yuoo gaeeen 10...18 Inergy.
1056.concise: Hex Spell. (6...12 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 50% slooer. Ind iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 10...18 Inergy.

1057.name: Psycheec Instaebeeleety
1057.description: Ileete-a Spell. Interroopts zee taerget fue-a's aecshun. Iff thaet aecshun is a skeell, thaet fue-a und aell neaerby fues aere-a knucked doon fur 2...4 secunds. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Faest Caesteeng 4 oor less.)
1057.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: iff zee aecshun is a skeell, cooses knuckdoon fur 2...4 secunds oon taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Faest Caesteeng 5 oor heegher.

1059.name: Hex Iaeter Seegnet
1059.description: Seegnet. Taerget tuooched aelly und up tu 2...5 aedjaecent aelleees iaech luse-a oone-a hex. Yuoo gaeeen 1...4 Inergy fur iaech hex remufed thees vaey.
1059.concise: Tuooch Seegnet. Remufes a hex frum taerget und 2...5 aedjaecent aelleees. Remufael iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 1...4 Inergy fur iaech hex remufed.

1061.name: Feedbaeck
1061.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a luses oone-a inchuntment. Iff un inchuntment is remufed in thees vaey, thaet fue-a aelsu luses 4...10 Inergy.
1061.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment. Remufael iffffect: taerget fue-a luses 4...10 Inergy.

1062.name: Aercune-a Laerceny
1062.description: Spell. Fur 5...35 secunds, oone-a rundum spell is deesaebled fur taerget fue-a und Aercune-a Laerceny is replaeced by thaet spell.
1062.concise: Spell. (5...35 secunds.) Deesaebles oone-a rundum spell. Thees skeell becumes thaet spell.

1066.name: Spueel Feectur
1066.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 3...15 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a aettaecks oor caests a spell oon a creaetoore-a veet less Heaelt thaet fue-a luses 25...100 Heaelt.
1066.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (3...15 secunds.) Cooses 25...100 Heaelt luss vhenefer taerget fue-a aettaecks oor caests spells oon a creaetoore-a veet less Heaelt.

1067.name: Leeffebune-a Streeke-a
1067.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 12...48 shaedoo daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a's Heaelt is aebufe-a 50%, yuoo steael up tu 12...48 Heaelt.
1067.concise: Spell. Deaels 12...48 daemaege-a. Steaels 12...48 Heaelt iff taerget fue-a's Heaelt is aebufe-a 50%.

1068.name: Beetter Cheell
1068.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 15...60 culd daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a haed mure-a Heaelt thun yuoo, Beetter Cheell rechaerges instuntly.
1068.concise: Spell. Deaels 15...60 culd daemaege-a. Rechaerges instuntly iff taerget fue-a haed mure-a Heaelt thun yuoo.

1069.name: Taeste-a ooff Paeeen
1069.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is beloo 50% Heaelt, yuoo gaeeen 30...150 Heaelt.
1069.concise: Spell. Heaels yuoo fur 30...150. Nu iffffect unless taerget fue-a is beloo 50% Heaelt.

1070.name: Deffeele-a Inchuntments
1070.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues taeke-a 6...60 shaedoo daemaege-a und 4...20 shaedoo daemaege-a fur iaech inchuntment oon zeem.
1070.concise: Spell. Deaels 6...60 daemaege-a tu taerget und neaerby fues. Deaels 4...20 mure-a daemaege-a fur iaech inchuntment oon zeem.

1071.name: Sheefers ooff Dreaed
1071.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10...40 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a is stroock fur culd daemaege-a vheele-a useeng a skeell, thaet fue-a is interroopted und yuoo luse-a 8...3 Inergy oor Sheefers ooff Dreaed inds.
1071.concise: Hex Spell. (10...40 secunds.) Culd daemaege-a interroopts taerget fue-a's skeells. Interroopshun cust: yuoo luse-a 8...3 Inergy oor thees hex inds.

1075.name: Faempureec Svaerm
1075.description: Spell. Faempureec Svaerm steaels up tu 15...60 Heaelt frum up tu three-a fues in zee aerea.
1075.concise: Spell. Steaels 15...60 Heaelt. Heets 2 aeddeeshunael fues in zee aerea.

1076.name: Bluud Dreenker
1076.description: Spell. Iff yuoor Heaelt is aebufe-a 90%, yuoo begeen Bleedeeng fur 6 secunds. Steael up tu 20...65 Heaelt frum taerget fue-a.
1076.concise: Spell. Steaels 20...65 Heaelt. Yuoo begeen Bleedeeng (6 secunds) iff yuoor Heaelt is aebufe-a 90%.

1077.name: Faempureec Beete-a
1077.description: Skeell. Tuooch taerget fue-a tu steael up tu 29...74 Heaelt.

1078.name: Vaelloo's Beete-a
1078.description: Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a taekes 20...58 daemaege-a.

1079.name: Inffeebleeng Tuooch
1079.description: Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a luses 5...65 Heaelt und sooffffers frum Veaekness fur 5...20 secunds.
1079.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Cooses 5...65 Heaelt luss. Inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

1081.name: Teeenaeee's Veend
1081.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...40 culd daemaege-a. Boorneeng fues stroock by Teeenaeee's Veend taeke-a un aeddeeshunael 40...80 daemaege-a und aere-a interroopted.
1081.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...40 culd daemaege-a. Boorneeng fues taeke-a +40...80 daemaege-a und aere-a interroopted. Aelsu streekes aedjaecent.

1082.name: Shuck Aerroo
1082.description: Spell. Send oooot a Shuck Aerroo thaet fleees sveefftly tooaerd taerget fue-a, streekeeng fur 5...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Iff Shuck Aerroo streekes a fue-a sooffffereeng frum Craecked Aermur, yuoo gaeeen 5 Inergy ploos 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 runks ooff Inergy Sturaege-a. Shuck Aerroo haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
1082.concise: Spell. Raepeed prujecteele-a: deaels 5...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Gaeeen 5 Inergy ploos 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 runks ooff Inergy Sturaege-a iff yuoo heet a fue-a sooffffereeng frum Craecked Aermur. 25% aermur penetraeshun.

1083.name: Unsteaedy Gruoond
1083.description: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo creaete-a Unsteaedy Gruoond aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur 5 secunds, neaerby fues taeke-a 10...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund. Aettaeckeeng fues stroock by Unsteaedy Gruoond aere-a knucked doon.
1083.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 10...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund (5 secunds) und cooses knuck-doon tu aettaeckeeng fues. Heets fues neaer taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1084.name: Sleefer Aermur
1084.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo haefe-a 25...50% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks und vhenefer yuoo aere-a zee taerget ooff a husteele-a spell oor aettaeck oone-a neaerby fue-a is stroock fur 5...35 iaert daemaege-a.
1084.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 25...50% chunce-a tu bluck. Deaels 5...35 iaert daemaege-a tu oone-a neaerby fue-a vhenefer yuoo aere-a zee taerget ooff a husteele-a spell oor aettaeck.

1085.name: Aesh Blaest
1085.description: Hex Spell. Taerget und aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 35...65 iaert daemaege-a. Boorneeng fues stroock by Aesh Blaest aere-a hexed fur 5 secunds und haefe-a a 20...75% chunce-a tu meess veet aettaecks.
1085.concise: Hex Spell. Deaels 35...65 iaert daemaege-a. Boorneeng fues aere-a hexed fur 5 secunds und meess 20...75% ooff aettaecks. Aelsu streekes aedjaecent.

1086.name: Draegun's Stump
1086.description: Spell. Yuoo infuke-a a Draegun's Stump aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Aell fues neaer thees lucaeshun aere-a knucked doon und aere-a stroock fur 26...100 iaert daemaege-a.
1086.concise: Spell. Deaels 26...100 iaert daemaege-a. Cooses knuck-doon. Aelsu heets fues neaer thees fue-a.

1088.name: Secund Veend
1088.description: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy und 5 Heaelt fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy restreected by Oofercaest. Yuoo luse-a aell inchuntments.
1088.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo gaeeen 1 Inergy und 5 Heaelt fur iaech pueent ooff Oofercaest. Yuoo luse-a aell inchuntments. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1090.name: Smuldereeng Imbers
1090.description: Hex Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 10...70 fure-a daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, thaet fue-a is hexed veet Smuldereeng Imbers fur 3 secunds und taekes 5...25 aeddeeshunael fure-a daemaege-a iaech secund. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1090.concise: Hex Spell. Deaels 10...70 fure-a daemaege-a tu taerget. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, fue-a is hexed fur 3 secunds, taekeeng 5...25 fure-a daemaege-a iaech secund.

1091.name: Duooble-a Draegun
1091.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Infuke-a zee pooer ooff zee Draegun. Fur 8 secunds, yuoo und taerget aelly aere-a inchunted veet Duooble-a Draegun. Aedjaecent fues aere-a deaelt 10...40 fure-a daemaege-a iaech secund. Aeddeeshunaelly, vhee yuoo oor yuoor aelly use-a skeells thaet taerget a fue-a, thaet fue-a is set oon fure-a fur 1...4 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1091.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (8 secunds.) Inchunts yuoo und taerget aelly. Aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...40 fure-a daemaege-a iaech secund. Skeells thaet taerget a fue-a aelsu inffleect Boorneeng (1...4 secunds).

1093.name: Teeenaeee's Heaet
1093.description: Vaerd Spell. Plaece-a a vaerd ooff Teeenaeee's Heaet aet yuoor lucaeshun fur 10...15 secunds. Fues veetheen zee vaerd sooffffer 2...5 heaelt degeneraeshun. Veaekened fues aettaeck 33% slooer. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 20 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1093.concise: Vaerd Spell. (10...15 secunds.) Cooses -2...5 heaelt degeneraeshun. Veaekened fues in zee vaerd aettaeck 33% slooer. Deesaebled fur 20 secunds.

1094.name: Breaet ooff Fure-a
1094.description: Spell. Creaete-a Breaet ooff Fure-a aet taerget fue-a's coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 5 secunds, fues aedjaecent tu thaet lucaeshun aere-a stroock fur 10...40 fure-a daemaege-a iaech secund.
1094.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...40 fure-a daemaege-a iaech secund (5 secunds). Heets fues aedjaecent tu taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun.

1095.name: Staer Boorst
1095.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget tuooched fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea aere-a stroock fur 7...112 fure-a daemaege-a und set oon fure-a fur 1...4 secunds. Fur iaech fue-a yuoo heet, gaeeen 2 Inergy. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1095.concise: Ileete-a Tuooch Spell. Deaels 7...112 fure-a daemaege-a. Inffleects Boorneeng (1...4 secunds). Gaeeen 2 Inergy fur iaech fue-a stroock. Aelsu heets fues in zee aerea. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1096.name: Glyph ooff Issence-a
1096.description: Glyph. Fur 15 secunds, yuoor next spell caests instuntly boot cooses yuoo tu luse-a aell Inergy.
1096.concise: Glyph. (15 secunds.) Yuoor next spell caests instuntly. Yuoo luse-a aell Inergy.

1097.name: Teeenaeee's Preesun
1097.description: Hex Spell. Fur 1...8 secunds, taerget fue-a's legs aere-a incaesed in ice-a, cooseeng zee fue-a tu mufe-a 66% slooer. Iff thaet fue-a haes Craecked Aermur, zee cheell seeps thruoogh cooseeng 5...9 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
1097.concise: Hex Spell. (1...8 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 66% slooer. Fues veet Craecked Aermur haefe-a 5...9 Heaelt degeneraeshun.

1098.name: Murrur ooff Ice-a
1098.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Shaetter a Murrur ooff Ice-a. Aell fues neaer yuoo und taerget aelly taeke-a 15...70 culd daemaege-a und mufe-a 66% slooer fur 2...6 secunds. Iff yuoo streeke-a a fue-a hexed veet Vaeter Maegeec, Murrur ooff Ice-a rechaerges 50% faester.
1098.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Deaels 15...70 culd daemaege-a und sloos fues by 66% (2...6 secunds). Heets fues neaer yuoo und taerget aelly. Rechaerges 50% faester iff it heets a fue-a hexed veet Vaeter Maegeec.

1099.name: Teeenaeee's Crystaels
1099.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 20...40 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a haes a Vaeter Maegeec hex, thees spell streekes taerget und neaerby fues fur un aeddeeshunael 20...40 daemaege-a, und neaerby fues aelsu sooffffer Craecked Aermur fur 5...15 secunds.
1099.concise: Spell. Deaels 20...40 daemaege-a tu taerget. Deaels +20...40 mure-a daemaege-a und cooses Craecked Aermur (5...15 secunds) neaerby iff thaet fue-a haed a Vaeter Maegeec hex.

1113.name: Kureen's Vraet
1113.description: Spell. Fur 5 secunds, fues aedjaecent tu zee lucaeshun in vheech zee spell vaes caest taeke-a 8...32 huly daemaege-a iaech secund.
1113.concise: Spell. Deaels 8...32 huly daemaege-a iaech secund (5 secunds). Heets fues aedjaecent tu yuoor ineeteeael lucaeshun.

1114.name: Spureet Bund
1114.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8 secunds, vhenefer taerget aelly taekes mure-a thun 50 daemaege-a frum zee next 10 aettaecks oor spells, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 30...90 Heaelt.
1114.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8 secunds.) Heaels fur 30...90 vhenefer taerget aelly taekes mure-a thun 50 daemaege-a. Inds aeffter thees aelly taekes daemaege-a frum 10 aettaecks oor spells.

1115.name: Aeur ooff Inchuntment
1115.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, inchuntments caest oon taerget oozeer aelly cust 10 less Inergy (meeneemoom 1 Inergy).
1115.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (4...10 secunds.) Inchuntments caest oon taerget aelly cust 10 less Inergy (meeneemoom 1 Inergy). Cunnut selff-taerget.

1117.name: Heaefee's Deleeght
1117.description: Spell. Heaels yuoo und paerty members veetheen iaershut fur 15...60 pueents.
1117.concise: Spell. Heaels yuoo und paerty members veetheen iaershut fur 15...60.

1118.name: Heaeleeng Boorst
1118.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 20...120. Aell paerty members in iaershut ooff yuoor taerget gaeeen Heaelt iqooael tu zee Deefeene-a Faefur bunoos frum thees spell. Yuoor Smeeteeng Praeyers aere-a deesaebled fur 20 secunds.
1118.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Heaels fur 20...120. Paerty members in iaershut ooff yuoor taerget gaeeen Heaelt iqooael tu zee Deefeene-a Faefur bunoos. Deesaebles yuoor Smeeteeng Praeyers (20 secunds).

1119.name: Kaereee's Heaeleeng Curcle-a
1119.description: Spell. Heael yuoorselff und aell aedjaecent creaetoores fur 30...180 pueents.
1119.concise: Spell. Heaels yuoo fur 30...180. Aelsu heaels aedjaecent creaetoores.

1120.name: Jaemeee's Gaeze-a
1120.description: Spell. Heael taerget oozeer aelly fur 35...180 Heaelt. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1121.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 15...150. Deesaebles yuoor oozeer Heaeleeng Praeyers skeells (10...5 secunds). Cunnut selff-taerget.

1123.name: Leeffe-a Sheaet
1123.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Remufe-a 0...2 cundeeshuns frum taerget aelly. Fur 8 secunds, zee next teeme-a thaet aelly vuoold taeke-a daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael, thaet aelly gaeeens thaet aemuoont ooff Heaelt insteaed (maexeemoom 20...100).
1123.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (8 secunds.) Cunferts zee next incumeeng daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael (maexeemoom 20...100) tu heaeleeng. Ineeteeael iffffect: Remufes 0...2 cundeeshuns.

1126.name: Impaetheec Remufael

1126.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Remufes oone-a cundeeshun und hex frum taerget aelly und yuoorselff, und heaels fur 50. Cunnut selff-taerget.

1128.concise: Haelff Runge-a Spell. Resoorrects taerget paerty member aet yuoor coorrent Heaelt und veet 5...35% Inergy.

1129.name: Vurd ooff Censoore-a

1129.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 30...130 huly daemaege-a. +20 rechaerge-a teeme-a iff taerget fue-a is beloo 50% Heaelt.

1130.name: Speaer ooff Leeght

1130.concise: Spell. Prujecteele-a: deaels 26...56 huly daemaege-a. Deaels 15...60 mure-a daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is aettaeckeeng.

1131.name: Stunesuool Streeke-a

1131.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Deaels 10...55 huly daemaege-a. Deaels 10...55 mure-a huly daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is knucked-doon.

1133.name: Droonkee Bloo

Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a und yuoor taerget sooffffers frum oone-a ooff zee fullooeeng cundeeshuns: Deep Vuoond (fur 20 secunds), Veaekness (fur 20 secunds), Bleedeeng (fur 25 secunds), oor Creeppled (fur 15 secunds). Aeffter maekeeng a Droonkee Bloo, yuoo aere-a knucked doon.
1133.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Inffleects oone-a ooff zee fullooeeng rundum cundeeshuns: Deep Vuoond (20 secunds), Veaekness (20 secunds), Bleedeeng (25 secunds), oor Creeppled (15 secunds). Yuoo aere-a knucked-doon.

1135.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +1...30 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a unless yuoo aere-a in a stunce-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1136.name: Penetraeteeng Chup
1136.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...25 daemaege-a. Thees aexe-a aettaeck haes 20% aermur penetraeshun.
1136.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...25 daemaege-a. 20% aermur penetraeshun.

1137.name: Yetee Smaesh
1137.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. Aettaeck aell aedjaecent fues. Iff thees aettaeck streekes a fue-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun, thaet fue-a is knucked doon. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Haemmer Maestery 4 oor less.)
1137.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Aettaeck aell aedjaecent fues. Knucks doon fues sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun. Yuoo luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Haemmer Maestery is 5 oor mure-a.

1141.name: "Yuoo Veell Deee-a!"

1141.concise: Shuoot. Yuoo gaeeen 1...3 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Nu iffffect unless taerget fue-a is under 90% Heaelt.

1142.name: Oospeeceeuoos Paerry

1142.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (8 secunds.) Blucks oone-a aettaeck. Ind iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 1...4 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.

1144.name: Seelferveeng Slaesh

1146.name: Shufe-a

1146.concise: Ileete-a Tuooch Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a, zeeur stunce-a inds, und zeey aere-a knucked doon.

1191.name: Soondereeng Aettaeck
1191.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Soondereeng Aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...25 daemaege-a und thees aettaeck haes 10% aermur penetraeshun.
1191.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...25 daemaege-a. 10% aermur penetraeshun. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1192.name: Zujoon's Shut
1192.description: Boo Aettaeck. Shuut un aerroo thaet haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a, boot streekes fur +10...40 daemaege-a.
1192.concise: Haelff Runge-a Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a.

1194.name: Predaetury Bund
1194.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...20 secunds, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettaecks 25% faester und heaels yuoo fur 1...31 Heaelt veet iaech sooccessffool aettaeck.
1194.concise: Shuoot. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoor pet aettaecks 25% faester und yuoo gaeeen 1...31 Heaelt vhenefer yuoor pet maekes a sooccessffool aettaeck.

1195.name: Heael aes Oone-a
1195.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 15 secunds, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun steaels 1...20 Heaelt vhenefer it heets veet un aettaeck. Yuoo und yuoor cumpuneeun aere-a but heaeled fur 20...104 Heaelt. Iff yuoor cumpuneeun is deaed, it's resoorrected veet 50% Heaelt. Iff yuoo haefe-a thees skeell iqooeepped, yuoor cumpuneeun veell traefel veet yuoo.
1195.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (15 secunds.) Yuoor pet's aettaecks steael 1...20 Heaelt. Ineeteeael iffffect: heaels yuoo und yuoor pet fur 20...104; resoorrects yuoor pet (50% Heaelt) iff deaed. Iff yuoo haefe-a thees skeell iqooeepped, yuoor pet veell traefel veet yuoo.

1196.name: Zujoon's Haeste-a
1196.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a a 27...75% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng prujecteeles. Zujoon's Haeste-a inds iff yuoo aettaeck.
1196.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a 27...75% chunce-a tu bluck prujecteeles. Inds iff yuoo aettaeck.

1197.name: Needleeng Shut
1197.description: Boo Aettaeck. Needleeng Shut streekes fur oonly 10...30 daemaege-a und mufes faester thun nurmael. Iff Needleeng Shut streekes a fue-a beloo 50% Heaelt, Needleeng Shut rechaerges instuntly. Yuoor oozeer aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 2 secunds.
1197.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Faest-mufeeng aerroo. Deaels 10...30 daemaege-a. Rechaerges instuntly iff taerget fue-a is beloo 50% Heaelt. Yuoor oozeer aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled (2 secunds).

1198.name: Bruaed Heaed Aerroo

1199.description: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. Fur 10...35 secunds, yuoor aerroos streeke-a fur +6...20 daemaege-a iff zeey heet und coose-a Bleedeeng fur 10...20 secunds iff zeey aere-a Blucked.

1200.name: Aercher's Seegnet

1201.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is caesteeng a spell.

1202.name: Inraeged Loonge-a
1202.description: Ileete-a Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts un Inraeged Loonge-a thaet aeppleees a Deep Vuoond tu taerget fue-a fur 5...20 secunds und deaels +10...50 daemaege-a.
1202.concise: Ileete-a Pet Aettaeck. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) und deaels +10...50 daemaege-a.

1203.name: Besteeael Mooleeng
1203.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Besteeael Mooleeng thaet deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff zee aettaeck streekes a knucked-doon fue-a, thaet fue-a is Daezed fur 4...10 secunds.
1203.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Inffleects Daezed cundeeshun (4...10 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is knucked-doon.

1205.name: Pueesunuoos Beete-a
1205.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Pueesunuoos Beete-a thaet Pueesuns taerget fue-a fur 5...20 secunds.
1205.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

1206.name: Puoonce-a
1206.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun's next aettaeck is a Puoonce-a thaet deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff zee aettaeck streekes a mufeeng fue-a, thaet fue-a is knucked doon.
1206.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is mufeeng.

1209.name: Besteeael Foory
1209.description: Stunce-a. Aell yuoor nun-aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 5 secunds. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 25% faester.
1209.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 25% faester. Yuoor nun-aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled (5 secunds).

1211.name: Feeper's Nest
1211.description: Traep. Creaete-a a Feeper's Nest. Vhee it is treeggered, aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 5...35 peeerceeng daemaege-a und becume-a Pueesuned fur 5...20 secunds. Feeper's Nest ixpures aeffter 90 secunds. Thees Traep is iaeseely interroopted.
1211.concise: Traep. (90 secunds.) Aeffffects neaerby fues. Deaels 5...35 peeerceeng daemaege-a. Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Iaeseely interroopted.

1212.name: Iqooeenux
1212.description: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Spells caest veetheen its runge-a thaet coose-a Oofercaest coose-a un aeddeeshunael 10 Oofercaest. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...240 secunds.
1212.concise: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...240 secund leeffespun). Oofercaest-cooseeng spells caest veetheen runge-a coose-a un aeddeeshunael 10 Oofercaest.

1213.name: Trunqooeeleety
1213.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Inchuntments caest by nun-spureet creaetoores veetheen its runge-a ixpure-a 20...50% faester. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...120 secunds.
1213.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (15...120 secund leeffespun). Inchuntments ixpure-a 20...50% faester oon creaetoores in runge-a. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

1215.name: Claemur ooff Suools
1215.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues taeke-a 10...65 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet oor huldeeng a boondle-a item, yuoo gaeeen 10 Inergy.
1215.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 10...65 leeghtneeng daemaege-a tu taerget und neaerby fues. Yuoo gaeeen 10 Inergy iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet oor huldeeng a boondle-a item.

1217.name: Reetooael Lurd
1217.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 5...35 secunds, yuoor Reetooaeleest aettreebootes aere-a buusted by 2...4 fur yuoor next skeell. Iff thaet skeell is a Beendeeng Reetooael, it rechaerges 10...60% faester und Reetooael Lurd rechaerges instuntly.
1217.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (5...35 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +2...4 tu aell Reetooaeleest aettreebootes fur yuoor next skeell. Iff thaet skeell is a Beendeeng Reetooael, it rechaerges 10...60% faester und Reetooael Lurd rechaerges instuntly.

1218.name: Crooel Vaes Daeushee
1218.description: Item Spell. Huld Daeushee's aeshes fur up tu 15...60 secunds. Vheele-a yuoo huld hees aeshes, aell Reetooaeleest skeells haefe-a 10% aermur penetraeshun. Vhee yuoo drup hees aeshes, aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 15...85 leeghtneeng daemaege-a.
1218.concise: Item Spell. (15...60 secunds.) Yuoor Reetooaeleest skeells haefe-a 10% aermur penetraeshun. Drup iffffect: deaels 15...85 leeghtneeng daemaege-a tu aell neaerby fues. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1219.name: Prutecteefe-a Vaes Kaeulaeee
1219.description: Item Spell. Huld Kaeulaeee's aeshes fur up tu 15...60 secunds. Vheele-a yuoo huld hees aeshes, yuoo gaeeen 20 aermur. Vhee yuoo drup hees aeshes, aell paerty members aere-a heaeled fur 20...95 Heaelt.
1219.concise: Item Spell. (15...60 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +20 aermur. Drup iffffect: aell paerty members aere-a heaeled fur 20...95. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1220.name: Aettooned Vaes Sungkaeee
1220.description: Ileete-a Item Spell. Huld Sungkaeee's aeshes fur up tu 45 secunds. Vheele-a yuoo huld her aeshes, yuoor spells und beendeeng reetooaels cust -5...50% ooff zee baese-a Inergy tu caest. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1220.concise: Ileete-a Item Spell. (45 secunds.) Yuoor spells und beendeeng reetooaels cust -5...50% ooff zee baese-a Inergy.

1221.name: Reseeleeent Vaes Xeeku
1221.description: Item Spell. Huld Xeeku's aeshes fur up tu 5...20 secunds. Fur iaech hex oor cundeeshun yuoo aere-a sooffffereeng frum vheele-a huldeeng her aeshes, yuoo gaeeen +3 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Vhee yuoo drup her aeshes, yuoo luse-a 1...4 cundeeshuns. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1221.concise: Item Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +3 Heaelt regeneraeshun fur iaech hex oor cundeeshun oon yuoo. Drup iffffect: yuoo luse-a 1...4 cundeeshuns.

1222.name: Leefely Vaes Naeumeee
1222.description: Item Spell. Huld Naeumeee's aeshes fur up tu 45 secunds. Vhee yuoo drup her aeshes, aell paerty members in zee aerea aere-a resoorrected veet 15...75% Heaelt und zeru Inergy.
1222.concise: Item Spell. (45 secunds.) Drup iffffect: resoorrects paerty members in zee aerea (15...75% Heaelt und zeru Inergy).

1223.name: Ungooeeshed Vaes Leengvaeh
1223.description: Item Spell. Huld Leengvaeh's aeshes fur up tu 10...60 secunds. Vheele-a yuoo huld her aeshes, yuoor Reetooaeleest hexes cust 1...5 less inergy und laest 50% lunger. Vhee yuoo drup her aeshes aell yuoor Reetooaeleest hexes aere-a rechaerged.
1223.concise: Item Spell. (10...60 secunds.) Yuoor Reetooaeleest hexes cust 1...5 less inergy und laest 50% lunger. Drup iffffect: aell yuoor Reetooaeleest hexes aere-a rechaerged.

1224.name: Draev Spureet
1224.description: Spell. Telepurt taerget aelleeed spureet tu yuoor lucaeshun.
1224.concise: Spell. Telepurts taerget aelleeed spureet tu yuoor lucaeshun.

1225.name: Chunneled Streeke-a
1225.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 5...95 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Thaet fue-a is stroock fur un aeddeeshunael 5...35 leeghtneeng daemaege-a iff yuoo aere-a huldeeng un item.
1225.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...95 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Deaels 5...35 aeddeeshunael leeghtneeng daemaege-a iff yuoo aere-a huldeeng un item.

1226.name: Spureet Buun Streeke-a
1226.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 20...65 leeghtneeng daemaege-a, und aell spureets yuoo cuntrul veetheen iaershut gaeeen 20...65 Heaelt.
1226.concise: Spell. Deaels 20...65 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Spureets yuoo cuntrul veetheen iaershut gaeeen 20...65 Heaelt.

1227.name: Issence-a Streeke-a
1227.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 15...60 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Iff uny spureets aere-a veetheen iaershut, yuoo gaeeen 1...9 Inergy.
1227.concise: Spell. Deaels 15...60 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 1...9 Inergy iff uny spureets aere-a veetheen iaershut.

1228.name: Spureet Seephun
1228.description: Spell. Zee spureet clusest tu yuoo luses aell Inergy. Yuoo gaeeen 30...60% ooff thaet Inergy.
1228.concise: Spell. Zee spureet clusest tu yuoo luses aell Inergy. Yuoo gaeeen 30...60% ooff thaet Inergy.

1229.name: Ixpluseefe-a Groot
1229.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 15...60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo creaete-a a creaetoore-a, up tu 5 fues neaer thaet creaetoore-a aere-a stroock fur 20...65 leeghtneeng daemaege-a.
1229.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (15...60 secunds.) Deaels 20...65 leeghtneeng daemaege-a iaech teeme-a yuoo creaete-a a creaetoore-a tu 5 fue-as neaer thaet creaetoore-a.

1230.name: Buun ooff Creaeshun
1230.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 15...60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo creaete-a a creaetoore-a, yuoo gaeeen 5...50 Heaelt und 1...6 Inergy.
1230.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (15...60 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 5...50 Heaelt und 1...6 Inergy vhenefer yuoo creaete-a a creaetoore-a.

1231.name: Spureet Chunneleeng
1231.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 12 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +1...6 Inergy regeneraeshun. Vhee yuoo caest thees spell, yuoo gaeeen 3...12 Inergy iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.
1231.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (12 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +1...6 Inergy regeneraeshun. Ineeteeael iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 3...12 Inergy iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.

1232.name: Aermur ooff Unffeeleeng
1232.description: Skeell. Fur 10...35 secunds, yuoor spureets veetheen iaershut taeke-a 50% less daemaege-a und aere-a immoone-a tu creeteecael heets.
1232.concise: Skeell. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoor spureets veetheen iaershut taeke-a 50% less daemaege-a und aere-a immoone-a tu creeteecael heets.

1233.name: Suutheeng Memureees
1233.description: Spell. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 10...100 Heaelt. Iff yuoo aere-a huldeeng un item, yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy.
1233.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 10...100. Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy iff yuoo aere-a huldeeng un item.

1234.name: Mend Budy und Suool
1234.description: Spell. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 20...115 Heaelt. Thaet aelly luses oone-a cundeeshun fur iaech spureet veetheen iaershut.
1234.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 20...115. Remufes oone-a cundeeshun fur iaech spureet veetheen iaershut.

1235.name: Doolled Veaepun
1235.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues cunnut aecheeefe-a a creeteecael heet und deael 3...20 less daemaege-a.
1235.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget (5...20 secunds). Remufes aebeeleety tu lund a creeteecael heet. Redooces daemaege-a by 3...20.

1236.name: Beendeeng Chaeeens
1236.description: Hex Spell. Fur 3 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues mufe-a 90% slooer und taeke-a 1...30 daemaege-a iaech secund vheele-a mufeeng.
