1236.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues neaer yuoor taerget (3 secunds). Zeese-a fues mufe-a 90% slooer und taeke-a 1...30 daemaege-a iaech secund vheele-a mufeeng.

1237.name: Paeeenffool Bund
1237.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10...20 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues aere-a hexed veet Paeeenffool Bund und taeke-a 8...20 daemaege-a vhenefer heet by a spureet's aettaeck.
1237.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues neaer yuoor taerget (10...20 secunds). Spureets du 8...20 mure-a daemaege-a aegaeeenst zeese-a fues.

1238.name: Seegnet ooff Creaeshun
1238.description: Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 4 Inergy fur ifery soommuned creaetoore-a yuoo cuntrul veetheen iaershut (maexeemoom 3...12 Inergy).
1238.concise: Seegnet. Gaeeen 4 Inergy (maexeemoom 3...12) fur iaech soommuned creaetoore-a yuoo cuntrul veetheen iaershut.

1239.name: Seegnet ooff Spureets
1239.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Creaete-a 3 lefel 1...12 spureets. Zeese-a spureets deael 5...20 daemaege-a veet aettaecks und deee-a aeffter 60 secunds.
1239.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Creaetes 3 lefel 1...12 spureets (60 secund leeffespun). Zeese-a spureets deael 5...20 daemaege-a veet aettaecks.

1240.name: Suool Tveesteeng
1240.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 5...45 secunds, yuoor Beendeeng Reetooaels cust 15 less Inergy (meeneemoom 5) und rechaerge-a instuntly. Suool Tveesteeng inds aeffter 1...3 Beendeeng Reetooaels.
1240.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (5...45 secunds.) Yuoor Beendeeng Reetooaels cust 15 less Inergy (meeneemoom 5) und rechaerge-a instuntly. Inds aeffter 1...3 Beendeeng Reetooaels.

1244.name: Ghustly Haeste-a
1244.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...30 secunds, spells yuoo caest vheele-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet rechaerge-a 25% faester.
1244.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...30 secunds.) Spells yuoo caest rechaerge-a 25% faester. Nu iffffect unless yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.

1245.name: Gaeze-a frum Beyund
1245.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 20...65 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet, thaet fue-a is Bleended fur 2...6 secunds.
1245.concise: Spell. Deaels 20...65 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun fur 2...6 secunds iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.

1246.name: Uncesturs' Raege-a
1246.description: Skeell. Fur 1 secunds, nutheeng haeppens. Vhee thees skeell inds, aell fues aedjaecent tu taerget aelly taeke-a 5...110 leeghtneeng daemaege-a.
1246.concise: Skeell. (1 secunds.) Ind Iffffect: deaels 5...110 leeghtneeng daemaege-a tu fues aedjaecent tu taerget aelly.

1247.name: Paeeen
1247.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet. Thees spureet's aettaecks deael 5...30 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...150 secunds.
1247.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (30...150 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...30 daemaege-a.

1249.name: Deesplaecement
1249.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...14 spureet. Aell nun-spureet aelleees veetheen its runge-a haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks. Ifery teeme-a un aettaeck is blucked in thees vaey, thees spureet taekes 60 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.
1249.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...14 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen runge-a haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Bluck iffffect: thees spureet taekes 60 daemaege-a.

1250.name: Preserfaeshun
1250.description: Ileete-a Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...14 spureet. Ifery 4 secunds, thees spureet heaels oone-a nun-spureet aelly in zee aerea fur 10...115 Heaelt. Thees spureet deees aeffter 90 secunds.
1250.concise: Ileete-a Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...14 spureet (90 secund leeffespun). Ifery 4 secunds, thees spureet heaels oone-a nun-spureet aelly fur 10...115.

1251.name: Leeffe-a
1251.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...14 spureet. Vhee thees spureet deees, aell nun-spureet aelleees veetheen its runge-a aere-a heaeled fur 1...7 Heaelt fur iaech secund thees spureet vaes aeleefe-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 20 secunds.
1251.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...14 spureet (20 secund leeffespun). Aeffffects nun-spureet aelleees veetheen runge-a. Ind iffffect: heaels fur 1...7 fur iaech secund thees spureet vaes aeleefe-a.

1252.name: Iaerthbeend
1252.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...14 spureet. Aell nun-spureet fues knucked doon veetheen its runge-a aere-a knucked doon fur aet leaest 3 secunds. Vhenefer thees haeppens, thees spureet luses 50...25 Heaelt. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...45 secunds.
1252.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...14 spureet (15...45 secund leeffespun). Uny teeme-a nun-spureet fues veetheen runge-a aere-a knucked-doon, zeey aere-a knucked doon fur aet leaest 3 secunds. Knuck-doon cust: thees spureet luses 50...25 Heaelt.

1253.name: Bluudsung
1253.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet vhu deees aeffter 30...150 secunds. Aettaecks by thaet spureet steael up tu 5...25 Heaelt.
1253.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (30...150 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks steael 5...25 Heaelt.

1255.name: Vunderloost
1255.description: Ileete-a Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet. Vhenefer thees spureet's aettaeck heets a staeshunaery fue-a, thaet fue-a is knucked doon und zee spureet luses 70...50 Heaelt. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.
1255.concise: Ileete-a Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks aegaeeenst staeshunaery fues coose-a knuck-doon. Knuck-doon cust: thees spureet luses 70...50 Heaelt.

1257.name: Spureet Leeght Veaepun
1257.description: Ileete-a Veaepun Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget aelly gaeeens 5...25 Heaelt per secund und un aeddeeshunael 5...25 Heaelt per secund iff thaet aelly is veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.
1257.concise: Ileete-a Veaepun Spell. (10 secunds.) Taerget aelly gaeeens 5...25 Heaelt iaech secund. 5...25 mure-a heaeleeng per secund vheele-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.

1258.name: Brootael Veaepun
1258.description: Veaepun Spell. Geefe-a taerget aelly a Brootael Veaepun fur 10...40 secunds. Zee beaerer's veaepun streekes fur +5...15 daemaege-a aes lung aes zee beaerer is under nu inchuntments.
1258.concise: Veaepun Spell. (10...40 secunds.) Aettaecks deael +5...15 daemaege-a. Nu iffffect vheele-a taerget aelly is inchunted.

1259.name: Gooeeded Veaepun
1259.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, taerget aelly's aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked.
1259.concise: Veaepun Spell. (4...10 secunds.) Aettaecks aere-a unbluckaeble-a.

1260.name: Meekness
1260.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...30 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea aettaeck 50% slooer.
1260.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues in zee aerea ooff taerget (5...30 secunds). Zeese-a fues aettaeck 50% slooer.

1261.name: Freegeed Aermur
1261.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...25 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +10...40 aermur aegaeeenst physeecael daemaege-a und cunnut be-a set oon fure-a.
1261.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10...25 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +10...40 aermur aegaeeenst physeecael daemaege-a und immooneety tu Boorneeng.

1262.name: Heaeleeng Reeng
1262.description: Spell. Heael aedjaecent creaetoores fur 30...180 Heaelt. Zee caester is nut heaeled.
1262.concise: Spell. Heaels aedjaecent aelleees und fues fur 30...180. Zee caester is nut heaeled.

1263.name: Renoo Leeffe-a
1263.description: Spell. Resoorrect taerget tuooched deaed taerget paerty member veet 50% Heaelt und 5...20% Inergy. Thaet paerty member und aell aelleees veetheen iaershut aere-a heaeled fur 55...130 Heaelt.
1263.concise: Tuooch Spell. Resoorrects taerget paerty member (50% Heaelt und 5...20% Inergy). Heaels aelleees veetheen iaershut fur 55...130.

1264.name: Duum
1264.description: Spell. Streeke-a taerget fue-a fur 10...60 leeghtneeng (maexeemoom 135) daemaege-a fur ifery rechaergeeng beendeeng reetooael yuoo haefe-a.
1264.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...60 leeghtneeng daemaege-a (maexeemoom 135) fur iaech ooff yuoor rechaergeeng beendeeng reetooaels.

1265.name: Veeelder's Buun
1265.description: Spell. Heael taerget aelly fur 15...60 pueents. Iff thaet aelly is under zee iffffects ooff a veaepun spell, Veeelder's Buun heaels fur un aeddeeshunael 15...75 Heaelt.
1265.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 15...60. Heaels fur 15...75 mure-a iff thees aelly is under a Veaepun spell.

1266.name: Suutheeng
1266.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet. Aell fues veetheen its runge-a taeke-a tveece-a aes lung tu booeeld aedrenaeleene-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...45 secunds.
1266.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (15...45 secund leeffespun). Booeeldeeng aedrenaeleene-a taekes tveece-a aes lung fur fues veetheen runge-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1267.name: Feetael Veaepun
1267.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 5...30 secunds, taerget aelly haes a Feetael Veaepun und haes +40...175 maexeemoom Heaelt.

1268.name: Veaepun ooff Qooeeckeneeng
1268.description: Ileete-a Veaepun Spell. Fur 5...25 secunds, taerget aelly haes a Veaepun ooff Qooeeckeneeng, und spells und beendeeng reetooaels rechaerge-a 33% faester.
1268.concise: Ileete-a Veaepun Spell. (5...25 secunds.) Spells und beendeeng reetooaels rechaerge-a 33% faester.

1269.name: Seegnet ooff Raege-a
1269.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a taekes 5...50 huly daemaege-a und +5...10 huly daemaege-a fur iaech aedrenaeleene-a skeell thaet fue-a haes.
1269.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 5...50 huly daemaege-a. Deaels 5...10 mure-a huly daemaege-a fur iaech ooff taerget fue-a's aedrenaeleene-a skeells.

1333.name: Ixtend Cundeeshuns
1333.description: Ileete-a Spell. Spreaed aell cundeeshuns frum taerget fue-a tu aell fues neaer yuoor taerget. Zee dooraeshuns ooff thuse-a cundeeshuns aere-a increaesed by 5...100% (maexeemoom 30 secunds).
1333.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Spreaed aell cundeeshuns frum taerget fue-a tu aell fues neaer yuoor taerget. Thuse-a dooraeshuns ooff thuse-a cundeeshuns aere-a increaesed by 5...100% (maexeemoom 30 secunds).

1334.name: Hypuchundreea
1334.description: Spell. Trunsffer aell cundeeshuns frum aell fues in zee aerea tu taerget fue-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1334.concise: Spell. Trunsffer aell cundeeshuns frum fues in zee aerea tu taerget fue-a.

1335.name: Vaestrel's Demeese-a
1335.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5 secunds, taerget fue-a is hexed veet Vaestrel's Demeese-a. Iaech secund vheele-a hexed, taerget fue-a und aell fues aedjaecent tu thaet fue-a taeke-a 1...10 daemaege-a und un aeddeeshunael 1...10 daemaege-a fur iaech secund thees spell is in iffffect. Thees hex inds premaetoorely iff taerget fue-a uses a skeell.
1335.concise: Hex Spell. (5 secunds.) Iaech secund vheele-a hexed, taerget fue-a und aell fues aedjaecent tu thaet fue-a taeke-a 1...10 daemaege-a. Fues taeke-a +1...10 daemaege-a iaech secund thees hex is in iffffect. Inds iaerly iff taerget fue-a uses a skeell.

1336.name: Spureetooael Paeeen
1336.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a. Aell husteele-a soommuned creaetoores in zee aerea ooff thaet fue-a taeke-a 25...125 daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1336.concise: Spell. Deaels 15...75 daemaege-a. Deaels 25...125 daemaege-a tu husteele-a soommuned creaetoores in zee aerea ooff taerget fue-a.

1337.name: Draeeen Delooseeuns
1337.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a Mesmer hex frum taerget fue-a. Iff a hex vaes remufed in thees vaey, thaet fue-a luses 1...5 Inergy und yuoo gaeeen 4 Inergy fur iaech pueent lust.
1337.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a Mesmer hex frum taerget fue-a. Cooses 1...5 Inergy luss. Yuoo gaeeen 4 Inergy fur iaech pueent lust. Nu iffffect unless a hex vaes remufed.

1338.name: Perseestence-a ooff Memury
1338.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, vhenefer a spell yuoo caest is interroopted, thaet spell is instuntly rechaerged. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1338.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoor interroopted spells rechaerge-a instuntly.

1339.name: Symbuls ooff Inspuraeshun
1339.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 6...40 secunds, thees skeell becumes zee Ileete-a ooff taerget fue-a. Ileete-a skeells yuoo caest use-a yuoor Faest Caesteeng aettreeboote-a insteaed ooff zeeur nurmael aettreebootes.
1339.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (6...40 secunds.) Thees skeell becumes zee Ileete-a ooff taerget fue-a. Ileete-a skeells use-a yuoor Faest Caesteeng aettreeboote-a insteaed ooff zeeur nurmael aettreebootes.

1340.name: Symbuleec Celereety
1340.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 36...60 secunds, aell ooff yuoor seegnets use-a yuoor Faest Caesteeng aettreeboote-a insteaed ooff zeeur nurmael aettreebootes.
1340.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (36...60 secunds.) Yuoor seegnets use-a yuoor Faest Caesteeng aettreeboote-a.

1341.name: Froostraeshun
1341.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a caests spells 50% slooer und taekes 5...50 daemaege-a vhenefer interroopted. Iff a skeell is interroopted, Froostraeshun deaels duooble-a daemaege-a.
1341.concise: Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Cooses 50% slooer spell caesteeng. Taerget fue-a taekes 5...50 daemaege-a vhenefer interroopted. Deaels duooble-a daemaege-a oon skeell interroopt.

1342.name: Teaese-a
1342.description: Ileete-a Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is useeng a skeell, thaet fue-a und oozeer fues in zee aerea aere-a interroopted und yuoo steael 0...5 Inergy frum aell fues in zee aerea.
1342.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Interroopts a skeell. Interroopshun iffffect: aelsu interroopts oozeer fues in zee aerea, und yuoo steael 0...5 Inergy frum aell fues in zee aerea.

1343.name: Izeer Phuntum
1343.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a haes -1 Inergy degeneraeshun. Iff thees hex is remufed premaetoorely, thaet fue-a luses 1...5 Inergy.
1343.concise: Hex Spell. (10 secunds.) Cooses -1 Inergy degeneraeshun. Cooses 1...5 Inergy luss iff thees hex inds iaerly.

1344.name: Veb ooff Deesroopshun
1344.description: Hex Spell. Interroopt taerget fue-a. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a is hexed veet Veb ooff Deesroopshun. Vhee thees hex inds, thaet fue-a is interroopted aegaeeen.
1344.concise: Hex Spell. (10 secunds.) Ineeteeael iffffect: interroopts a skeell. Ind iffffect: interroopts a skeell.

1345.name: Inchunter's Cunoondroom
1345.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a caests inchuntments 100...200% slooer. Iff taerget fue-a is nut under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment vhee thees hex is aeppleeed, thaet fue-a taekes 10...100 daemaege-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a.
1345.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Cooses 100...200% slooer inchuntment caesteeng (10 secunds). Ineeteeael iffffect: iff taerget fue-a is nut inchunted deaels 10...100 daemaege-a tu taerget und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues.

1346.name: Seegnet ooff Illooseeuns
1346.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Yuoor next 1...3 nun-Illooseeun spells use yuoor Illooseeun aettreeboote-a insteaed ooff their nurmael aettreeboote-a.
1346.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Yuoor next 1...3 nun-Illooseeun spells use yuoor Illooseeun aettreeboote-a insteaed ooff their nurmael aettreeboote-a.

1347.name: Deeschaerge-a Inchuntment
1347.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Iff thaet fue-a is hexed, thees skeell rechaerges 20...50% faester.
1347.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. 20...50% faester rechaerge-a iff thaet fue-a vaes hexed.

1348.name: Hex Iaeter Furtex
1348.description: Ileete-a Spell. Remufe-a a hex frum taerget aelly. Iff a hex is remufed in thees vaey, fues in zee aerea ooff thaet aelly taeke-a 30...90 daemaege-a und luse-a oone-a inchuntment.
1348.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Remufes oone-a hex frum taerget aelly. Remufael iffffect: deaels 30...90 daemaege-a und remufes oone-a inchuntment frum fues in zee aerea ooff thees aelly.

1349.name: Murrur ooff Deesenchuntment
1349.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Aell ooff thaet fue-a's paerty members aelsu luse-a thaet saeme-a inchuntment.
1349.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Thaet fue-a's paerty members aelsu luse-a thees inchuntment.

1350.name: Seemple-a Theeefery
1350.description: Ileete-a Spell. Interroopt taerget fue-a's aecshun. Iff thaet aecshun vaes a skeell, thaet skeell is deesaebled fur 5...20 secunds, und Seemple-a Theeefery is replaeced by thaet skeell.
1350.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: Iff a skeell vaes interroopted, thaet skeell is deesaebled und Seemple-a Theeefery becumes thaet skeell (5...20 secunds).

1351.name: Uneemaete-a Shaembleeng Hurrur
1351.description: Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a tu creaete-a a lefel 1...17 shaembleeng hurrur. Vhee zee shaembleeng hurrur deees, it is replaeced by a lefel 0...15 jaegged hurrur thaet cooses Bleedeeng veet iaech ooff its aettaecks.
1351.concise: Spell. Creaetes a lefel 1...17 shaembleeng hurrur. Vhee zee shaembleeng hurrur deees, it is replaeced by a lefel 0...15 jaegged hurrur thaet cooses Bleedeeng veet iaech ooff its aettaecks. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a.

1352.name: Oorder ooff Undeaet
1352.description: Ileete-a Spell. Fur 5 secunds, yuoor meeneeuns deael +3...16 daemaege-a, boot yuoo luse-a 2% ooff yuoor maexeemoom Heaelt vhenefer oone-a ooff yuoor meeneeuns heets veet un aettaeck.
1352.concise: Ileete-a Spell. (5 secunds). Yuoor meeneeuns deael +3...16 daemaege-a. Meeneeun heet iffffect: yuoo luse-a 2% ooff yuoor maexeemoom Heaelt.

1353.name: Pootreed Flesh
1353.description: Spell. Destruy oone-a ooff yuoor taerget uneemaeted undeaed meeneeuns. Aell fues neaer thaet creaetoore-a aere-a Deeseaesed fur 5...15 secunds.
1353.concise: Spell. Destruys oone-a ooff yuoor undeaed serfunts. Inffleects Deeseaesed cundeeshun (5...15 secunds) tu fues neaer thees serfunt.

1354.name: Feaest fur zee Deaed
1354.description: Spell. Destruy taerget uneemaeted undeaed aelly. Aell ooff yuoor oozeer uneemaeted undeaed aelleees aere-a heaeled fur 10...100 Heaelt.
1354.concise: Spell. Destruys oone-a ooff yuoor undeaed serfunts. Heaels yuoor serfunts fur 10...100.

1355.name: Jaegged Bunes
1355.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, vhenefer taerget undeaed serfunt deees, it is replaeced by a lefel 0...15 jaegged hurrur thaet cooses Bleedeeng veet iaech ooff its aettaecks.
1355.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (60 secunds.) Vhee taerget undeaed serfunt deees, it is replaeced by a lefel 0...15 jaegged hurrur thaet inffleects Bleedeeng veet aettaecks.

1356.name: Cuntaegeeun
1356.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo sooffffer frum a noo cundeeshun, aell fues in zee aerea sooffffer frum thaet saeme-a cundeeshun und yuoo saecreeffeece-a 10...5% maexeemoom Heaelt.
1356.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (60 secunds.) Vhenefer yuoo gaeeen a cundeeshun, aell fues in zee aerea gaeeen thaet saeme-a cundeeshun. Yuoo saecreeffeece-a 10...5% maexeemoom Heaelt iaech teeme-a thees haeppens.

1358.name: Ulceruoos Loongs
1358.description: Hex Spell. Fur 10...30 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues sooffffer frum -4 Heaelt degeneraeshun vhee Bleedeeng, und vhenefer zeey use-a a shuoot oor chunt, zeey Bleed fur 5...20 secunds
1358.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues neaer yuoor taerget (10...30 secunds). Cooses -4 Heaelt degeneraeshun tu uny ooff zeese-a fues thaet aere-a Bleedeeng. Inffleects Bleedeeng (5...20 secunds) vhenefer zeese-a fues use-a a shuoot oor chunt.

1359.name: Paeeen ooff Deesenchuntment
1359.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a luses 1...3 inchuntments. Iff un inchuntment vaes lust in thees vaey, thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues luse-a 10...100 Heaelt.
1359.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a luses 1...3 inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues luse-a 10...100 Heaelt.

1360.name: Maerk ooff Foory
1360.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5 secunds, aelleees heetteeng taerget fue-a gaeeen 0...2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Vhee thees hex inds, thaet fue-a sooffffers frum Craecked Aermur fur 1...15 secunds.
1360.concise: Hex Spell. (5 secunds.) Aelleees heetteeng taerget fue-a gaeeen 0...2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Ind iffffect: inffleects Craecked Aermur (1...15 secunds).

1362.name: Curroopt Inchuntment
1362.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Remufe-a oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Iff un inchuntment is remufed in thees vaey, thaet fue-a sooffffers frum -1...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun fur 10 secunds.
1362.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffect: -1...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun (10 secunds).

1363.name: Seegnet ooff Surroo
1363.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is neaer a curpse-a oor haes a deaed pet, thees skeell rechaerges instuntly.
1363.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 15...75 daemaege-a. Rechaerges instuntly iff taerget fue-a is neaer a curpse-a oor haes a deaed pet.

1364.name: Seegnet ooff Sooffffereeng
1364.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Yuoo sooffffer frum Bleedeeng fur 6 secunds. Zee next Necrumuncer skeell thaet taergets a fue-a cooses Bleedeeng fur 2...16 secunds.
1364.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Yuoo Bleed fur 6 secunds. Aeppleees Bleedeeng (2...16 secunds) tu zee taerget ooff yuoor next Necrumuncer skeell.

1365.name: Seegnet ooff Lust Suools
1365.description: Seegnet. Iff taerget fue-a is beloo 50% Heaelt, yuoo gaeeen 10...100 Heaelt und 1...10 Inergy.
1365.concise: Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 10...100 Heaelt und 1...10 Inergy iff taerget fue-a is beloo 50% Heaelt.

1366.name: Vell ooff Daerkness
1366.description: Vell Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 66% heaelt tu creaete-a a Vell ooff Daerkness fur 5...50 secunds. Hexed fues veetheen zee Vell ooff Daerkness meess 50% ooff zee teeme-a.
1366.concise: Vell Spell. (5...50 secunds.) Hexed fues in thees vell haefe-a 50% chunce-a tu meess. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a oor saecreeffeeces 66% heaelt.

1367.name: Bleendeeng Soorge-a
1367.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 5...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a Bleended fur 3...8 secunds. Thees spell haes 25% aermur penetraeshun. Iff thees spell streekes un aettaeckeeng fue-a, aell aedjaecent fues aere-a aelsu stroock und thees spell deaels 50% mure-a daemaege-a.
1367.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 5...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleend oon taerget und aedjaecent fues (3...8 secunds). 25% aermur penetraeshun. Iff taerget vaes aettaeckeeng, aelsu heets aedjaecent fues und deaels 50% mure-a daemaege-a.

1368.name: Cheelleeng Veends
1368.description: Hex Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 30...60 culd daemaege-a. Fur 10 secunds, zee next Vaeter Maegeec hex taergeteeng a hexed fue-a laests 25...100% lunger.
1368.concise: Hex Spell. (10 secunds.) Zee next vaeter hex oon taerget fue-a laests 25...100% lunger. Ineeteeael iffffect: 30...60 culd daemaege-a. Aelsu streekes aedjaecent.

1369.name: Leeghtneeng Bult
1369.description: Spell. Send oooot a Leeghtneeng Bult thaet streekes fur 5...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a iff it heets. Iff Leeghtneeng Bult streekes a mufeeng fue-a, thaet fue-a is stroock fur 5...50 aeddeeshunael leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Thees spell haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
1369.concise: Spell. Prujecteele-a: deaels 5...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Deaels 5...50 mure-a leeghtneeng daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is mufeeng. 25% aermur penetraeshun.

1370.name: Sturm Djeenn's Haeste-a
1370.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...25 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Iaech secund thaet yuoo aere-a mufeeng, yuoo luse-a 1 Inergy. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1370.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10...25 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Luse-a 1 Inergy iaech secund vheele-a mufeeng.

1371.name: Stune-a Streeker
1371.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...30 secunds, vhenefer yuoo taeke-a oor deael ilementael oor physeecael daemaege-a, thaet daemaege-a is cunferted tu iaert daemaege-a.
1371.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...30 secunds.) Cunferts ilementael und physeecael daemaege-a yuoo taeke-a oor deael tu iaert daemaege-a.

1372.name: Sundsturm
1372.description: Ileete-a Spell. Creaete-a a Sundsturm aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur 10 secunds, neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 20...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund und aettaeckeeng fues aere-a stroock fur un aeddeeshunael 10...30 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund.
1372.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 20...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund (10 secunds). Heets fues neaer taerget fue-a's ineeteeael lucaeshun. Heets aettaeckeeng fues fur 10...30 mure-a iaert daemaege-a iaech secund.

1373.name: Stune-a Sheaet
1373.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, yuoo und taerget aelly haefe-a +1...30 aermur und aere-a immoone-a tu creeteecael heets. Vhee yuoo caest thees spell, aell fues neaer yuoo und yuoor taerget taeke-a 15...70 iaert daemaege-a und aere-a Veaekened fur 5...20 secunds.
1373.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Geefes yuoo und taerget aelly +1...30 aermur und immooneety tu creeteecael heets. Ineeteeael iffffect: Fues neaer yuoo und taerget aelly aere-a stroock fur 15...70 iaert daemaege-a und aere-a Veaekened (5...20 secunds).

1374.name: Ibun Haevk
1374.description: Spell. Send a prujecteele-a thaet streekes taerget fue-a fur 10...85 iaert daemaege-a und cooses Veaekness fur 5...15 secunds iff it heets.
1374.concise: Spell. Prujecteele-a: deaels 10...85 iaert daemaege-a und inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun (5...15 secunds). Bork! Bork! Bork!

1375.name: Stunefflesh Oora
1375.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, daemaege-a yuoo receeefe-a is redooced by 1...31, und yuoo aere-a immoone-a tu creeteecael aettaecks.
1375.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Redooces daemaege-a yuoo taeke-a by 1...31, und yuoo aere-a immoone-a tu creeteecael heets.

1376.name: Glyph ooff Resturaeshun
1376.description: Glyph. Fur 15 secunds, yuoor next 2 spells heael yuoo fur 30...105 Heaelt, und yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 150...400% ooff zee Inergy cust ooff iaech spell.
1376.concise: Glyph. (15 secunds.) Yuoor next 2 spells heael yuoo fur 30...105, und yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 150...400% ooff zee Inergy cust ooff iaech spell.

1377.name: Izeer Preesm
1377.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 3 secunds, aell daemaege-a yuoo taeke-a is redooced by 75%. Vhee Izeer Preesm inds, yuoo gaeeen 5...20 Inergy.
1377.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (3 secunds.) Aell daemaege-a yuoo taeke-a is redooced by 75%. Ind iffffect: gaeeen 5...20 Inergy. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1378.name: Maester ooff Maegeec
1378.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 1...61 secunds, aell ooff yuoor ilementael aettreebootes aere-a set tu 8...14, und yuoor ilementael spells retoorn 1 Inergy ploos 30% ooff zeeur cust.
1378.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (1...61 secunds). Yuoor ilementael aettreebootes aere-a set tu 8...14 und ilementael spells retoorn 1 Inergy ploos 30% ooff zeeur cust.

1379.name: Glooeeng Gaeze-a
1379.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 5...50 fure-a daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is oon Fure-a, yuoo gaeeen 5 Inergy ploos 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 runks ooff Inergy Sturaege-a.
1379.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...50 fure-a daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 5 Inergy ploos 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 runks ooff Inergy Sturaege-a iff taerget fue-a is Boorneeng.

1380.name: Saefunnaeh Heaet
1380.description: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo creaete-a Saefunnaeh Heaet aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur 5 secunds, aell neaerby fues taeke-a 5...20 fure-a daemaege-a fur iaech secund thees spell haes beee in iffffect.
1380.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 5...20 fure-a daemaege-a fur iaech secund seence-a caesteeng thees spell (5 secunds). Heets fues neaer taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun.

1381.name: Flaeme-a Djeenn's Haeste-a
1381.description: Inchuntment Spell. Aell aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 15...120 fure-a daemaege-a. Fur 8...14 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Flaeme-a Djeenn's Haeste-a rechaerges 50% faester iff a fue-a vaes stroock by thees spell. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1381.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8...14 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 15...120 fure-a daemaege-a tu fues aedjaecent tu yuoo. Iff yuoo daemaege-a a fue-a veet thees spell, it rechaerges 50% faester.

1382.name: Freezeeng Goost
1382.description: Hex Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is under zee iffffect ooff a Vaeter Maegeec hex, thaet fue-a is stroock fur 20...80 culd daemaege-a. Oozeerveese-a, thaet fue-a mufes 66% slooer fur 1...5 secunds.
1382.concise: Hex Spell. Deaels 20...80 culd daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is hexed veet Vaeter Maegeec. Oozeerveese-a, thees fue-a mufes 66% slooer (1...5 secunds).

1390.name: Joodge-a's Interfenshun
1390.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly receeefes daemaege-a thaet vuoold be-a faetael, zee daemaege-a is negaeted und oone-a neaerby fue-a taekes 30...180 huly daemaege-a.
1390.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Negaetes zee next faetael daemaege-a. Negaeshun iffffect: deaels 30...180 huly daemaege-a tu oone-a fue-a neaer taerget aelly.

1391.name: Sooppurteefe-a Spureet
1391.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...23 secunds, vhenefer taerget aelly taekes daemaege-a vheele-a knucked doon, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 5...50 Heaelt.
1391.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...23 secunds.) Heaels fur 5...50 vhenefer taerget aelly taekes daemaege-a vheele-a knucked-doon.

1392.name: Vaetchffool Heaeleeng
1392.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget aelly gaeeens +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Iff thees skeell inds premaetoorely, thaet aelly gaeeens 30...120 Heaelt.
1392.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Taerget aelly haes +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun und gaeeens 30...120 Heaelt iff thees inchuntment inds iaerly.

1393.name: Heaeler's Buun
1393.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...55 secunds. Heaeleeng Praeyers spells caest 50% faester und heael fur 50% mure-a Heaelt.
1393.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10...55 secunds.) Heaeleeng Praeyers spells caest 50% faester und heael fur 50% mure-a.

1394.name: Heaeler's Cufenunt
1394.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, yuoor Heaeleeng Praeyers spells heael fur 20% less Heaelt, boot cust -1...4 Inergy.
1394.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Yuoor Heaeleeng Praeyers spells cust 1...4 less Inergy. Zeese-a spells heael fur 20% less.

1395.name: Baelthaezaer's Pendooloom
1395.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...25 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly vuoold be-a knucked doon by a fue-a, thaet fue-a is knucked doon insteaed.
1395.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5...25 secunds.) Cooses knuck-doon tu zee next fue-a aettempteeng tu knuck-doon taerget aelly. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1396.name: Vurds ooff Cumffurt
1396.description: Spell. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 20...65 Heaelt und un aeddeeshunael 20...50 Heaelt iff thaet aelly is sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun.
1396.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 20...65. Heaels fur 20...50 mure-a iff taerget aelly haes a cundeeshun.

1397.name: Leeght ooff Deleeferunce-a
1397.description: Ileete-a Spell. Aell paerty members aere-a heaeled fur 5...70 Heaelt.
1397.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Heaels inture-a paerty fur 5...70.

1398.name: Scuoorge-a Inchuntment
1398.description: Hex Spell. Fur 30 secunds, iaech teeme-a taerget fue-a is zee taerget ooff un inchuntment, zee caester ooff thaet inchuntment taekes 15...75 daemaege-a.
1398.concise: Hex Spell. (30 secunds.) Deaels 15...75 daemaege-a tu unyune-a caesteeng un inchuntment oon taerget fue-a.

1399.name: Sheeeld ooff Aebsurpshun
1399.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 3...7 secunds, daemaege-a receeefed by taerget aelly is redooced by 5 iaech teeme-a thaet aelly is heet vheele-a under zee iffffects ooff thees inchuntment.
1399.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (3...7 secunds.) Redooces incumeeng daemaege-a by 5 iaech teeme-a taerget aelly taekes daemaege-a.

1400.name: Refersael ooff Daemaege-a
1400.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly vuoold taeke-a daemaege-a, zee fue-a deaeleeng zee daemaege-a taekes thaet daemaege-a insteaed (maexeemoom 5...75).
1400.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8 secunds.) Negaetes zee next daemaege-a und heets zee suoorce-a fur thaet saeme-a aemuoont (maexeemoom 5...75).

1401.name: Mendeeng Tuooch
1401.description: Spell. Tuooched aelly luses tvu cundeeshuns und is heaeled fur 15...60 Heaelt fur iaech cundeeshun remufed in thees vaey.
1401.concise: Tuooch Spell. Remufes tvu cundeeshuns. Heaels fur 15...60 fur iaech cundeeshun remufed. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1402.name: Creeteecael Chup
1402.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo inffleect +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff thees aettaeck resoolts in a creeteecael heet, taerget fue-a is interroopted.
1402.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Interroopts un aecshun iff yuoo lund a creeteecael heet.

1403.name: Aeguneezeeng Chup
1403.description: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Vhee thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is sooffffereeng frum a Deep Vuoond, yuoo interroopt thaet fue-a's aecshun.
1403.concise: Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Interroopts un aecshun iff taerget fue-a haes a Deep Vuoond.

1404.name: Flaeeel
1404.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...15 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester boot mufe-a 33% slooer.
1404.concise: Stunce-a. (1...15 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Yuoo mufe-a 33% slooer.

1405.name: Chaergeeng Streeke-a
1405.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 1...10 secunds, yuoo roon 33% faester. Yuoor next sooccessffool melee-a heet dues +10...90 daemaege-a und thees stunce-a inds. Thees stunce-a inds iff yuoo use-a a skeell.
1405.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (1...10 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und deael +10...90 daemaege-a veet yuoor next melee-a heet. Inds vhee yuoo heet oor iff yuoo use-a a skeell.

1406.name: Heaedboott
1406.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a taekes 40...100 daemaege-a. Yuoo aere-a Daezed fur 10 secunds.
1406.concise: Ileete-a Tuooch Skeell. Deaels 40...100 daemaege-a. Yuoo aere-a Daezed (10 secunds).

1407.name: Leeun's Cumffurt
1407.description: Skeell. Aell ooff yuoor seegnets aere-a deesaebled fur 12 secunds. Yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 50...110 Heaelt, und yuoo gaeeen 0...3 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.
1407.concise: Skeell. Yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 50...110 und gaeeen 0...3 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Deesaebles yuoor seegnets (12 secunds).

1408.name: Raege-a ooff zee Ntuooka
1408.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Gaeeen 1...7 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Fur 8 secunds, vhenefer yuoo use-a un aedrenael skeell, thaet skeell rechaerges fur 3 secunds.
1408.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. Yuoo gaeeen 1...7 aedrenaeleene-a. Fur 8 secunds, aedrenael skeells haefe-a a 3 secund rechaerge-a vhee used.

1409.name: Mukele-a Smaesh
1409.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a und gaeeen 2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.
1409.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a und yuoo gaeeen 2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.

1410.name: Ooferbeaereeng Smaesh
1410.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +1...20 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is knucked doon, thaet fue-a is Daezed fur 1...8 secunds.
1410.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +1...20 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is knucked doon, zeey aere-a Daezed (1...8 secunds).

1411.name: Seegnet ooff Staemeena
1411.description: Seegnet. Yuoo haefe-a +50...300 maexeemoom Heaelt. Thees seegnet inds iff yuoo sooccessffoolly heet veet un aettaeck. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1411.concise: Seegnet. Yuoo haefe-a +50...300 maexeemoom Heaelt. Inds iff yuoo heet veet un aettaeck.

1412.name: "Yuoo're-a Aell Aelune-a!"
1412.description: Ileete-a Shuoot. Iff taerget fue-a isn't neaer un aelly, thaet fue-a sooffffers frum Creepple-a und Veaekness fur 8 secunds.
1412.concise: Ileete-a Shuoot. Inffleects Creepple-a und Veaekness cundeeshuns (8 secunds). Nu iffffect iff taerget fue-a is neaer oone-a ooff its aelleees.

1413.name: Boorst ooff Aeggresseeun
1413.description: Stunce-a. Fur 2...10 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Vhee thees stunce-a inds, yuoo luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a.
1413.concise: Stunce-a. (2...10 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Ind iffffect: luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a.

1414.name: Inraegeeng Chaerge-a
1414.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...15 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Inraegeeng Chaerge-a inds vhee yuoo sooccessffoolly streeke-a a taerget, aet vheech pueent yuoo gaeeen 0...3 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a iff yuoo heet veet a melee-a aettaeck.
1414.concise: Stunce-a. (5...15 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Gaeeen +0...3 aedrenaeleene-a oon yuoor next melee-a aettaeck. Inds aeffter yuoor next heet.

1415.name: Creeppleeng Slaesh
1415.description: Ileete-a Svurd Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a is Creeppled fur 5...15 secunds und begeens Bleedeeng fur 10...25 secunds.
1415.concise: Ileete-a Svurd Aettaeck. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (5...15 secunds) und Bleedeeng cundeeshun (10...25 secunds).

1416.name: Baerbaeruoos Sleece-a
1416.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...30 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a coorrently nut in a stunce-a, yuoo aelsu inffleect Bleedeeng fur 5...15 secunds.
1416.concise: Svurd Aettaeck. Deaels +5...30 daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...15 secunds) iff yuoo aere-a nut in a stunce-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1465.name: Prepaered Shut
1465.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...25 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a under zee iffffects ooff a prepaeraeshun, yuoo gaeeen 1...9 Inergy.
1465.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +10...25 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 1...9 Inergy iff yuoo haefe-a a prepaeraeshun aecteefe-a.

1466.name: Boorneeng Aerroo
1466.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...30 daemaege-a und coose-a Boorneeng fur 2...8 secunds.
1466.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +10...30 daemaege-a. Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (2...8 secunds).

1467.name: Aerceeng Shut
1467.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aerroo heets, it streekes fur +10...35 daemaege-a. Thees aerroo cunnut be-a blucked, boot it mufes 50% slooer.
1467.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +10...35 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Thees aerroo mufes 50% slooer.

1468.name: Streeke-a aes Oone-a
1468.description: Ileete-a Shuoot. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun instuntly mufes tu yuoor taerget und cooses Bleedeeng fur 5...15 secunds veet its next aettaeck. Zee next teeme-a yuoo heet veet un aettaeck, taerget fue-a is Creeppled fur 5...15 secunds.
1468.concise: Ileete-a Shuoot. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun instuntly mufes tu yuoor taerget und inffleects Bleedeeng (5...15 secunds) veet its next aettaeck. Zee next teeme-a yuoo heet veet un aettaeck, yuoo inffleect Creeppled cundeeshun (5...15 secunds).

1469.name: Crussffure-a
1469.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets taerget fue-a, it deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is neaer uny ooff yuoor aelleees, thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
1469.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a iff taerget fue-a is neaer uny ooff yuoor aelleees.

1470.name: Baerbed Aerroos
1470.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 24 secunds, yuoor aerroos coose-a Bleedeeng fur 3...15 secunds. Yuoo haefe-a -40 aermur vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell.
1470.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (24 secunds.) Yuoor aerroos inffleect Bleedeeng cundeeshun (3...15 secunds). Yuoo haefe-a -40 aermur vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell.

1471.name: Scaefenger's Fucoos
1471.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 10 secunds, iff yuoo streeke-a a fue-a vhu is sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun yuoo gaeeen 3...12 Inergy.
1471.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (10 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 3...12 Inergy iff yuoo streeke-a a fue-a vhu haes a cundeeshun. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1472.name: Tuxeeceety
1472.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Pueesuned oor Deeseaesed creaetoores veetheen its runge-a sooffffer -2 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...180 secunds.
1472.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...180 secund leeffespun). Pueesuned oor Deeseaesed creaetoores in runge-a haefe-a -2 Heaelt degeneraeshun.

1473.name: Qooeecksund
1473.description: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Aell nun-spureet creaetoores veetheen its runge-a luse-a 1 Inergy iaech teeme-a zeey aettaeck oor use-a a skeell. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...180 secunds.
1473.concise: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...180 secund leeffespun). Creaetoores luse-a 1 Inergy iaech teeme-a zeey aettaeck oor use-a a skeell. Dues nut aeffffect spureets.

1474.name: Sturm's Imbraece-a
1474.description: Stunce-a. Fur 10 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Thees stunce-a is reffreshed vhenefer yuoo taeke-a Ilementael daemaege-a.
1474.concise: Stunce-a. (10 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Renooael: vhenefer yuoo taeke-a ilementael daemaege-a.

1475.name: Traepper's Speed
1475.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...30 secunds, yuoor Traeps rechaerge-a 25% faester und aecteefaete-a 25% faester. Thees stunce-a inds iff yuoo sooccessffoolly heet veet un aettaeck.
1475.concise: Stunce-a. (5...30 secunds.) Yuoor traeps rechaerge-a 25% faester und aecteefaete-a 25% faester. Inds iff yuoo heet veet un aettaeck.

1476.name: Treepvure-a
1476.description: Traep. Vhee Treepvure-a is treeggered, aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 5...20 peeerceeng daemaege-a. Uny Creeppled fues aere-a knucked doon. Treepvure-a inds aeffter 90 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
1476.concise: Traep. (90 secunds.) Deaels 5...20 peeerceeng daemaege-a tu neaerby fues. Cooses knuck-doon tu Creeppled fues. Iaeseely interroopted.

1478.name: Renooeeng Soorge-a
1478.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers 2...12 daemaege-a iaech secund. Vhee thees hex inds, yuoo gaeeen 1...8 Inergy.
1478.concise: Hex Spell. (8 secunds.) Deaels 2...12 daemaege-a iaech secund. Ind iffffect: Yuoo gaeeen 1...8 Inergy.

1479.name: Ooffffereeng ooff Spureet
1479.description: Ileete-a Spell. Gaeeen 8...17 Inergy. Iff uny spureets aere-a veetheen iaershut, yuoo du nut saecreeffeece-a Heaelt.
1479.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo gaeeen 8...17 Inergy. Yuoo du nut saecreeffeece-a Heaelt iff uny spureets aere-a veetheen iaershut.

1480.name: Spureet's Geefft
1480.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, vhenefer yuoo creaete-a a creaetoore-a, aell aelleees neaer thaet creaetoore-a gaeeen 5...50 Heaelt und luse-a 1 cundeeshun.
1480.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (60 secunds.) Vhenefer yuoo creaete-a a creaetoore-a, aell neaerby aelleees gaeeen 5...50 Heaelt und luse-a oone-a cundeeshun.

1481.name: Deaet Paect Seegnet
1481.description: Seegnet. Resoorrect taerget paerty member veet yuoor coorrent Heaelt und 15...100% maexeemoom Inergy. Zee next teeme-a thaet aelly deees veetheen 120 secunds, su du yuoo.
1481.concise: Seegnet. Resoorrects taerget paerty member veet yuoor coorrent Heaelt und 15...100% maexeemoom Inergy. Fur 120 secunds, yuoo deee-a zee next teeme-a thees paerty member deees.

1482.name: Reclaeeem Issence-a
1482.description: Ileete-a Spell. Aell ooff yuoor spureets deee-a. Yuoo gaeeen 5...20 Inergy und aell ooff yuoor Beendeeng Reetooaels aere-a rechaerged iff a spureet deeed in thees vaey.
1482.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Aell ooff yuoor Spureets deee-a. Iff a Spureet deees in thees vaey, yuoo gaeeen 5...20 Inergy und aell ooff yuoor Beendeeng Reetooaels aere-a rechaerged. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1483.name: Buneesheeng Streeke-a
1483.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck deaels 10...60 huly daemaege-a. It deaels duooble-a daemaege-a tu soommuned creaetoores. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1483.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels 10...60 huly daemaege-a. Deaels duooble-a daemaege-a tu soommuned creaetoores. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1484.name: Mysteec Sveep
1484.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +3...12 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a inchunted, thees aettaeck deaels un aeddeeshunael +3...12 daemaege-a.
1484.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +3...12 daemaege-a. Deaels un aeddeeshunael +3...12 daemaege-a iff yuoo aere-a inchunted.

1485.name: Iremeete-a's Aettaeck
1485.description: Scyzee Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck deaels +1...10 daemaege-a und remufes a Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff un inchuntment is remufed, yuoo du un aeddeeshunael +1...10 daemaege-a und streeke-a aell aedjaecent fues.
1485.concise: Scyzee Aettaeck. Deaels +1...10 daemaege-a und remufes a Derfeesh inchuntment. Remufael Iffffect: deaels +1...10 mure-a daemaege-a und streekes aell aedjaecent fues.

1486.name: Reaep Impooreeteees
1486.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +3...15 daemaege-a. Iaech fue-a yuoo heet luses 1 cundeeshun. Fur iaech fue-a vhu luses a cundeeshun, aell fues aedjaecent tu thaet taerget fue-a taeke-a 10...40 huly daemaege-a.
1486.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +3...15 daemaege-a. Stroock fues luse-a 1 cundeeshun. Remufael Iffffect: Aell fues aedjaecent tu thuse-a stroock taeke-a 10...40 huly daemaege-a.

1487.name: Tveen Muun Sveep
1487.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Yuoo luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment und gaeeen 10...50 Heaelt. Iff un inchuntment is lust in thees vaey, yuoo cunnut be-a blucked, yuoo streeke-a tveece-a, und yuoo gaeeen un aeddeeshunael 10...70 Heaelt.
1487.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Remufe-a 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Gaeeen 10...50 Heaelt. Remufael iffffect: unbluckaeble-a, aettaeck tveece-a, und gaeeen 10...70 mure-a Heaelt.

1488.name: Feectureeuoos Sveep
1488.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...25 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a haes less Heaelt thun yuoo, yuoo gaeeen 30...80 Heaelt.
1488.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...25 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 30...80 Heaelt fur iaech fue-a yuoo heet thaet haes less Heaelt thun yuoo.

1489.name: Irreseesteeble-a Sveep
1489.description: Scyzee Aettaeck. Deael +3...15 daemaege-a und luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff yuoo luse-a un inchuntment in thees vaey, Irreseesteeble-a Sveep cunnut be-a blucked, remufes a stunce-a, und deaels +3...15 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a.
1489.concise: Scyzee Aettaeck. Deaels +3...15 daemaege-a. Remufe-a 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: unbluckaeble-a, remufes a stunce-a, deaels +3...15 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1490.name: Peeuoos Aessoolt
1490.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck deaels +10...20 daemaege-a und remufes 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff a Derfeesh inchuntment vaes remufed, thees skeell rechaerges 75% faester und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 15...40 daemaege-a.
1490.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...20 daemaege-a. Remufes 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael Iffffect: thees skeell rechaerges 75% faester und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 15...40 daemaege-a.

1491.name: Mysteec Tveester
1491.description: Spell. Deaels 10...60 culd daemaege-a tu aell neaerby fues. Iff yuoo aere-a inchunted, thees spell deaels un aeddeeshunael 10...60 culd daemaege-a.
1491.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...60 culd daemaege-a tu aell neaerby fues. Deaels 10...60 mure-a culd daemaege-a iff yuoo aere-a inchunted.

1493.name: Grent's Feengers
1493.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 10...40 culd daemaege-a. Fur 30 secunds, yuoor aettaecks deael culd daemaege-a. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, yuoo trunsffer 1...2 cundeeshuns tu aell neaerby fues.
1493.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoor aettaecks deael culd daemaege-a. Ineeteeael iffffect: heets neaerby fues fur 10...40 culd daemaege-a. Ind iffffect: trunsffers 1...2 cundeeshuns tu aell neaerby fues.

1495.name: Oora ooff Thurns
1495.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Aell neaerby fues begeen Bleedeeng fur 5...15 secunds. Fur 30 secunds, thees inchuntment dues nutheeng. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, aell neaerby fues aere-a Creeppled fur 3...8 secunds.
1495.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Ineeteeael iffffect: inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...15 secunds) oon neaerby fues. Ind iffffect: inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...8 secunds) oon neaerby fues.

1496.name: Baelthaezaer's Raege-a
1496.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Aell neaerby fues aere-a set oon fure-a fur 1...3 secunds. Fur 20 secunds aefftervaerd, thees inchuntment dues nutheeng. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, yuoo gaeeen 1...2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a iff uny fues aere-a veetheen iaershut.
1496.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Ineeteeael Iffffect: inffleects Boorneeng (1...3 secunds) oon neaerby fues. Ind Iffffect: gaeeen 1...2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a iff uny fues aere-a in iaershut.

1497.name: Doost Cluaek
1497.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 10...40 iaert daemaege-a. Fur 30 secunds, yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, aell neaerby fues aere-a Bleended fur 1...4 secunds.
1497.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 10...40 iaert daemaege-a tu neaerby fues. Ind iffffect: inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (1...4 secunds) oon neaerby fues.

1498.name: Staeggereeng Furce-a
1498.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 10...40 iaert daemaege-a. Fur 30 secunds, yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, aell neaerby fues haefe-a Craecked Aermur fur 1...10 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1498.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 10...40 iaert daemaege-a tu neaerby fues. Ind iffffect: inffleects Craecked Aermur (1...10 secunds) oon neaerby fues.

1499.name: Peeuoos Renooael
1499.description: Ileete-a Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8 secunds, nutheeng haeppens. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, Peeuoos Renooael is rechaerged und yuoo gaeeen 0...5 Inergy und 0...30 Heaelt.
1499.concise: Ileete-a Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (8 secunds.) Ind Iffffect: rechaerges itselff und yuoo gaeeen 0...5 Inergy und 0...30 Heaelt.

1500.name: Muraege-a Cluaek
1500.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 40% chunce-a tu bluck und un ixtra 4...10% fur iaech aeddeeshunael inchuntment (maex 80%). Aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 10...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech teeme-a a Derfeesh inchuntment is remufed frum yuoo.
1500.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) 40% chunce-a tu bluck und un ixtra 4...10% fur iaech aeddeeshunael inchuntment. 10...40 iaert daemaege-a tu neaerby fues vhee yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment.

1502.name: Aercune-a Zeael
1502.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, vhenefer yuoo caest a spell, yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo (maexeemoom 2...7 Inergy).
1502.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy (maexeemoom 2...7) fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo vhenefer yuoo caest a spell.

1503.name: Mysteec Feegur
1503.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, ifery teeme-a yuoo sooccessffoolly heet veet un aettaeck, yuoo gaeeen 3...15 Heaelt fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo (maexeemoom 25 Heaelt).
1503.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 3...15 Heaelt (maexeemoom 25) fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo vhenefer yuoo heet veet un aettaeck.

1504.name: Vaetchffool Interfenshun
1504.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, zee next teeme-a daemaege-a drups taerget aelly's Heaelt beloo 25%, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 50...200 Heaelt.
1504.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (60 secunds.) Heaels fur 50...200 zee next teeme-a daemaege-a drups taerget aelly's Heaelt beloo 25%.

1505.name: Foo ooff Peeety
1505.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +24 aermur und +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Foo ooff Peeety renoos vhenefer un inchuntment oon yuoo inds.
1505.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) +24 aermur und +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Renooael: vhenefer un inchuntment oon yuoo inds.

1506.name: Feetael Buun
1506.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +40...100 maexeemoom Heaelt. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 75...200 Heaelt.
1506.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +40...100 maexeemoom Heaelt. Ind iffffect: heaels yuoo fur 75...200.

1507.name: Heaert ooff Huly Flaeme-a
1507.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Aell neaerby fues taeke-a 5...30 huly daemaege-a. Fur 30 secunds aefftervaerd, yuoor aettaecks deael huly daemaege-a. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, aell neaerby fues aere-a set oon fure-a fur 2...5 secunds.
1507.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoor aettaecks deael huly daemaege-a. Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 5...30 huly daemaege-a tu neaerby fues. Ind iffffect: inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (2...5 secunds) oon neaerby fues.

1508.name: Ixtend Inchuntments
1508.description: Skeell. Fur 10 secunds, yuoor next Derfeesh inchuntment laests 10...150% lunger. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1508.concise: Skeell. (10 secunds)Yuoor next Derfeesh inchuntment laests 10...150% lunger.

1509.name: Faeeethffool Interfenshun
1509.description: Inchuntment Spell. Iff daemaege-a drups yuoor Heaelt beloo 50%, Faeeethffool Interfenshun inds. Vhee Faeeethffool Interfenshun inds, yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 30...150 Heaelt.
1509.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Yuoo gaeeen 30...150 Heaelt zee next teeme-a daemaege-a drups yuoor Heaelt beloo 50%. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1510.name: Sund Shaerds
1510.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, zee next 1...5 teeme-as yuoo heet veet a scyzee, aell oozeer aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...60 iaert daemaege-a.
1510.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Deaels 10...60 iaert daemaege-a tu aell oozeer aedjaecent fues vhenefer yuoo heet veet yuoor scyzee. Inds aeffter 1...5 heets.

1512.name: Lyssa's Haeste-a
1512.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 3...15 secunds, yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments rechaerge-a 33% faester. Vhee yuoo aecteefaete-a thees inchuntment, aell aedjaecent fues aere-a interroopted. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, aell aedjaecent fues aere-a interroopted. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Veend Praeyers 5 oor heegher.
1512.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (3...15 secunds.) Yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments rechaerge-a 33% faester. Ineeteeael Iffffect: interroopts aell aedjaecent fues. Ind Iffffect: interroopts aell aedjaecent fues. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Veend Praeyers 5 oor heegher.)

1513.name: Gooeedeeng Hunds
1513.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, yuoor next 0...3 aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked. Vhee aecteefaeted, thees skeell remufes zee Bleendness cundeeshun.
1513.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Yuoor next 0...3 aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked. Ineeteeael iffffect: remufes Bleendness.

1514.name: Fleeteeng Staebeeleety
1514.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a knucked doon und mufe-a 25% faester. Thees inchuntment inds premaetoorely iff it prefents a knuckdoon.
1514.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (4...10 secunds.) Yuoo cunnut be-a knucked doon und mufe-a 25% faester. Inds iff knuckdoon prefented.

1515.name: Aermur ooff Suncteety
1515.description: Inchuntment Spell. Aell aedjaecent fues sooffffer frum Veaekness fur 5...15 secunds. Fur 15 secunds, yuoo taeke-a 5...20 less daemaege-a frum fues sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun.
1515.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun oon aell aedjaecent fues (5...15 secunds). Yuoo taeke-a 5...20 less daemaege-a frum fues veet a cundeeshun (15 secunds). Bork! Bork! Bork!

1516.name: Mysteec Regeneraeshun
1516.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun fur iaech inchuntment (maexeemoom ooff 8) oon yuoo.
1516.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun fur iaech inchuntment (maexeemoom ooff 8) oon yuoo.

1517.name: Foo ooff Seelence-a
1517.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...10 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a zee taerget ooff spells, und yuoo cunnut caest spells.
1517.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5...10 secunds.) Spells cunnut taerget yuoo. Yuoo cunnut caest spells.

1518.name: Aefaetaer ooff Baelthaezaer
1518.description: Ileete-a Furm. Fur 10...90 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +20 aermur aegaeeenst physeecael daemaege-a, yuoo gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a 25% faester, yuoor aettaecks deael huly daemaege-a, und vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment, neaerby fues aere-a set oon fure-a fur 1...3 secunds. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.
1518.concise: Ileete-a Furm. (10...90 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen +20 aermur aegaeeenst physeecael daemaege-a, yuoo gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a 25% faester, yuoor aettaecks deael huly daemaege-a, yuoo inffleect Boorneeng (1...3 secunds) oon neaerby fues vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.

1519.name: Aefaetaer ooff Dvaeyna
1519.description: Ileete-a Furm. Fur 10...90 secunds, yuoor aettaecks deael huly daemaege-a. Vhenefer yuoo use-a a Derfeesh aettaeck skeell, yuoo luse-a 1 hex. Vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment, aell aelleees in iaershut aere-a heaeled fur 5...50 Heaelt. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.
1519.concise: Ileete-a Furm. (10...90 secunds.) Deael huly daemaege-a. Yuoo luse-a 1 hex vhenefer yuoo use-a a Derfeesh aettaeck skeell. Heael aelleees in iaershut fur 5...50 Heaelt vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.

1520.name: Aefaetaer ooff Grent
1520.description: Ileete-a Furm. Fur 10...90 secunds, yuoor scyzee aettaecks deael daerk daemaege-a und steael 0...12 Heaelt. Yuoo aere-a immoone-a tu Deeseaese-a und inffleect Deeseaese-a oon aell aedjaecent fues fur 3 secunds vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.
1520.concise: Ileete-a Furm. (10...90 secunds.) Yuoor scyzee aettaecks deael daerk daemaege-a und steael 0...12 Heaelt. Yuoo aere-a immoone-a tu Deeseaese-a. Aepply Deeseaese-a tu aell aedjaecent fues (3 secunds) vhee yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.

1521.name: Aefaetaer ooff Lyssa
1521.description: Ileete-a Furm. Fur 10...90 secunds, yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments rechaerge-a 50% faester und yuoor aettaecks deael chaeus daemaege-a. Vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment, steael 1 Inergy frum aell neaerby fues. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1521.concise: Ileete-a Furm. (10...90 secunds.) Yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments rechaerge-a 50% faester und deael chaeus daemaege-a veet aettaecks. Steael 1 Inergy frum neaerby fues vhee yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.

1522.name: Aefaetaer ooff Melundroo
1522.description: Ileete-a Furm. Fur 10...90 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +150 Heaelt, +30 ilementael aermur, und yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment, aell paerty members in iaershut luse-a 1 cundeeshun. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.
1522.concise: Ileete-a Furm. (10...90 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +150 maexeemoom Heaelt, +30 ilementael aermur, und yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Coore-a 1 cundeeshun frum aell paerty members in iaershut vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.

1523.name: Medeetaeshun
1523.description: Inchuntment Spell. Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. Fur 20 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 1...4 Inergy ifery teeme-a un inchuntment oon yuoo inds.
1523.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a. Gaeeen 1...4 Inergy vhenefer un inchuntment oon yuoo inds. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1524.name: Iremeete-a's Zeael
1524.description: Inchuntment Spell. Yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy fur iaech fue-a veetheen iaershut, maexeemoom 8 Inergy. Fur 10 secunds aefftervaerd, thees inchuntment dues nutheeng. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy fur iaech fue-a veetheen iaershut, maexeemoom 8 Inergy.
1524.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Ineeteeael iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy (maexeemoom 8) fur iaech fue-a in iaershut. Ind iffffect: yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy (maexeemoom 8) fur iaech fue-a in iaershut.

1525.name: Naetoorael Heaeleeng
1525.description: Spell. Yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 50...170 Heaelt. Iff yuoo aere-a nut inchunted, thees spell aecteefaetes 50% faester.
1525.concise: Spell. Heaels yuoo fur 50...170 Heaelt. Thees skeell aecteefaetes 50% faester iff yuoo aere-a nut inchunted.

1526.name: Imbooe-a Heaelt
1526.description: Spell. Taerget oozeer aelly is heaeled fur 5...50% ooff yuoor coorrent Heaelt (maexeemoom 300 Heaelt).
1526.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 5...50% ooff yuoor coorrent Heaelt (maexeemoom 300). Cunnut selff-taerget.

1527.name: Mysteec Heaeleeng
1527.description: Spell. Yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 5...65 Heaelt. Aelsu heaels aell inchunted paerty members fur 5...65 Heaelt.
1527.concise: Spell. Heaels yuoo fur 5...65. Heaels aell inchunted paerty members fur 5...65 Heaelt.

1528.name: Dvaeyna's Tuooch
1528.description: Spell. Taerget tuooched aelly is heaeled fur 60 Heaelt fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo (maexeemoom 60...240).
1528.concise: Tuooch Spell. Heaels fur 60 (maexeemoom 60...240) fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo.

1529.name: Peeuoos Resturaeshun
1529.description: Spell. Yuoo gaeeen 80...150 Heaelt und remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed in thees vaey, yuoo aelsu luse-a 1...3 hexes.
1529.concise: Spell. Gaeeen 80...150 Heaelt und remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Remufael iffffect: luse-a 1...3 hexes.

1530.name: Seegnet ooff Peeuoos Leeght
1530.description: Seegnet. Remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 30...150 Heaelt. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed in thees vaey, thees seegnet rechaerges 75% faester.
1530.concise: Seegnet. Heaels fur 30...150 Heaelt. Remufes 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: rechaerges 75% faester.

1531.name: Inteemeedaeteeng Oora
1531.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +40...100 maex Heaelt und taeke-a 1...10 less daemaege-a frum fues veet less Heaelt thun yuoo.
1531.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (60 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +40...100 maex Heaelt und taeke-a -1...10 daemaege-a frum fues veet less Heaelt thun yuoo.

1532.name: Mysteec Sundsturm
1532.description: Spell. Creaete-a a Sundsturm aet yuoor lucaeshun thaet laests 3 secunds. Iaech secund, fues neaerby thees lucaeshun taeke-a 10...40 iaert daemaege-a. Aettaeckeeng fues taeke-a un aeddeeshunael 10...20 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a inchunted vhee yuoo caest thees spell, it laests tveece-a aes lung.
1532.concise: Spell. (3 secunds). Deaels 10...40 iaert daemaege-a iaech secund. Deaels un aeddeeshunael 10...20 daemaege-a tu aettaeckeeng fues. Heets fues neaerby yuoor ineeteeael lucaeshun. Laests tveece-a aes lung iff yuoo aere-a inchunted.

1533.name: Veends ooff Deesenchuntment
1533.description: Spell. Remufe-a 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, aell neaerby fues luse-a 1 inchuntment und taeke-a 20...80 culd daemaege-a.
1533.concise: Spell. Remufe-a 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: aell neaerby fues luse-a 1 inchuntment und taeke-a 20...80 culd daemaege-a.

1534.name: Rendeeng Tuooch
1534.description: Spell. Deaels 15...65 culd daemaege-a tu taerget fue-a. Yuoo luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, taerget fue-a luses 1 inchuntment und yuoo gaeeen 2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.
1534.concise: Tuooch Spell. Deaels 15...65 culd daemaege-a. Luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Remufael iffffect: taerget fue-a luses 1 inchuntment und yuoo gaeeen 2 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1535.name: Creeppleeng Sveep
1535.description: Scyzee Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a fue-a, thaet fue-a is Creeppled fur 3...12 secunds. Thees skeell deaels +3...15 ixtra daemaege-a iff thaet fue-a is mufeeng.
1535.concise: Scyzee Aettaeck. (3...12 secunds.) Inffleects Creepple-a cundeeshun. Deaels +3...15 daemaege-a tu mufeeng fues.

1536.name: Vuoondeeng Streeke-a
1536.description: Ileete-a Scyzee Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo du +5...20 daemaege-a, taerget fue-a sooffffers frum Bleedeeng fur 5...20 secunds, und yuoo luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, taerget fue-a aelsu sooffffers frum a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds.
1536.concise: Ileete-a Scyzee Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a und inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Remufael Iffffect: inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

1537.name: Veaeryeeng Streeke-a
1537.description: Scyzee Aettaeck. Yuoo remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, yuoo inffleect a Deep Vuoond fur 3...10 secunds. Yuoo sooffffer frum Veaekness fur 10 secunds iff un inchuntment is nut remufed.
1537.concise: Scyzee Aettaeck. Remufe-a 1 Derfeesh Inchuntment. Remufael Iffffect: Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (3...10 secunds). Yuoo aere-a Veaekened (10 secunds) iff un inchuntment is nut lust.

1538.name: Lyssa's Aessoolt
1538.description: Scyzee Aettaeck. Thees aettaeck interroopts un aecshun iff it heets. Iff yuoo aere-a inchunted, uny skeell yuoo interroopt is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 1...10 secunds. Thees aettaeck dues 50% ooff nurmael daemaege-a.
1538.concise: Scyzee Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Iff yuoo aere-a inchunted, zee interroopted skeell is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 1...10 secunds. Thees aettaeck dues 50% ooff nurmael daemaege-a.

1539.name: Cheelleeng Feectury
1539.description: Scyzee Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +3...15 daemaege-a. Fur iaech fue-a heet vhu haes less Heaelt thun yuoo, thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 10...30 culd daemaege-a.
1539.concise: Scyzee Aettaeck. Deaels +3...15 daemaege-a. Deaels 10...30 culd daemaege-a tu iaech fue-a heet vhu haes less Heaelt thun yuoo und fues aedjaecent tu thuse-a taergets.

1540.name: Cunfeecshun
1540.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, yuoo gaeeen +10 aermur iff yuoo haefe-a a cundeeshun und gaeeen 1...3 Heaelt regee fur iaech cundeeshun yuoo aere-a sooffffereeng frum. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, yuoo aere-a coored ooff 1...2 cundeeshuns.
1540.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Gaeeen +10 aermur vheele-a cundeeshuned. Gaeeen 1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun fur iaech cundeeshun yuoo haefe-a. Ind Iffffect: remufe-a 1...2 cundeeshuns.

1541.name: Inchunted Haeste-a
1541.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 7 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Iff thees inchuntment inds premaetoorely, yuoo luse-a 1 cundeeshuns. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1541.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (7 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Luse-a 1 cundeeshuns iff thees inchuntment inds premaetoorely.

1542.name: Peeuoos Cuncentraeshun
1542.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...20 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a interroopted, boot iaech teeme-a yuoo vuoold haefe-a beee interroopted, yuoo luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment oor Peeuoos Cuncentraeshun inds.
1542.concise: Stunce-a. (5...20 secunds.) Prefents interroopts. Prefenshun cust: yuoo luse-a oone-a Derfeesh inchuntment oor Peeuoos Cuncentraeshun inds.

1543.name: Peeuoos Haeste-a
1543.description: Stunce-a. Yuoo remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment und fur 1...7 secunds yuoo mufe-a 25% faester. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed yuoo roon 50% faester insteaed.
1543.concise: Stunce-a. (1...7 secunds.) Luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment und mufe-a 25% faester. Remufael Iffffect: Roon 50% faester insteaed.

1544.name: Vhurleeng Chaerge-a
1544.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 1...6 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 33% faester thun nurmael. Zee next teeme-a yuoo streeke-a a fue-a, aell oozeer neaerby fues taeke-a 10...60 culd daemaege-a und thees inchuntment inds.
1544.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (1...6 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester. Deael 10...60 culd daemaege-a tu aell oozeer neaerby fues zee next teeme-a yuoo heet a fue-a und thees inchuntment inds.

1545.name: Test ooff Faeeet
1545.description: Spell. Deaels 15...75 culd daemaege-a und taekes 1 inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Iff thaet fue-a vaes nut inchunted, thaet fue-a is Daezed fur 2...6 secunds.
1545.concise: Tuooch Spell. Deaels 15...75 culd daemaege-a und remufes 1 inchuntment. Taerget fue-a is Daezed fur 2...6 secunds iff thaet fue-a vaes nut inchunted.

1546.name: Blaezeeng Speaer
1546.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, it deaels +5...25 daemaege-a und sets taerget fue-a oon Fure-a fur 1...3 secunds.
1546.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...25 daemaege-a. Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...3 secunds).

1547.name: Meeghty Throo
1547.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Yuoor speaer mufes three-a teemes faester. Iff it heets, yuoo deael +10...40 daemaege-a.
1547.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Thees speaer mufes three-a teemes faester.

1548.name: Crooel Speaer
1548.description: Ileete-a Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +10...50 daemaege-a. Iff it heets a nun-mufeeng taerget, yuoo inffleect a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds.
1548.concise: Ileete-a Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +10...50 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) iff taerget is nut mufeeng.

1549.name: Haerreeer's Tuss
1549.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff thees aettaeck heets a mufeeng fue-a, it deaels un aeddeeshunael 5...40 daemaege-a.
1549.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Deaels 5...40 mure-a daemaege-a iff taerget is mufeeng.

1550.name: Unbluckaeble-a Throo
1550.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +10...40 daemaege-a. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.

1551.name: Speaer ooff Leeghtneeng
1551.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Streekes aell fues betveee yuoo und yuoor taerget. Iff thees aettaeck heets, it deaels +10...20 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Thees aettaeck haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
1551.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +10...20 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. 25% aermur penetraeshun. Streekes aell fues betveee yuoo und yuoor taerget.

1552.name: Veaeryeeng Speaer
1552.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +10...40 daemaege-a. Yuoo aere-a Veaekened fur 5 secunds.
1552.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Yuoo aere-a Veaekened (5 secunds).

1553.name: Unzeem ooff Foory
1553.description: Ileete-a Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, aell paerty members veetheen iaershut gaeeen 2...5 streekes ooff aedrenaeleene-a zee next teeme-a zeey use-a un aettaeck skeell.
1553.concise: Ileete-a Chunt. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen 2...5 aedrenaeleene-a veet zeeur next aettaeck skeell.

1554.name: Creeppleeng Unzeem
1554.description: Ileete-a Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next aettaeck skeell used by iaech aelly veetheen iaershut cooses Creeppleeng fur 5...15 secunds.
1554.concise: Ileete-a Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut inffleect Creeppled cundeeshun (5...15 secunds) veet zeeur next aettaeck skeell. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1555.name: Deffenseefe-a Unzeem
1555.description: Ileete-a Chunt. Fur 4...10 secunds, iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut haes a 50% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks. Thees chunt inds iff thaet paerty member heets veet un aettaeck skeell.
1555.concise: Ileete-a Chunt. (4...10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut haefe-a 50% chunce-a tu bluck. Inds vhee heetteeng veet un aettaeck skeell.

1556.name: Gudspeed
1556.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...20 secunds, aell aelleees veetheen iaershut mufe-a 25% faester vheele-a under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment.
1556.concise: Shuoot. (5...20 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut mufe-a 25% faester vheele-a inchunted.

1557.name: Unzeem ooff Flaeme-a
1557.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next aettaeck skeell used by iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut aelsu cooses Boorneeng fur 1...5 secunds.
1557.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut inffleect Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...5 secunds) veet zeeur next aettaeck skeell.

1558.name: "Gu fur zee Iyes!"
1558.description: Shuoot. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech aelly veetheen iaershut maekes un aettaeck, thaet aettaeck haes un aeddeeshunael 30...100% chunce-a tu creeteecael.
1558.concise: Shuoot. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut haefe-a +30...100% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet veet zeeur next aettaeck.

1559.name: Unzeem ooff Infy
1559.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next aettaeck skeell used by iaech aelly veetheen iaershut deaels +10...25 daemaege-a aegaeeenst fues veet mure-a thun 50% Heaelt.
1559.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut du +10...25 daemaege-a veet zeeur next aettaeck skeell. Daemaege-a bunoos oonly aeppleees tu fues veet mure-a thun 50% Heaelt.

1560.name: Sung ooff Pooer
1560.description: Chunt. Fur 5...20 secunds, iaech aelly veetheen iaershut gaeeens 4 Inergy regeneraeshun unteel thaet aelly uses a skeell.
1560.concise: Chunt. (5...20 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut gaeeen +4 Inergy regeneraeshun. Inds vhee useeng a skeell.

1561.name: Zeaeluoos Unzeem
1561.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech aelly veetheen iaershut uses un aettaeck skeell, thaet aelly gaeeens 1...8 Inergy.
1561.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut gaeeen 1...8 Inergy veet zeeur next aettaeck skeell.

1562.name: Aereea ooff Zeael
1562.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech aelly veetheen iaershut uses a spell, thaet aelly gaeeens 1...6 Inergy.
1562.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut gaeeen 1...6 Inergy veet zeeur next spell.

1563.name: Lyreec ooff Zeael
1563.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech aelly veetheen iaershut uses a seegnet, thaet aelly gaeeens 1...8 Inergy.
1563.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut gaeeen 1...8 Inergy veet zeeur next seegnet.

1564.name: Baellaed ooff Resturaeshun
1564.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut taekes daemaege-a, thaet paerty member gaeeens 15...75 Heaelt.
1564.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen 15...75 Heaelt zee next teeme-a zeey taeke-a daemaege-a.

1565.name: Churoos ooff Resturaeshun
1565.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech aelly veetheen iaershut uses a shuoot oor chunt, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 30...90 Heaelt.
1565.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut aere-a heaeled fur 30...90 veet zeeur next shuoot oor chunt.

1566.name: Aereea ooff Resturaeshun
1566.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut uses a spell, thaet paerty member gaeeens 30...90 Heaelt.
1566.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen 30...90 Heaelt veet zeeur next spell.

1567.name: Sung ooff Cuncentraeshun
1567.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next skeell used by iaech aelly veetheen iaershut cunnut be-a interroopted.
1567.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut aere-a uneenterroopteeble-a veet zeeur next skeell.

1568.name: Unzeem ooff Gooeedunce-a
1568.description: Ileete-a Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next aettaeck skeell used by iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut cunnut be-a blucked.
1568.concise: Ileete-a Chunt. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut aere-a unbluckaeble-a veet zeeur next aettaeck skeell.

1569.name: Inergeezeeng Churoos
1569.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next shuoot oor chunt used by iaech aelly veetheen iaershut custs 3...7 less Inergy.
1569.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Zee next shuoot oor chunt custs 3...7 less Inergy fur aelleees in iaershut. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1570.name: Sung ooff Pooreeffeecaeshun
1570.description: Ileete-a Chunt. Fur 20 secunds, zee next 1...6 skeells used by iaech aelly veetheen iaershut remufe-a 1 cundeeshun frum thaet aelly.
1570.concise: Ileete-a Chunt. (20 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut luse-a oone-a cundeeshun veet zeeur next 1...6 skeells.

1571.name: Hexbreaeker Aereea
1571.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech aelly veetheen iaershut caests a spell, thaet aelly luses 1 hex.
1571.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut luse-a oone-a hex veet zeeur next spell.

1572.name: "Braece-a Yuoorselff!"
1572.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...15 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget oozeer aelly vuoold be-a knucked doon, aell neaerby fues taeke-a 15...75 daemaege-a insteaed.
1572.concise: Shuoot. (5...15 secunds.) Prefents zee next knuck-doon und deaels 15...75 daemaege-a tu aell fues neaer taerget aelly. Cunnut selff-taerget.

1573.name: Aeve-a
1573.description: Skeell. Iff thees skeell heets a knucked-doon fue-a, thaet fue-a becumes Daezed fur 5...15 secunds.
1573.concise: Skeell. Inffleects Daezed cundeeshun (5...15 secunds). Nu iffffect unless taerget is knucked-doon.

1574.name: Indooreeng Haermuny
1574.description: Ichu. Fur 10...35 secunds, chunts und shuoots laest 50% lunger oon taerget nun-spureet aelly.
1574.concise: Ichu. (10...35 secunds.) Chunts und shuoots laest 50% lunger oon taerget aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

1575.name: Blaezeeng Feenaele-a
1575.description: Ichu. Fur 10...35 secunds, vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon taerget nun-spureet aelly, aell fues aedjaecent tu thaet aelly aere-a set oon Fure-a fur 1...7 secunds.
1575.concise: Ichu. (10...35 secunds.) Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...7 secunds) tu aedjaecent fues vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon taerget aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

1576.name: Boorneeng Reffraeeen
1576.description: Ichu. Fur 20 secunds, iff taerget nun-spureet aelly heets a fue-a veet mure-a Heaelt thun thaet aelly, thaet fue-a is set oon Fure-a fur 1...3 secunds. Thees ichu is reaeppleeed ifery teeme-a a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly.
1576.concise: Ichu. (20 secunds.) Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...3 secunds) iff taerget aelly heets a fue-a veet mure-a Heaelt. Renooael: Vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

1577.name: Feenaele-a ooff Resturaeshun
1577.description: Ichu. Fur 10...35 secunds, vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon taerget nun-spureet aelly, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 15...75 Heaelt.
1577.concise: Ichu. (10...35 secunds.) Taerget aelly gaeeens 15...75 Heaelt vhenefer a shuoot oor chunt inds oon thaet aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

1578.name: Mendeeng Reffraeeen
1578.description: Ichu. Fur 15 secunds, taerget nun-spureet aelly haes +2...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Thees ichu is reaeppleeed ifery teeme-a a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly.
1578.concise: Ichu. (15 secunds.) Taerget aelly haes +2...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Renooael: Vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

1579.name: Pooreeffyeeng Feenaele-a
1579.description: Ichu. Fur 10...35 secunds, taerget nun-spureet aelly luses 1 cundeeshun vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly.
