1579.concise: Ichu. (10...35 secunds.) Taerget aelly luses oone-a cundeeshun vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

1580.name: Blaedetoorn Reffraeeen
1580.description: Ichu. Fur 20 secunds, taerget nun-spureet aelly haes a 5...20% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks. Thees ichu is reaeppleeed ifery teeme-a a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly.
1580.concise: Ichu. (20 secunds.) Taerget aelly haes a 5...20% chunce-a tu bluck. Renooael: Vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

1581.name: Glooeeng Seegnet
1581.description: Seegnet. Iff taerget fue-a is Boorneeng, yuoo gaeeen 5...15 Inergy.
1581.concise: Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 5...15 Inergy iff taerget fue-a is Boorneeng.

1583.name: Leaeder's Zeael
1583.description: Skeell. Fur iaech neaerby aelly, yuoo gaeeen 2...4 Inergy (maexeemoom 8...12 Inergy).
1583.concise: Skeell. Yuoo gaeeen 2...4 Inergy (maexeemoom 8...12 Inergy) fur iaech neaerby aelly.

1584.name: Leaeder's Cumffurt
1584.description: Skeell. Yuoo gaeeen 30...75 Heaelt. Fur iaech aelly veetheen iaershut, yuoo aelsu gaeeen +10...20 Heaelt (maexeemoom 140 Heaelt).
1584.concise: Skeell. Yuoo gaeeen 30...75 Heaelt. Yuoo aelsu gaeeen 10...20 Heaelt (maexeemoom 140) fur iaech aelly in iaershut.

1585.name: Seegnet ooff Synergy
1585.description: Seegnet. Taerget oozeer aelly is heaeled fur 40...100 Heaelt. Iff yuoo aere-a nut under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, yuoo aere-a aelsu heaeled fur 40...100 Heaelt.
1585.concise: Seegnet. Heael taerget aelly fur 40...100. Yuoo aere-a aelsu heaeled fur 40...100 iff yuoo aere-a nut inchunted. Cunnut selff-taerget.

1586.name: Ungeleec Prutecshun
1586.description: Skeell. Fur 10 secunds, uny teeme-a taerget oozeer aelly taekes mure-a thun 250...80 daemaege-a per secund, thaet aelly is heaeled fur uny daemaege-a oofer thaet aemuoont.
1586.concise: Skeell. (10 secunds.) Iaech secund thaet taerget aelly taekes daemaege-a oofer 250...80, thaet aelly is heaeled fur uny daemaege-a oofer thaet aemuoont. Cunnut selff taerget.

1587.name: Ungeleec Bund
1587.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a un aelly veetheen iaershut vuoold taeke-a faetael daemaege-a, thaet daemaege-a is negaeted und thaet aelly is heaeled fur 20...200 Heaelt. Ungeleec Bund inds oon aell oozeer aelleees.
1587.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (10 secunds.) Zee next teeme-a un aelly veetheen iaershut vuoold taeke-a faetael daemaege-a, thaet daemaege-a is negaeted und thaet aelly is heaeled fur 20...200. Inds oon aell oozeer aelleees.

1588.name: Cootery Seegnet
1588.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Aell paerty members luse-a aell cundeeshuns. Yuoo aere-a set oon Fure-a fur 1 secund fur iaech cundeeshun remufed in thees vaey.
1588.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Aell paerty members luse-a aell cundeeshuns. Yuoo begeen Boorneeng (oone-a secund fur iaech cundeeshun remufed).

1589.name: "Stund Yuoor Gruoond!"
1589.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...20 secunds, aell paerty members veetheen iaershut receeefe-a +24 aermur vhee nut mufeeng.
1589.concise: Shuoot. (5...20 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen +24 aermur vhee nut mufeeng.

1590.name: "Leaed zee Vaey!"
1590.description: Shuoot. Taerget aelly mufes 25% faester fur 1...5 secunds fur iaech aelly veetheen iaershut (maexeemoom ooff 30 secunds).
1590.concise: Shuoot. Taerget aelly mufes 25% faester fur 1...5 secunds (maexeemoom ooff 30 secunds) fur iaech aelly in iaershut.

1591.name: "Maeke-a Haeste-a!"
1591.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget oozeer aelly mufes 33% faester. Thees skeell inds iff thaet aelly sooccessffoolly heets veet un aettaeck.
1591.concise: Shuoot. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget aelly mufes 33% faester. Inds iff taerget aelly heets veet un aettaeck. Cunnut selff-taerget.

1592.name: "Ve-a Shaell Retoorn!"
1592.description: Shuoot. Aell paerty members in iaershut aere-a resoorrected veet 25...50% Heaelt und 5...20% Inergy.
1592.concise: Shuoot. Aell paerty members in iaershut aere-a resoorrected (25...50% Heaelt und 5...20% Inergy).

1593.name: "Nefer Geefe-a Up!"
1593.description: Shuoot. Aell aelleees veetheen iaershut und beloo 75% Heaelt gaeeen 1...10 Inergy.
1593.concise: Shuoot. Aelleees in iaershut gaeeen 1...10 Inergy. Oonly aeffffects aelleees beloo 75% Heaelt.

1594.name: "Help!"
1594.description: Shuoot. Taerget nun-spureet aelly gaeeens 15...90 Heaelt. Fur 1...10 secunds, oozeer aelleees' spells taergeteeng thaet aelly caest 50% faester.
1594.concise: Shuoot. (1...10 secunds.) Taerget nun-spureet aelly gaeeens 15...90 heaelt, aelleeed spells taergeteeng zeem caest 50% faester.

1595.name: "Faell Baeck!"
1595.description: Shuoot. Fur 4...10 secunds, aell aelleees veetheen iaershut gaeeen 5...15 Heaelt per secund vheele-a mufeeng und mufe-a 33% faester. "Faell Baeck!" inds oon un aelly aeffffected by thees shuoot vhee thaet aelly sooccessffoolly heets veet un aettaeck.
1595.concise: Shuoot. (4...10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut gaeeen 5...15 Heaelt per secund vheele-a mufeeng und mufe-a 33% faester. Inds fur un aelly iff thaet aelly heets veet un aettaeck.

1596.name: "Incumeeng!"
1596.description: Ileete-a Shuoot. Fur 4...10 secunds, aell aelleees veetheen iaershut mufe-a 33% faester und gaeeen 5...15 Heaelt per secund vheele-a mufeeng.
1596.concise: Ileete-a Shuoot. (4...10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut mufe-a 33% faester und gaeeen 5...15 Heaelt per secund vheele-a mufeeng.

1597.name: "Zeey're-a oon Fure-a!"
1597.description: Shuoot. Fur 10 secunds, paerty members veetheen iaershut taeke-a 5...35% less daemaege-a frum fues sooffffereeng frum Boorneeng.
1597.concise: Shuoot. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut taeke-a 5...35% less daemaege-a frum Boorneeng fues.

1598.name: "Nefer Soorrender!"
1598.description: Shuoot. Fur 15 secunds, aell paerty members veetheen iaershut und beloo 75% Heaelt gaeeen +1...5 Heaelt regeneraeshun.
1598.concise: Shuoot. (15 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen +1...5 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Oonly aeffffects paerty members beloo 75% Heaelt.

1599.name: "It's Joost a Flesh Vuoond."
1599.description: Ileete-a Shuoot. Taerget oozeer aelly luses aell cundeeshuns. Iff a cundeeshun vaes remufed in thees vaey, thaet aelly mufes 25% faester fur 1...10 secunds.
1599.concise: Ileete-a Shuoot. Remufe-a aell cundeeshuns frum taerget aelly. Thaet aelly mufes 25% faester (1...10 secunds) iff a cundeeshun vaes remufed. Cunnut selff-taerget.

1600.name: Baerbed Speaer
1600.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoor taerget begeens Bleedeeng fur 5...20 secunds.
1600.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

1601.name: Feeceeuoos Aettaeck
1601.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo lund a creeteecael heet veet thees aettaeck, taerget fue-a sooffffers frum a Deep Vuoond fur 5...15 secunds.
1601.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...15 secunds) veet a creeteecael heet.

1602.name: Stoonneeng Streeke-a
1602.description: Ileete-a Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +10...50 daemaege-a. Iff it heets a fue-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun, thaet fue-a is aelsu Daezed fur 4...10 secunds.
1602.concise: Ileete-a Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +10...50 daemaege-a. Inffleects Daezed cundeeshun (4...10 secunds) iff taerget haes a cundeeshun.

1603.name: Merceeless Speaer
1603.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a fue-a veet less thun 50% Heaelt, thaet fue-a sooffffers frum a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds.
1603.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Nu iffffect unless taerget haes less thun 50% Heaelt.

1604.name: Deesroopteeng Throo
1604.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a fue-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun, thaet fue-a is interroopted.
1604.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Interroopts aecshuns. Nu iffffect unless taerget haes a cundeeshun.

1605.name: Veeld Throo
1605.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, it deaels +5...20 daemaege-a, und uny stunce-a beeeng used by yuoor taerget inds. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked. Aell ooff yuoor nun-speaer aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 3 secunds.
1605.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Inds taerget's stunce-a.Deesaebles yuoor nun-speaer aettaeck skeells fur 3 secunds.

1633.name: Maeleeceeuoos Streeke-a
1633.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a fue-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun, yuoo deael +10...30 daemaege-a und thees aettaeck resoolts in a creeteecael heet.
1633.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff taerget fue-a haes a cundeeshun, thees aettaeck deaels +10...30 daemaege-a und is a creeteecael heet.

1634.name: Shaettereeng Aessoolt
1634.description: Ileete-a Dooael Aettaeck. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck. Iff it heets, yuoo deael 5...50 daemaege-a und taerget fue-a luses oone-a inchuntment. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
1634.concise: Ileete-a Dooael Aettaeck. Deaels 5...50 daemaege-a. Remufes oone-a inchuntment. Unbluckaeble-a. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

1635.name: Guldee Skooll Streeke-a
1635.description: Ileete-a Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Iff yuoo aere-a under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment und thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a is Daezed 1...12 secunds.
1635.concise: Ileete-a Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Inffleects Daezed cundeeshun (1...12 secunds). Nu iffffect unless yuoo aere-a inchunted.

1636.name: Blaeck Speeder Streeke-a
1636.description: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Moost streeke-a a hexed fue-a. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +5...20 daemaege-a und taerget fue-a is Pueesuned fur 5...20 secunds.
1636.concise: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Moost streeke-a a hexed fue-a.

1637.name: Guldee Fux Streeke-a
1637.description: Leaed Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a taekes +10...30 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
1637.concise: Leaed Aettaeck. Deaels +10...30 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a iff yuoo aere-a inchunted.

1638.name: Deaedly Haeste-a
1638.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...35 secunds, haelff-runged spells caest 5...50% faester und rechaerge-a 5...60% faester.
1638.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoor haelff-runged spells caest 5...50% faester und rechaerge-a 5...60% faester.

1639.name: Aessaesseen's Remedy
1639.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, zee next 1...10 aettaeck skeells yuoo use-a remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun.
1639.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoor next 1...10 aettaeck skeells iaech remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun.

1640.name: Fux's Prumeese-a
1640.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, yuoor daegger aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked. Thees inchuntment inds zee next teeme-a yuoo faeeel tu heet.
1640.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoor daegger aettaecks aere-a unbluckaeble-a. Inds zee next teeme-a yuoo faeeel tu heet.

1641.name: Feeegned Neootraeleety
1641.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +7 Heaelt regeneraeshun und +80 aermur. Thees inchuntment inds iff yuoo sooccessffoolly heet veet un aettaeck oor use-a a skeell.
1641.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (4...10 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +7 Heaelt regeneraeshun und +80 aermur. Inds iff yuoo heet veet un aettaeck oor use-a a skeell.

1642.name: Heeddee Caeltrups
1642.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Yuoor nun-Aessaesseen skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 3 secunds. Fur 1...10 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 50% slooer. Vhee thees hex inds thaet fue-a is creeppled fur 1...15 secunds.
1642.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (1...10 secunds.) Cooses 50% slooer mufement. Ind iffffect: inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (1...15 secunds). Yuoor nun-Aessaesseen skeells aere-a deesaebled (3 secunds).

1643.name: Aessoolt Inchuntments
1643.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Moost fulloo a dooael aettaeck. Taerget fue-a luses aell inchuntments.
1643.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. Remufes aell inchuntments. Moost fulloo a dooael aettaeck.

1644.name: Vaestrel's Cullaepse-a
1644.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Iff taerget fue-a is nut useeng a skeell, thaet fue-a is knucked doon. Aell ooff yuoor nun-daegger aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 10 secunds.
1644.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Cooses knuck-doon iff taerget fue-a is nut useeng a skeell. Deesaebles yuoor nun-daegger aettaeck skeells (10 secunds).

1645.name: Leefft Inchuntment
1645.description: Skeell. Iff taerget tuooched fue-a is knucked doon, thaet fue-a luses oone-a inchuntment.
1645.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment.Nu iffffect unless taerget fue-a is knucked-doon.

1646.name: Oogoory ooff Deaet
1646.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...35 secunds, zee next teeme-a daemaege-a vuoold drup taerget fue-a's Heaelt beloo 50%, yuoo inffleect a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds und Shaedoo Step tu thaet fue-a. Thees spell haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a.
1646.concise: Haelff Runge-a Hex Spell. (5...35 secunds.) Inffleect Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) und Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a zee next teeme-a daemaege-a vuoold drup thees fue-a's Heaelt beloo 50%. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1647.name: Seegnet ooff Tuxeec Shuck
1647.description: Seegnet. Iff taerget fue-a is sooffffereeng frum Pueesun, thaet fue-a taekes 10...100 daemaege-a.
1647.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 10...100 daemaege-a. Nu iffffect unless taerget fue-a is Pueesuned.

1648.name: Seegnet ooff Tveeleeght
1648.description: Seegnet. Fur iaech hex oon taerget fue-a, thaet fue-a luses oone-a inchuntment.
1648.concise: Seegnet. Remufes oone-a inchuntment fur iaech hex oon taerget fue-a.

1649.name: Vaey ooff zee Aessaesseen
1649.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur zee next 20 secunds vheele-a veeeldeeng daeggers, yuoo aettaeck 5...20% faester und haefe-a a +5...35% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet.
1649.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (20 secunds.) Vheele-a veeeldeeng daeggers, yuoo aettaeck 5...20% faester und haefe-a +5...35% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet.

1650.name: Shaedoo Vaelk
1650.description: Stunce-a. Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Fur 15 secunds, nutheeng haeppens. Yuoor aettaeck skeells aere-a deesaebled fur 1 secund, und yuoor stunces und inchuntments aere-a deesaebled fur 10 secunds. Vhee thees stunce-a inds, yuoo retoorn tu yuoor ooreegeenael lucaeshun.
1650.concise: Stunce-a. (15 secunds.) Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Ind iffffect: retoorn tu yuoor ooreegeenael lucaeshun. Deesaebles yuoor aettaeck skeells fur 1 secund. Deesaebles yuoor inchuntments und stunces fur 10 secunds.

1651.name: Deaet's Retreaet
1651.description: Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget aelly. Iff yuoo haefe-a less Heaelt thun thaet aelly, yuoo gaeeen 40...130 Heaelt.
1651.concise: Spell. Gaeeen 40...130 Heaelt iff yuoo haefe-a less Heaelt thun taerget aelly. Ineeteeael iffffect: Shaedoo Step tu thees aelly. Cunnut selff-taerget.

1652.name: Shaedoo Preesun
1652.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Fur 1...7 secunds, thaet fue-a mufes 66% slooer.
1652.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget fue-a. Thees fue-a mufes 66% slooer (1...7 secunds).

1653.name: Svaep
1653.description: Spell. Yuoo und taerget soommuned creaetoore-a Shaedoo Step tu iaech oozeer's lucaeshun.
1653.concise: Spell. Yuoo und taerget soommuned creaetoore-a Shaedoo Step tu iaech oozeer's lucaeshuns.

1654.name: Shaedoo Meld
1654.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget oozeer aelly. Vhee yuoo stup maeeentaeeeneeng thees inchuntment, yuoo retoorn tu yuoor ooreegeenael lucaeshun.
1654.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Shaedoo Step tu taerget aelly. Ind iffffect: retoorn tu yuoor ooreegeenael lucaeshun. Cunnut selff-taerget.

1655.name: Preece-a ooff Preede-a
1655.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a uses un ileete-a skeell, thaet fue-a luses 3...15 Inergy.
1655.concise: Hex Spell. (5 secunds.) Cooses 3...15 Inergy luss zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a uses un ileete-a skeell.

1656.name: Aeur ooff Deesenchuntment
1656.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Remufe-a oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues. Fur 5...20 secunds, inchuntments ixpure-a 150...300% faester oon thuse-a fues.
1656.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues neaer yuoor taerget (5...20 secunds). Remufe-a oone-a inchuntment frum taerget und neaerby fues. Inchuntments ixpure-a 150...300% faester oon thuse-a fues.

1657.name: Seegnet ooff Cloomseeness
1657.description: Seegnet. Iff taerget fue-a is aettaeckeeng, thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a interroopted und taeke-a 15...60 daemaege-a. Uny fues useeng aettaeck skeells aere-a knucked doon.
1657.concise: Seegnet. Interroopts un aettaeck fur taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues. Interroopshun iffffect: deaels 15...60 daemaege-a; knucks doon fues useeng aettaeck skeells.

1658.name: Symbuleec Pustoore-a
1658.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...20 secunds, zee next seegnet yuoo aecteefaete-a rechaerges 20...80% faester.
1658.concise: Stunce-a. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoor next seegnet rechaerges 20...80% faester.

1659.name: Tuxeec Cheell
1659.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 15...75 culd daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is under zee iffffects ooff a hex oor inchuntment, thaet fue-a becumes Pueesuned fur 10...25 secunds.
1659.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 15...75 culd daemaege-a. Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (10...25 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is hexed oor inchunted.

1660.name: Vell ooff Seelence-a
1660.description: Vell Spell. Ixplueet taerget curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 66% heaelt tu creaete-a a Vell ooff Seelence-a fur 10...30 secunds. Fues veetheen zee vell cunnut use-a shuoots oor chunts und sooffffer -1...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
1660.concise: Vell Spell. (10...30 secunds.) Fues in thees vell cunnut use-a shuoots und chunts und haefe-a -1...4 Heaelt degeneraeshun. Ixplueets a fresh curpse-a oor saecreeffeeces 66% heaelt.

1661.name: Gloostune-a
1661.description: Spell. Send a prujecteele-a thaet streekes fur 5...50 iaert daemaege-a iff it heets. Iff thees spell heets a veaekened fue-a, yuoo gaeeen 5 Inergy ploos 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 runks ooff Inergy Sturaege-a.
1661.concise: Spell. Prujecteele-a: deaels 5...50 iaert daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 5 Inergy ploos 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 runks ooff Inergy Sturaege-a iff taerget fue-a is Veaekened.

1662.name: Meend Blaest
1662.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 15...60 fure-a daemaege-a. Iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a Inergy thun taerget fue-a, yuoo gaeeen 1...8 Inergy.
1662.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 15...60 fure-a daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 1...8 Inergy iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a Inergy thun taerget fue-a.

1663.name: Ilementael Flaeme-a
1663.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...35 secunds, vhenefer yuoo aepply un Ilementael hex tu a fue-a, thaet fue-a is set oon fure-a fur 1...5 secunds.
1663.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10...35 secunds.) Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...5 secunds) vhenefer yuoo aepply un Ilementael hex tu a taerget.

1664.name: Infuke-a Leeghtneeng
1664.description: Ileete-a Spell. Taerget fue-a und up tu tvu oozeer fues neaer yuoor taerget aere-a stroock fur 10...90 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Thees spell haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
1664.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 10...90 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Heets tvu fues neaer taerget. 25% aermur penetraeshun.

1683.name: Penseefe-a Gooaerdeeun
1683.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...11 secunds, taerget aelly haes a 50% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks frum inchunted fues.
1683.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...11 secunds.) 50% chunce-a tu bluck inchunted fues.

1684.name: Screebe-a's Inseeght
1684.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...35 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy vhenefer yuoo use-a a seegnet.
1684.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy vhenefer yuoo use-a a seegnet.

1685.name: Huly Haeste-a
1685.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 1...60 secunds, yuoor Heaeleeng Praeyers spells caest 50% faester. Thees inchuntment inds iff yuoo caest unuzeer inchuntment.
1685.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (1...60 secunds.) Yuoor Heaeleeng Praeyers spells caest 50% faester. Inds iff yuoo caest un inchuntment.

1686.name: Gleemmer ooff Leeght
1686.description: Ileete-a Spell. Heael taerget aelly fur 10...115 Heaelt.

1687.name: Zeaeluoos Benedeecshun
1687.description: Ileete-a Spell. Heael taerget aelly fur 30...180 Heaelt. Iff taerget vaes beloo 50% Heaelt, yuoo gaeeen 7 Inergy.
1687.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Heaels fur 30...180. Yuoo gaeeen 7 Inergy iff taerget aelly vaes beloo 50% Heaelt.

1688.name: Deffender's Zeael
1688.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 10...30 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a heets veet un aettaeck, yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy.
1688.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (10...30 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 2 Inergy vhenefer taerget fue-a heets veet un aettaeck.

1689.name: Seegnet ooff Mysteec Vraet
1689.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a taekes 25 huly daemaege-a fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo (maexeemoom 30...120 huly daemaege-a).
1689.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 25 huly daemaege-a fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo (maexeemoom 30...120 huly daemaege-a).

1690.name: Seegnet ooff Remufael
1690.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Iff taerget aelly is under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, thaet aelly luses oone-a hex und oone-a cundeeshun.
1690.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Remufes oone-a hex und oone-a cundeeshun. Nu iffffect unless taerget aelly is inchunted.

1691.name: Deesmeess Cundeeshun
1691.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun frum taerget aelly. Iff thaet aelly is under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 15...75 Heaelt.
1691.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a cundeeshun. Heaels fur 15...75 iff taerget aelly is inchunted.

1692.name: Deefert Hexes
1692.description: Ileete-a Spell. Remufe-a up tu 1...3 hexes frum taerget aelly. Fur iaech hex remufed in thees vaey, thaet aelly luses oone-a cundeeshun und gaeeens 15...75 Heaelt.
1692.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Remufes 1...3 hexes. Fur iaech hex remufed, taerget aelly luses oone-a cundeeshun und gaeeens 15...75 Heaelt.

1693.name: Cuoonteraettaeck
1693.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...35 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo heet un aettaeckeeng fue-a, yuoo gaeeen 2...6 Inergy.
1693.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 2...6 Inergy iff taerget fue-a is aettaeckeeng.

1694.name: Maegehoonter Streeke-a
1694.description: Ileete-a Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +7...25 daemaege-a. Iff yuoor taerget is under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
1694.concise: Ileete-a Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +7...25 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a iff taerget fue-a is inchunted.

1695.name: Suldeeer's Streeke-a
1695.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +10...40 mure-a daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a under zee iffffects ooff a chunt oor shuoot, thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
1695.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a iff yuoo aere-a under zee iffffects ooff a chunt oor shuoot. Bork! Bork! Bork!

1696.name: Decaepeetaete-a
1696.description: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Yuoo luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a und aell Inergy. Thees aettaeck is unbluckaeble-a, yuoo deael +5...80 daemaege-a, und coose-a a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds. Thees aettaeck is aelvaeys creeteecael und iff fue-a is keelled, neaerby fues aere-a Veaekened fur 8 secunds.
1696.concise: Ileete-a Aexe-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...80 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Ootumaeteec creeteecael heet. Iff fue-a is keelled, neaerby fues aere-a Veaekened (8 secunds). Yuoo luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a und Inergy.

1697.name: Maegehoonter's Smaesh
1697.description: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a is knucked doon. Iff yuoor taerget is under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment, thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
1697.concise: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Cooses knuck-doon. Unbluckaeble-a iff taerget fue-a is inchunted.

1698.name: Suldeeer's Stunce-a

1702.description: Svurd Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +1...31 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo heet a fue-a thaet is knucked doon, yuoo gaeeen 1...5 aedrenaeleene-a.

1719.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +10...25 daemaege-a. Iff yuoor taerget is veetheen iaershut, thaet fue-a begeens Bleedeeng fur 5...20 secunds.
1719.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +10...25 daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is veetheen iaershut.

1720.name: Keee Aerroo
1720.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo lund a creeteecael heet, yuoo deael un aeddeeshunael +5...25 daemaege-a.

1721.name: Raempaege-a aes Oone-a
1721.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Fur 3...15 secunds, but yuoo und yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettaeck 33% faester und roon 25% faester.
1721.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. (3...15 secunds.) Yuoo und yuoor pet aettaeck 33% faester und mufe-a 25% faester. Nu iffffect unless yuoor pet is aeleefe-a.

1722.name: Furked Aerroo
1722.description: Boo Aettaeck. Shuut tvu aerroos seemooltuneuoosly aet taerget fue-a. Iff yuoo aere-a under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment oor hex, yuoo shuut oonly oone-a aerroo.
1722.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Yuoo shuut tvu aerroos seemooltuneuoosly. Shuut oonly oone-a aerroo iff yuoo aere-a inchunted oor hexed.

1723.name: Deesroopteeng Aeccooraecy
1723.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 36 secunds, vhenefer yuoor aerroos creeteecael, zeey aelsu interroopt yuoor taerget. Bork! Bork! Bork!
1723.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (36 secunds.) Interroopts un aecshun vhenefer yuoor aerroos creeteecael.

1724.name: Ixpert's Dextereety
1724.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 1...20 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester und yuoor Maerksmunsheep aettreeboote-a is increaesed by 2.
1724.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (1...20 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester und yuoo gaeeen +2 tu yuoor Maerksmunsheep aettreeboote-a.

1725.name: Ruaereeng Veends
1725.description: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Chunts und shuoots cust 1...5 mure-a Inergy. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...180 secunds.
1725.concise: Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...180 secund leeffespun). Chunts und shuoots cust 1...5 mure-a Inergy fur creaetoores in runge-a.

1726.name: Maegebune-a Shut
1726.description: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, it interroopts taerget fue-a's aecshun. Iff thaet aecshun vaes a spell, it is deesaebled fur un aeddeeshunael 10 secunds. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
1726.concise: Ileete-a Boo Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: un interroopted spell is deesaebled fur +10 secunds. Unbluckaeble-a.

1727.name: Naetoorael Streede-a
1727.description: Stunce-a. Fur 1...8 secunds, yuoo roon 33% faester und haefe-a a 50% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks. Naetoorael Streede-a inds iff yuoo becume-a hexed oor inchunted.
1727.concise: Stunce-a. (1...8 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a 50% chunce-a tu bluck. Inds iff yuoo becume-a hexed oor inchunted.

1728.name: Heket's Raempaege-a
1728.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Thees stunce-a inds iff yuoo use-a un aettaeck skeell.
1728.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Inds iff yuoo use-a un aettaeck skeell.

1729.name: Smuke-a Traep
1729.description: Ileete-a Traep. Vhee Smuke-a Traep is treeggered, fues in zee aerea aere-a Bleended und Daezed fur 5...10 secunds. Smuke-a Traep inds aeffter 90 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
1729.concise: Ileete-a Traep. (90 secunds.) Inffleects Bleended und Daezed cundeeshuns (5...10 secunds) tu fues in zee aerea. Iaeseely interroopted.

1730.name: Inffooreeaeteeng Heaet
1730.description: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Nun-spureet creaetoores veetheen its runge-a gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a tveece-a aes faest. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...120 secunds.
1730.concise: Ileete-a Naetoore-a Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...120 secund leeffespun). Duoobles aedrenaeleene-a gaeeen fur creaetoores in runge-a.

1731.name: Fucael Vaes Sugulun
1731.description: Item Spell. Fur 60 secunds, aell shuoots und chunts yuoo use-a laest 20...50% lunger.
1731.concise: Item Spell. (60 secunds.) Shuoots und chunts yuoo use-a laest 20...50% lunger.

1732.name: Destroocteefe-a Vaes Glaeeefe-a
1732.description: Ileete-a Item Spell. Huld Glaeeefe-a's aeshes fur up tu 30...60 secunds. Vheele-a yuoo huld her aeshes, aell Reetooaeleest skeells haefe-a 20% aermur penetraeshun. Vhee yuoo drup her aeshes, aell fues in zee aerea aere-a stroock fur 15...85 leeghtneeng daemaege-a.

1733.name: Veeelder's Streeke-a
1733.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 10...60 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a under zee iffffects ooff a veaepun spell, yuoo deael un aeddeeshunael 10...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a.

1734.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Destruy taerget spureet und creaete-a a lefel 1...14 Spureet ooff Foory. Thees spureet's aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.

1754.concise: Ileete-a Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (3...15 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck, mufe-a, und gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a 25% faester.

1758.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, aettaecks aegaeeenst mufeeng fues aelsu Creepple-a thuse-a fues fur 2...9 secunds. 1759.name: Foo ooff Strengt

1759.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (15 secunds.) Aettaecks veet a scyzee deael 10...25 slaesheeng daemaege-a tu aell aedjaecent fues vhenefer yuoo aettaeck.

1761.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 1...6 Inergy iaech teeme-a yuoo heet veet un aettaeck. Yuoo haefe-a -2 Inergy regeneraeshun.

1762.name: Heaert ooff Foory

1763.name: Zeaeluoos Renooael

1765.name: Rendeeng Oora

2137.name: Cunffooseeng Imaeges
2137.description: Hex Spell. Fur 2...10 secunds, taerget fue-a taekes tveece-a aes lung tu aecteefaete-a nun-aettaeck skeells.
2137.concise: Hex Spell. (2...10 secunds.) Taerget fue-a taekes tveece-a aes lung tu aecteefaete-a nun-aettaeck skeells.

2138.name: Hexer's Feegur
2138.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +1...8 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Hexer's Feegur inds iff yuoo caest a nun-hex skeell.
2138.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +1...8 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Inds iff yuoo use-a a nun-hex skeell.

2139.name: Maesucheesm
2139.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...40 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +2 tu yuoor Deaet Maegeec und Suool Reaepeeng aettreebootes und saecreeffeece-a 5...3% ooff yuoor maexeemoom Heaelt vhenefer yuoo caest a spell.
2139.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10...40 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +2 Deaet Maegeec und Suool Reaepeeng. Yuoo saecreeffeece-a 5...3% ooff yuoor maexeemoom Heaelt vhenefer yuoo caest a spell.

2140.name: Peeerceeng Traep
2140.description: Traep. Vhee Peeerceeng Traep is treeggered, aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 5...50 peeerceeng daemaege-a. Uny fues veet Craecked Aermur aere-a stroock fur un aeddeeshunael 15...60 daemaege-a. Peeerceeng Traep inds aeffter 90 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
2140.concise: Traep. (90 secunds.) Aeffffects neaerby fues. Deaels 5...50 peeerceeng daemaege-a. Deaels 15...60 mure-a daemaege-a tu uny fues veet Craecked Aermur. Iaeseely interroopted.

2141.name: Cumpuneeunsheep
2141.description: Skeell. Iff yuoo haefe-a less Heaelt thun yuoor pet, yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 30...120 Heaelt. Iff yuoor pet haes less Heaelt thun yuoo, it is heaeled fur 30...120 Heaelt.
2141.concise: Skeell. Heaels yuoo fur 30...120 iff yuoo haefe-a less Heaelt thun yuoor pet. Heaels yuoor pet fur 30...120 iff it haes less Heaelt thun yuoo.

2142.name: Ferael Aeggresseeun
2142.description: Skeell. Fur 5...20 secunds, yuoor pet aettaecks 33% faester und deaels 3...10 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a.
2142.concise: Skeell. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoor pet aettaecks 33% faester und deaels +3...10 daemaege-a.

2143.name: Deesroopteeng Shut
2143.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a's aecshun is interroopted. Iff thaet aecshun vaes a skeell, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a.
2143.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: +10...40 daemaege-a iff yuoo interroopt a skeell.

2144.name: Fulley
2144.description: Boo Aettaeck. Aell yuoor prepaeraeshuns aere-a remufed. Shuut aerroos aet taerget fue-a und up tu 3 fue-as aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget. Zeese-a aerroos streeke-a fur +1...10 daemaege-a iff zeey heet.
2144.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +1...10 daemaege-a. Heets up tu 3 fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget. Aell yuoor prepaeraeshuns aere-a remufed.

2145.name: Ixpert Fucoos
2145.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 24 secunds, yuoor boo aettaeck skeells cust 1...2 less Inergy und deael 1...10 ixtra daemaege-a.
2145.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (24 secunds.) Yuoor boo aettaeck skeells cust 1...2 less Inergy und du +1...10 daemaege-a.

2146.name: Peeuoos Foory
2146.description: Stunce-a. Remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Fur 1...7 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 25% faester. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, thees stunce-a laests tveece-a aes lung.
2146.concise: Stunce-a. (1...7 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 25% faester und remufe-a 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: thees stunce-a laests tveece-a aes lung.

2147.name: Creeppleeng Feectury
2147.description: Scyzee Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets a fue-a, thaet fue-a is Creeppled fur 3...8 secunds. Iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a Heaelt thun taerget fue-a, aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...30 iaert daemaege-a.
2147.concise: Scyzee Aettaeck. (3...8 secunds.) Creepples taerget fue-a. Iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a Heaelt thun taerget fue-a, aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...30 iaert daemaege-a.

2148.name: Soondereeng Veaepun
2148.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 4...10 secunds, taerget aelly's next 3 aettaecks haefe-a 10% aermur penetraeshun und coose-a Craecked Aermur fur 5...20 secunds.
2148.concise: Veaepun Spell. (4...10 secunds.) Taerget aelly's next 3 aettaecks inffleect Craecked Aermur cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) und haefe-a 10% aermur penetraeshun.

2149.name: Veaepun ooff Renooael
2149.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly heets veet un aettaeck skeell, thaet aelly gaeeens 1...7 Inergy.
2149.concise: Veaepun Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget aelly gaeeens 1...7 Inergy zee next teeme-a thees aelly heets veet un aettaeck skeell.

2150.name: Maeeemeeng Speaer
2150.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff yuoor aettaeck heets a Bleedeeng fue-a, thaet fue-a is Creeppled fur 5...20 secunds.
2150.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is Bleedeeng.

2186.name: Seegnet ooff Deaedly Curroopshun
2186.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a taekes 5...35 daemaege-a fur iaech cundeeshun oon thaet fue-a (maexeemoom 130 daemaege-a).
2186.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 5...35 daemaege-a (maexeemoom 130) fur iaech cundeeshun oon taerget fue-a.

2187.name: Vaey ooff zee Maester
2187.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, vheele-a huldeeng a nun-daegger veaepun, yuoo haefe-a un aeddeeshunael 3...33% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet.
2187.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (60 secunds.) Vheele-a huldeeng a nun-daegger veaepun, yuoo haefe-a +3...33% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet.

2188.name: Deffeele-a Deffenses
2188.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a blucks, thaet fue-a taekes 30...120 daemaege-a.
2188.concise: Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Deaels 30...120 daemaege-a zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a blucks.

2189.name: Ungurudun's Gaeze-a
2189.description: Spell. Steael 10...50 Heaelt frum taerget fue-a. Iff yuoo aere-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun, yuoo gaeeen 3...12 Inergy. Bork! Bork! Bork!
2189.concise: Spell. Steaels 10...50 Heaelt. Yuoo gaeeen 3...12 Inergy iff yuoo haefe-a a cundeeshun.

2190.name: Maegneteec Soorge-a
2190.description: Inchuntment Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, Maegneteec Soorge-a inchunts aell aelleees in iaershut fur 1...5 secunds tu bluck zee next aettaeck aegaeeenst zeem.
2190.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Deaels 15...75 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo aere-a Oofercaest, aelleees in iaershut aere-a inchunted fur 1...5 und bluck zee next aettaeck aegaeeenst zeem.

2191.name: Sleeppery Gruoond
2191.description: Spell. Iff taerget oor aedjaecent fues aere-a Bleend oor mufeeng, zeese-a fues aere-a knucked doon. Zeere-a is a 50% chunce-a ooff faeeeloore-a veet Vaeter Maegeec less thun 5.
2191.concise: Spell. Cooses knuck-doon iff thees fue-a is Bleend oor mufeeng. Aeffffects fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Vaeter Maegeec greaeter thun 4.

2192.name: Glooeeng Ice-a
2192.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 5...50 culd daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is under zee iffffects ooff a Vaeter Maegeec hex, yuoo gaeeen 5 Inergy ploos 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 runks ooff Inergy Sturaege-a.
2192.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...50 culd daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 5 Inergy ploos 1 Inergy fur ifery 2 runks ooff Inergy Sturaege-a iff taerget fue-a is hexed veet Vaeter Maegeec.

2193.name: Inergy Blaest
2193.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 1...2 daemaege-a fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy yuoo haefe-a (maexeemoom 130 daemaege-a).
2193.concise: Spell. Deaels 1...2 daemaege-a (maexeemoom 130) fur iaech pueent ooff Inergy yuoo haefe-a.

2194.name: Deestraecteeng Streeke-a
2194.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff Deestraecteeng Streeke-a heets, it deaels nu daemaege-a und interroopts taerget fue-a's aecshun. Iff taerget fue-a haes Craecked Aermur, thaet skeell is deesaebled fur 30 secunds.
2194.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: Deesaebles interroopted skeell (30 secunds) iff taerget fue-a haes Craecked Aermur. Deaels nu daemaege-a.

2195.name: Symbuleec Streeke-a
2195.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +12 daemaege-a fur iaech seegnet yuoo haefe-a iqooeepped (maexeemoom 70 daemaege-a).
2195.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +12 daemaege-a (maexeemoom 70) fur iaech seegnet yuoo haefe-a iqooeepped.

2196.name: Suldeeer's Speed
2196.description: Stunce-a. Fur 3...18 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 15% faester. Yuoo mufe-a un aeddeeshunael 15% faester vheele-a under zee iffffects ooff a chunt oor shuoot.
2196.concise: Stunce-a. (3...18 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 15% faester und un aeddeeshunael 15% faester vheele-a aeffffected by a chunt oor shuoot.

2197.name: Budy Bloo
2197.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a taekes +10...40 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a haes Craecked Aermur, thaet fue-a sooffffers frum a Deep Vuoond fur 0...15 secunds.
2197.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond (0...15 secunds) iff taerget fue-a haes Craecked Aermur.

2198.name: Budy Shut
2198.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff it heets a fue-a veet Craecked Aermur, yuoo gaeeen 5...10 Inergy.
2198.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 5...10 Inergy iff taerget fue-a haes Craecked Aermur.

2199.name: Pueesun Teep Seegnet
2199.description: Seegnet. Fur 60 secunds, yuoor next aettaeck aelsu inffleects Pueesun fur 8...15 secunds.
2199.concise: Seegnet. (60 secunds.) Inffleects Pueesuned cundeeshun (8...15 secunds) veet yuoor next aettaeck.

2200.name: Seegnet ooff Mysteec Speed
2200.description: Seegnet. Fur 30 secunds, yuoor next 1...3 selff-taergeteeng inchuntments caest instuntly. Flaesh inchuntments du nut cunsoome-a uses ooff thees skeell.
2200.concise: Seegnet. (30 secunds.) Yuoor next 1...3 selff-taergeted inchuntments caest instuntly. Flaesh inchuntments du nut cunsoome-a uses ooff thees skeell.

2201.name: Sheeeld ooff Furce-a
2201.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 1...16 secunds, blucks zee next 1 aettaecks aegaeeenst yuoo. Iff un aettaeck is blucked, aell aedjaecent aettaeckeeng fues aere-a knucked doon und sooffffer frum Veaekness fur 5...20 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
2201.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (1...16 secunds.) Blucks zee next 1 aettaecks aegaeeenst yuoo. Knucks doon und inffleects Veaekness (5...20 secunds) oon aell aedjaecent aettaeckeeng fues.

2202.name: Mendeeng Greep
2202.description: Spell. Taerget aelly is heaeled fur 30...90 Heaelt. Iff thaet aelly is under zee iffffects ooff a veaepun spell, thaet aelly luses oone-a cundeeshun.
2202.concise: Spell. Heaels fur 30...90. Remufes oone-a cundeeshun iff taerget aelly is under a Veaepun spell.

2203.name: Spureetleech Oora
2203.description: Skeell. Fur 5...20 secunds, aell ooff yuoor spureets veetheen iaershut deael 5...20 less daemaege-a und steael 5...20 Heaelt vhee zeey aettaeck.
2203.concise: Skeell. (5...20 secunds.) Aell ooff yuoor spureets veetheen iaershut deael 5...20 less daemaege-a und steael 5...20 Heaelt vhee zeey aettaeck. Bork! Bork! Bork!

2204.name: Rejoofenaeshun
2204.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...20 spureet. Thees spureet heaels aell paerty members veetheen iaershut fur 3...10 Heaelt iaech secund. Thees spureet luses 3...10 Heaelt fur iaech paerty member heaeled in thees vaey. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...90 secunds.
2204.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...20 spureet (30...90 secund leeffespun). Heaels paerty members in iaershut fur 3...10 iaech secund. Heaeleeng cust: thees spureet luses 3...10 Heaelt.

2205.name: Aeguny
2205.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...12 spureet. Thees spureet cooses 3...10 Heaelt luss iaech secund tu fues veetheen iaershut. Thees spureet luses 3...10 Heaelt fur iaech fue-a hoort in thees vaey. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...90 secunds.
2205.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...12 spureet (30...90 secund leeffespun). Cooses 3...10 Heaelt luss iaech secund tu fues in iaershut. Thees spureet luses 3...10 Heaelt fur iaech fue-a thaet luses Heaelt.

2206.name: Ghustly Veaepun
2206.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget oozeer aelly's next aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked.
2206.concise: Veaepun Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget aelly's next aettaeck is unbluckaeble-a. Cunnut selff-taerget.

2207.name: Inspuraeshunael Speech
2207.description: Skeell. Yuoo luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a und taerget oozeer aelly gaeeens 1...8 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.
2207.concise: Skeell. Taerget aelly gaeeens 1...8 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Cunnut selff-taerget. Yuoo luse-a aell aedrenaeleene-a.

2208.name: Boorneeng Sheeeld
2208.description: Skeell. Fur 3...9 secunds, vheele-a veeeldeeng a sheeeld, zee next aettaeck skeell used aegaeeenst yuoo is blucked. Iff it vaes a melee-a aettaeck, yuoor aettaecker is set oon fure-a fur 1...6 secunds.
2208.concise: Skeell. (3...9 secunds.) Blucks zee next aettaeck skeell aegaeeenst yuoo. Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...6 secunds) iff it vaes a melee-a aettaeck. Nu iffffect unless yuoo aere-a veeeldeeng a sheeeld.

2209.name: Huly Speaer
2209.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff it heets a soommuned creaetoore-a, aell neaerby fues taeke-a 15...90 huly daemaege-a, und aere-a set oon fure-a fur 3 secunds.
2209.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Deaels 15...90 huly daemaege-a und inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (3 secunds) tu neaerby fues iff yuoo heet a soommuned creaetoore-a.

2210.name: Speaer Sveepe-a
2210.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...20 daemaege-a und taerget fue-a is Daezed fur 4...10 secunds. Thees aettaeck haes melee-a runge-a.
2210.concise: Speaer Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a und inffleects Daezed cundeeshun (4...10 secunds). Thees aettaeck haes melee-a runge-a.

2211.name: Aelkaer's Aelchemeecael Aeceed
2211.description: Spell. Throo Aelkaer's Aelchemeecael Aeceed aet taerget fue-a. Taerget und aedjaecent fues aere-a stroock fur 40...50 daemaege-a. Destruyers taeke-a un aeddeeshunael 45...70 daemaege-a und zeey haefe-a Craecked Aermur fur 14...20 secunds.
2211.concise: Spell. Prujecteele-a: deaels 40...50 daemaege-a tu taerget und aedjaecent fues. Deaels 45...70 mure-a daemaege-a und inffleects Craecked Aermur cundeeshun (14...20 secunds) tu Destruyers.

2212.name: Leeght ooff Deldreemur
2212.description: Spell. Aell fues in zee aerea aere-a stroock fur 55...80 huly daemaege-a. Zee lucaeshun ooff heeddee oobjects aere-a breeeffly indeecaeted oon yuoor Cumpaess. Uny heeddee oobjects in zee aerea aere-a refeaeled.
2212.concise: Spell. Deaels 55...80 huly daemaege-a tu fues in zee aerea. Peengs heeddee oobjects veetheen zee aerea oon zee cumpaess.

2213.name: Iaer Beete-a
2213.description: Skeell. Taerget tuooched fue-a taekes 50...70 peeerceeng daemaege-a und begeens Bleedeeng fur 15...25 secunds.
2213.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Deaels 50...70 peeerceeng daemaege-a und Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (15...25 secunds).

2214.name: Loo Bloo
2214.description: Skeell. Streeke-a taerget fue-a fur 45...70 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is knucked doon, thaet fue-a taekes un aeddeeshunael 30...50 daemaege-a und sooffffers frum Craecked Aermur fur 14...20 secunds.
2214.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Deaels 45...70 daemaege-a. Deaels 30...50 mure-a daemaege-a und Inffleects Craecked Aermur (14...20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a is knucked-doon.

2215.name: Braevleeng Heaedboott
2215.description: Skeell. Yuoo heaedboott taerget tuooched fue-a, deaeleeng 45...70 daemaege-a und knuckeeng doon thaet fue-a iff it heets. Bork! Bork! Bork!
2215.concise: Tuooch Skeell. Deaels 45...70 daemaege-a; cooses knuck-doon.

2216.name: "Dun't Treep!"
2216.description: Shuoot. Fur 3...5 secunds, paerty members veetheen iaershut cunnut be-a knucked doon.
2216.concise: Shuoot. (3...5 secunds.) Prefents knuck-doon; aeffffects paerty members veetheen iaershut.

2217.name: "By Urael's Haemmer!"
2217.description: Shuoot. Fur 30 secunds, aell deaed paerty members in iaershut aere-a resoorrected veet fooll Heaelt und Inergy. Resoorrected paerty members deael 25...33% mure-a daemaege-a. Vhee thees iffffect inds, aeffffected paerty members deee-a. Thees skeell dues nut incoor a deaet penaelty.
2217.concise: Shuoot. (30 secunds.) Resoorrect aell deaed paerty members in iaershut veet fooll Heaelt und Inergy. Aeffffected paerty members deael 25...33% mure-a daemaege-a. Aeffffected paerty members deee-a vhee it inds, boot du nut receeefe-a a deaet penaelty.

2218.name: Droonkee Maester
2218.description: Stunce-a. Fur 72...90 secunds, yuoor mufement und aettaeck speeds aere-a increaesed by 10...15%. Iff yuoo aere-a droonk vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoor mufement und aettaeck speeds aere-a increaesed by 25...33% insteaed.
2218.concise: Stunce-a. (72...90 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a und aettaeck 10...15% faester iff yuoo aere-a nut droonk. Yuoo mufe-a und aettaeck 25...33% faester iff yuoo aere-a droonk.

2219.name: Greaet Dvaerff Veaepun
2219.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 20 secunds, taerget oozeer aelly's veaepun streekes fur +15...20 daemaege-a und haes a 28...40% chunce-a tu coose-a knuck doon. Bork! Bork! Bork!
2219.concise: Veaepun Spell. (20 secunds.) +15...20 veaepun daemaege-a und 28...40% chunce-a tu coose-a knuck-doon veet aettaecks. Cunnut selff-taerget.

2220.name: Greaet Dvaerff Aermur
2220.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 22...40 secunds, taerget aelly haes +24 aermur, +60 maexeemoom Heaelt, und un aeddeeshunael +24 aermur aegaeeenst Destruyers.
2220.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (22...40 secunds.) +24 aermur und +60 maexeemoom Heaelt. Aeddeeshunael +24 aermur aegaeeenst Destruyers. Bork! Bork! Bork!

2221.name: Breaet ooff zee Greaet Dvaerff
2221.description: Spell. Aell paerty members aere-a releeefed ooff Boorneeng und aere-a heaeled fur 50...60 Heaelt.
2221.concise: Spell. Remufes Boorneeng und heaels fur 50...60; aeffffects paerty members.

2222.name: Snoo Sturm
2222.description: Spell. Creaete-a a Snoo Sturm aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur 5 secunds, fues aedjaecent tu thaet lucaeshun aere-a stroock fur 30...40 culd daemaege-a iaech secund.
2222.concise: Spell. Deaels 30...40 culd daemaege-a iaech secund (5 secunds). Heets fues aedjaecent tu taerget fue-a's ineeteeael lucaeshun.

2223.name: Blaeck Pooder Meene-a
2223.description: Traep. Vhee Blaeck Pooder Meene-a is treeggered, aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 20...30 daemaege-a, becume-a Bleended, und begeen Bleedeeng fur 7...10 secunds. Blaeck Pooder Meene-a inds aeffter 90 secunds. Vheele-a aecteefaeteeng thees skeell, yuoo aere-a iaeseely interroopted.
2223.concise: Traep. (90 secunds.) Aeffffects neaerby fues. Deaels 20...30 daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleendness und Bleedeeng cundeeshuns (7...10 secunds). Iaeseely interroopted.

2224.name: Soommun Moorsaeaet

2228.name: Defft Streeke-a

2230.concise: Seegnet. (14...20 secunds.) Taerget und aedjaecent fues mufe-a und aettaeck 23...40% slooer.

2231.description: Vaerd Spell. Yuoo plunt un Ibun Baettle-a Stundaerd ooff Cuooraege-a aet yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 14...20 secunds, nun-spureet aelleees in thees aerea gaeeen +24 aermur und un aeddeeshunael +24 aermur aegaeeenst Chaerr.

2232.name: Ibun Baettle-a Stundaerd ooff Veesdum
2232.description: Vaerd Spell. Yuoo plunt un Ibun Baettle-a Stundaerd ooff Veesdum aet yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 14...20 secunds, nun-spureet aelleees in thees aerea haefe-a a 44...60% chunce-a tu haelfe-a zee rechaerge-a teeme-a ooff spells zeey caest. Bork! Bork! Bork!

2233.description: Vaerd Spell. Yuoo plunt un Ibun Baettle-a Stundaerd ooff Hunur aet yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 14...20 secunds, nun-spureet aelleees in thees aerea streeke-a fur +8...15 daemaege-a und un aeddeeshunael +7...10 aegaeeenst Chaerr.

2235.name: Ibun Fungooaerd Aessaesseen Sooppurt

Iff taerget fue-a is nut a Chaerr, zee Aessaesseen leefes fur 12...15 secunds.

Iff thees fue-a is a Chaerr, zee aessaesseen leefes fur 24...30 secunds. Iff thees fue-a is nut a Chaerr, zee aessaesseen leefes fur 12...15 secunds.

2236.description: Vell Spell. Ixplueet neaerest curpse-a oor saecreeffeece-a 66% heaelt tu creaete-a a Vell ooff Rooeen aet its lucaeshun. Fur 5...30 secunds, vhenefer a fue-a in zee vell taekes physeecael daemaege-a, thaet fue-a haes Craecked Aermur fur 5...20 secunds.
