2807.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 10...70 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. 25% aermur penetraeshun. Bleends aell aedjaecent fues (1...5 secunds). Yuoo instuntly mufe-a tu yuoor taerget. Maey taerget aelleees.

2808.name: Inraeged Smaesh (PfP)
2808.description: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Inraeged Smaesh heets, yuoo gaeeen 1...3 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a. Iff yuoo heet a mufeeng fue-a, yuoo streeke-a fur +10...40 daemaege-a, und yuoor taerget is knucked doon.
2808.concise: Ileete-a Haemmer Aettaeck. Geefes yuoo 1...3 streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a iff yuoo heet. Deaels +10...40 daemaege-a und cooses knuckdoon iff yuoor taerget vaes mufeeng.

2809.name: Oobseedeeun Flaeme-a (PfP)
2809.description: Spell. Deael 22...92 daemaege-a tu taerget fue-a. Thees spell ignures aermur.

2857.name: Aeegees  (PfP)
2857.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 1...3 secunds, taerget oozeer paerty member cunnut be-a zee taerget ooff husteele-a spells, und aettaecks aegaeeenst thees paerty member faeeel.
2857.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (1...3 secunds.) Taerget paerty member cunnut be-a taergeted by husteele-a spells. Aettaecks aegaeeenst thees paerty member faeeel. Cunnut selff-taerget.

2858.name: "Vaetch Yuoorselff!" (PfP)
2858.description: Shuoot. Paerty members veetheen iaershut gaeeen +5...25 aermur fur 10 secunds. Thees shuoot inds aeffter 1...3 incumeeng aettaecks.
2858.concise: Shuoot. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut haefe-a +5...25 aermur. Inds aeffter 1...3 incumeeng aettaecks.

2859.name: Inffeeble-a (PfP)
2859.description: Spell. Taerget sooffffers frum Veaekness fur 10...30 secunds.

2860.name: Izeer Renooael (PfP)
2860.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10 secunds, iaech teeme-a yuoo caest a spell, yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy und 5...20 Heaelt fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo.
2860.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (10 secunds.) Iaech teeme-a yuoo caest a spell, yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy und 5...20 Heaelt fur iaech inchuntment oon yuoo.

2861.name: Penetraeteeng Aettaeck (PfP)
2861.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Penetraeteeng Aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...15 daemaege-a und thees aettaeck haes 10% aermur penetraeshun.
2861.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...15 daemaege-a. 10% aermur penetraeshun. Bork! Bork! Bork!

2862.name: Shaedoo Furm (PfP)
2862.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, aell husteele-a spells thaet taerget yuoo faeeel und aell aettaecks aegaeeenst yuoo meess. Vhee Shaedoo Furm inds, luse-a aell boot 5...50 Heaelt.
2862.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Husteele-a spells taergeteeng yuoo faeeel, und aettaecks aegaeeenst yuoo meess. Ind iffffect: luse-a aell boot 5...50 Heaelt.

2863.name: Deescurd (PfP)
2863.description: Ileete-a Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun und under zee iffffects ooff a hex oor un inchuntment, thaet fue-a sooffffers 30...110 daemaege-a.
2863.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 30...110 daemaege-a. Nu iffffect unless taerget fue-a haes a cundeeshun und is ieezeer hexed oor inchunted.

2864.name: Soondereeng Aettaeck (PfP)
2864.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff Soondereeng Aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...15 daemaege-a und thees aettaeck haes 10% aermur penetraeshun.
2864.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...15 daemaege-a. 10% aermur penetraeshun. Bork! Bork! Bork!

2866.name: Flesh ooff My Flesh (PfP)
2866.description: Spell. Luse-a haelff yuoor Heaelt. Resoorrect taerget paerty member veet yuoor coorrent Heaelt und 5...20% Inergy.
2866.concise: Spell. Resoorrects taerget paerty member (haelff yuoor coorrent Heaelt und 5...20% Inergy). Luse-a haelff yuoor Heaelt.

2867.name: Uncesturs' Raege-a (PfP)
2867.description: Skeell. Fur 3 secunds aell fues aedjaecent tu taerget aelly taeke-a 4...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a iaech secund.
2867.concise: Skeell. (3 secunds.) Deaels 4...50 leeghtneeng daemaege-a tu fues aedjaecent tu taerget aelly iaech secund.

2868.name: Spleenter Veaepun (PfP)
2868.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 20 secunds, taerget aelly haes a Spleenter Veaepun. Taerget aelly's next 1...5 aettaecks deal 5...40 daemaege-a tu up tu 4 aedjaecent fues.
2868.concise: Veaepun Spell. (20 secunds.) Aettaecks deael 5...40 daemaege-a tu 3 aedjaecent fues. Inds aeffter 1...5 aettaecks.

2869.name: Aessaesseen's Remedy  (PfP)
2869.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, zee next 1...10 aettaeck skeells yuoo use-a remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun.
2869.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoor next 1...10 aettaeck skeells iaech remufe-a oone-a cundeeshun.

2871.name: Leeght ooff Deleeferunce-a (PfP)
2871.description: Ileete-a Spell. Aell paerty members aere-a heaeled fur 5...70 Heaelt. Aell yuoor Smeeteeng Praeyers aere-a deesaebled fur 20 secunds.
2871.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Heaels inture-a paerty fur 5...70. Deesaebles yuoor Smeeteeng Praeyers (20 secunds).

2872.name: Deaet Paect Seegnet (PfP)
2872.description: Seegnet. Resoorrect taerget paerty member veet yuoor coorrent Heaelt und 15...100% maexeemoom Inergy. Zee next teeme-a thaet aelly deees veetheen 120 secunds, su du yuoo.
2872.concise: Seegnet. Resoorrects taerget paerty member veet yuoor coorrent Heaelt und 15...100% maexeemoom Inergy. Fur 120 secunds, yuoo deee-a zee next teeme-a thees paerty member deees.

2875.name: Haerreeer's Tuss (PfP)
2875.description: Speaer Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo deael +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff thees aettaeck heets a mufeeng fue-a, it deaels un aeddeeshunael 5...40 daemaege-a.
2875.concise: Speaer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Deaels 5...40 mure-a daemaege-a iff taerget is mufeeng.

2876.name: Deffenseefe-a Unzeem (PfP)
2876.description: Ileete-a Chunt. Fur 4...10 secunds, iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut haes a 50% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks. Thees chunt inds iff thaet paerty member heets veet un aettaeck skeell.
2876.concise: Ileete-a Chunt. (4...10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut haefe-a 50% chunce-a tu bluck. Inds vhee heetteeng veet un aettaeck skeell.

2877.name: Baellaed ooff Resturaeshun (PfP)
2877.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut taekes daemaege-a, thaet paerty member gaeeens 15...75 Heaelt.
2877.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen 15...75 Heaelt zee next teeme-a zeey taeke-a daemaege-a.

2878.name: Sung ooff Resturaeshun (PfP)
2878.description: Ileete-a Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut uses a skeell, thaet paerty member gaeeens 45...110 Heaelt.
2878.concise: Ileete-a Chunt. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen 45...110 Heaelt veet zeeur next skeell.

2879.name: "Incumeeng!" (PfP)
2879.description: Ileete-a Shuoot. Fur 4...10 secunds, aell aelleees veetheen iaershut mufe-a 33% faester und gaeeen 5...15 Heaelt per secund vheele-a mufeeng.
2879.concise: Ileete-a Shuoot. (4...10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut mufe-a 33% faester und gaeeen 5...15 Heaelt per secund vheele-a mufeeng.

2880.name: "Nefer Soorrender!" (PfP)
2880.description: Shuoot. Fur 10 secunds, aell paerty members veetheen iaershut und beloo 75% Heaelt gaeeen +1...5 Heaelt regeneraeshun.
2880.concise: Shuoot. (10 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen +1...5 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Oonly aeffffects paerty members beloo 75% Heaelt.

2883.name: "Fur Greaet Joosteece-a!" (PfP)
2883.description: Shuoot. Fur 8 secunds, vhenefer yuoo heet veet un aettaeck, yuoo gaeeen 1 aeddeeshunael streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a.
2883.concise: Shuoot. (8 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 1 ixtra streeke-as ooff aedrenaeleene-a vhenefer yuoo heet veet un aettaeck.

2884.name: Mysteec Regeneraeshun (PfP)
2884.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun fur iaech inchuntment (maexeemoom ooff 3) oon yuoo.
2884.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +1...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun fur iaech inchuntment (maexeemoom ooff 3) oon yuoo.

2885.name: Inffeebleeng Bluud (PfP)
2885.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a und aell neaerby fues sooffffer frum Veaekness fur 1...16 secunds. Bork! Bork! Bork!
2885.concise: Spell. Inffleects Veaekness cundeeshun (1...16 secunds) oon thees fue-a und neaerby fues.

2887.name: Seegnet ooff Joodgment (PfP)
2887.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Taerget fue-a is knucked doon. Thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 5...50 huly daemaege-a. Thees seegnet haes haelff zee nurmael runge-a.
2887.concise: Ileete-a Haelff Runge-a Seegnet. Knucks doon taerget. Deaels 5...50 huly daemaege-a tu taerget und aedjaecent fues.

2891.name: Unyeeeldeeng Oora (PfP)
2891.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Breeng taerget deaed paerty member baeck tu leeffe-a aet fooll Heaelt und fooll Inergy. Iff yuoo stup maeeentaeeeneeng thees inchuntment oor iff thees inchuntment is remufed, thaet paerty member deees und leaefes un ixplueeted curpse-a. Deaeths vheele-a inchunted veet Unyeeeldeeng Oora du nut incoor a deaet penaelty. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Deefeene-a Faefur 4 oor less.)
2891.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Resoorrects taerget paerty member (fooll Heaelt, fooll Inergy). Ind iffffect: thees aelly deees und leaefes un ixplueeted curpse-a. Dues nut incoor a deaet penaelty. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Deefeene-a Faefur 5 oor mure-a.

2892.name: Spureet Bund (PfP)
2892.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 8 secunds, vhenefer taerget aelly taekes mure-a thun 50 daemaege-a frum zee next 10 aettaecks oor spells, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 30...90 Heaelt.
2892.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (8 secunds.) Heaels fur 30...90 vhenefer taerget aelly taekes mure-a thun 50 daemaege-a. Inds aeffter thees aelly taekes daemaege-a frum 10 aettaecks oor spells.

2893.name: Veaepun ooff Vaerdeeng (PfP)
2893.description: Veaepun Spell. Fur 3...8 secunds, taerget aelly haes a Veaepun ooff Vaerdeeng, grunteeng thaet aelly +2...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun und a 50% chunce-a tu bluck. Veaepun ooff Vaerdeeng inds iff thaet aelly aettaecks.
2893.concise: Veaepun Spell. (3...8 secunds.) +2...4 Heaelt regeneraeshun. 50% chunce-a tu bluck. Inds iff taerget aelly aettaecks.

2895.name: Smeeter's Buun (PfP)
2895.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 4 secunds, yuoor Smeeteeng Praeyers haefe-a duooble-a zee Deefeene-a Faefur bunoos.
2895.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (4 secunds.) Yuoor Smeeteeng Praeyers haefe-a duooble-a Deefeene-a Faefur heaeleeng bunoos.

2925.name: Slooth Hoonter's Shut (PfP)
2925.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a taekes +5...15 daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is nut useeng a skeell, Slooth Hoonter's Shut dues un aeddeeshunael +5...20 daemaege-a.
2925.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...15 daemaege-a. Deaels +5...20 mure-a daemaege-a iff taerget fue-a is nut useeng a skeell.

2959.name: Ixpert's Dextereety (PfP)
2959.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 1...20 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 15% faester und yuoor Maerksmunsheep aettreeboote-a is increaesed by 1.
2959.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (1...20 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 15% faester und yuoo gaeeen +1 tu yuoor Maerksmunsheep aettreeboote-a.

2965.name: Seegnet ooff Spureets (PfP)
2965.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 3...12 Inergy iff yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.
2965.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 3...12 Inergy. Nu iffffect unless yuoo aere-a veetheen iaershut ooff a spureet.

2966.name: Seegnet ooff Ghustly Meeght (PfP)
2966.description: Ileete-a Seegnet. Taerget aelleeed soommuned creaetoore-a's aettaecks deael 5...35 mure-a daemaege-a. Aeffter 10 secunds, thaet creaetoore-a is destruyed.
2966.concise: Ileete-a Seegnet. Taerget aelleeed soommuned creaetoore-a deaels +5...35 daemaege-a. Thaet creaetoore-a is destruyed aeffter 10 secunds.

2969.name: Reaed zee Veend (PfP)
2969.description: Prepaeraeshun. Fur 24 secunds, yuoor aerroos mufe-a tveece-a aes faest.
2969.concise: Prepaeraeshun. (24 secunds.) Yuoor aerroos mufe-a tveece-a aes faest.

2998.name: Fraegeeleety (PfP)
2998.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8...20 secunds, taerget und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 5...20 daemaege-a iaech teeme-a zeey sooffffer oor recufer frum a noo cundeeshun.
2998.concise: Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (8...20 secunds). Zeese-a fues taeke-a 5...20 daemaege-a iaech teeme-a zeey gaeeen oor luse-a a cundeeshun.

2999.name: Strengt ooff Hunur (PfP)
2999.description: Inchuntment Spell. Vheele-a yuoo maeeentaeeen thees inchuntment, taerget aelly deaels 1...5 mure-a daemaege-a in melee-a.
2999.concise: Inchuntment Spell. Taerget aelly deaels 1...5 mure-a daemaege-a in melee-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

3002.name: Vaerreeur's Indoorunce-a (PfP)
3002.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 5...35 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy iaech teeme-a yuoo heet veet a melee-a aettaeck. Vaerreeur's Indoorunce-a cunnut raeeese-a yuoor Inergy aebufe-a 10...25.
3002.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (5...35 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy iaech teeme-a yuoo heet veet a melee-a aettaeck. Nu Inergy gaeeen iff yuoo haefe-a mure-a thun 10...25 Inergy.

3003.name: Aermur ooff Unffeeleeng (PfP)
3003.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 10...35 secunds, yuoo haefe-a 10 baese-a daemaege-a redoocshun vheele-a caesteeng beendeeng reetooaels.
3003.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 10 baese-a daemaege-a redoocshun vheele-a caesteeng beendeeng reetooaels.

3005.name: Uneeun (PfP)
3005.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet. Vhenefer a nun-spureet aelly in its runge-a taekes daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael, it is redooced by 15 und zee spureet taekes 15 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.
3005.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Vhenefer a nun-spureet aelly veetheen runge-a taekes daemaege-a oor leeffe-a steael, it is redooced by 15 und zee spureet taekes 15 daemaege-a.

3006.name: Shaedoosung (PfP)
3006.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...6 spureet. Thees spureet's aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und coose-a Bleendness fur 1...6 secunds. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30 secunds.
3006.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...6 spureet (30-secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und inffleect Bleendness cundeeshun (1...6 secunds).

3007.name: Paeeen (PfP)
3007.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet. Thees spureet's aettaecks deael 5...30 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...150 secunds.
3007.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (30...150 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...30 daemaege-a.

3008.name: Destroocshun (PfP)
3008.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 Spureet thaet deees aeffter 30 secunds. Vhee thees Spureet deees, aell fues in zee aerea taeke-a 1...10 daemaege-a fur iaech secund zee Spureet vaes aeleefe-a (maexeemoom ooff 150 daemaege-a). Bork! Bork! Bork!
3008.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30 secund leeffespun). Oon deaet, it deaels 1...10 daemaege-a fur iaech secund it vaes aeleefe-a tu aell fues in zee aerea (maexeemoom 150 daemaege-a).

3009.name: Suutheeng (PfP)
3009.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet. Aell fues veetheen its runge-a taeke-a tveece-a aes lung tu booeeld aedrenaeleene-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...45 secunds.
3009.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (15...45 secund leeffespun). Booeeldeeng aedrenaeleene-a taekes tveece-a aes lung fur fues veetheen runge-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!

3010.name: Deesplaecement (PfP)
3010.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Aell nun-spureet aelleees veetheen its runge-a haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck incumeeng aettaecks. Ifery teeme-a un aettaeck is blucked in thees vaey, thees spureet taekes 60 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.
3010.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen runge-a haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Bluck iffffect: thees spureet taekes 60 daemaege-a.

3011.name: Preserfaeshun (PfP)
3011.description: Ileete-a Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Ifery 4 secunds, thees spureet heaels oone-a nun-spureet aelly in zee aerea fur 10...115 Heaelt. Thees spureet deees aeffter 90 secunds.
3011.concise: Ileete-a Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (90 secund leeffespun). Ifery 4 secunds, thees spureet heaels oone-a nun-spureet aelly fur 10...115.

3012.name: Leeffe-a (PfP)
3012.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Vhee thees spureet deees, aell nun-spureet aelleees veetheen its runge-a aere-a heaeled fur 1...7 Heaelt fur iaech secund thees spureet vaes aeleefe-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 20 secunds.
3012.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (20 secund leeffespun). Aeffffects nun-spureet aelleees veetheen runge-a. Ind iffffect: heaels fur 1...7 fur iaech secund thees spureet vaes aeleefe-a.

3013.name: Recooperaeshun (PfP)
3013.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen its runge-a gaeeen +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...45 secunds.
3013.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (15...45 secund leeffespun). Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen runge-a haefe-a +1...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun.

3014.name: Deessununce-a (PfP)
3014.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet. Thees spureet deaels 5...20 daemaege-a und unyune-a stroock by its aettaeck is interroopted. Thees spureet deees aeffter 10...25 secunds.
3014.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (10...25 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und interroopt aecshuns.

3015.name: Iaerthbeend (PfP)
3015.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Aell nun-spureet fues knucked doon veetheen its runge-a aere-a knucked doon fur aet leaest 3 secunds. Vhenefer thees haeppens, thees spureet luses 50...25 Heaelt. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...45 secunds.
3015.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (15...45 secund leeffespun). Uny teeme-a nun-spureet fues veetheen runge-a aere-a knucked-doon, zeey aere-a knucked doon fur aet leaest 3 secunds. Knuck-doon cust: thees spureet luses 50...25 Heaelt.

3016.name: Shelter (PfP)
3016.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet. Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen its runge-a cunnut luse-a mure-a thun 10% maexeemoom Heaelt frum a seengle-a aettaeck. Vhee thees spureet prefents daemaege-a, it luses 75...45 Heaelt. Thees spureet laests 30...60 secunds.
3016.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Nun-spureet aelleees veetheen runge-a cunnut luse-a mure-a thun 10% maexeemoom Heaelt frum a seengle-a aettaeck. Daemaege-a prefenshun cust: thees spureet luses 75...45 Heaelt.

3017.name: Deesenchuntment (PfP)
3017.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet. Thees spureet deaels 5...20 daemaege-a und unyune-a stroock by its aettaeck luses oone-a inchuntment. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...40 secunds.
3017.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (15...40 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und remufe-a oone-a inchuntment.

3018.name: Resturaeshun (PfP)
3018.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Vhee thees spureet deees, aell paerty members in zee aerea aere-a resoorrected veet 5...50% Heaelt und zeru Inergy. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30 secunds.
3018.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30 secund leeffespun). Ind iffffect: resoorrects paerty members in zee aerea veet 5...50% Heaelt und zeru Inergy.

3019.name: Bluudsung (PfP)
3019.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet vhu deees aeffter 30...150 secunds. Aettaecks by thaet spureet steael up tu 5...25 Heaelt.
3019.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (30...150 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks steael 5...25 Heaelt.

3020.name: Vunderloost (PfP)
3020.description: Ileete-a Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet. Vhenefer thees spureet's aettaeck heets a staeshunaery fue-a, thaet fue-a is knucked doon und zee spureet luses 70...50 Heaelt. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.
3020.concise: Ileete-a Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks aegaeeenst staeshunaery fues coose-a knuck-doon. Knuck-doon cust: thees spureet luses 70...50 Heaelt.

3021.name: Saefunnaeh Heaet (PfP)
3021.description: Ileete-a Spell. Yuoo creaete-a Saefunnaeh Heaet aet taerget fue-a's lucaeshun. Fur 5 secunds, aell neaerby fues taeke-a 5...20 fure-a daemaege-a fur iaech secund thees spell haes beee in iffffect.
3021.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Deaels 5...20 fure-a daemaege-a fur iaech secund seence-a caesteeng thees spell (5 secunds). Heets fues neaer taerget's ineeteeael lucaeshun.

3022.name: Gaeze-a ooff Foory (PfP)
3022.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Destruy taerget aelleeed spureet und creaete-a a lefel 1...10 Spureet ooff Foory. Thees spureet's aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.
3022.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Destruys un aelleeed spureet. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a.

3023.name: Ungooeesh (PfP)
3023.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...7 spureet. Thees spureet's aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a und deael duooble-a daemaege-a tu hexed fues. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...45 secunds.
3023.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...7 spureet (15...45 secund leeffespun). Its aettaecks deael 5...20 daemaege-a. Duooble-a daemaege-a tu hexed fues.

3024.name: Impooerment (PfP)
3024.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Aell aelleees veetheen its runge-a huldeeng un item gaeeen 15...45 maexeemoom Heaelt und 10 maexeemoom Inergy. Thees spureet deees aeffter 15...60 secunds.
3024.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (15...60 secund leeffespun). Aelleees in runge-a huldeeng un item gaeeen 15...45 maexeemoom Heaelt und 10 maexeemoom Inergy.

3025.name: Recufery (PfP)
3025.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...10 spureet. Cundeeshuns oon aelleees veetheen runge-a ooff thees spureet ixpure-a 20...50% faester. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...60 secunds.
3025.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...10 spureet (30...60 secund leeffespun). Cundeeshuns oon aelleees in runge-a ixpure-a 20...50% faester.

3026.name: "Gu fur zee Iyes!" (PfP)
3026.description: Shuoot. Fur 10 secunds, zee next teeme-a iaech aelly veetheen iaershut maekes un aettaeck, thaet aettaeck haes un aeddeeshunael 30...75% chunce-a tu creeteecael.
3026.concise: Shuoot. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut haefe-a +30...75% chunce-a tu lund a creeteecael heet veet zeeur next aettaeck.

3027.name: "Braece-a Yuoorselff!" (PfP)
3027.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...15 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget oozeer aelly vuoold be-a knucked doon, 1 neaerby fue-a taekes 15...90 daemaege-a insteaed.
3027.concise: Shuoot. (5...15 secunds.) Prefents zee next knuck-doon und deaels 15...90 daemaege-a tu oone-a fue-a neaer taerget aelly. Cunnut selff-taerget.

3028.name: Blaezeeng Feenaele-a (PfP)
3028.description: Ichu. Fur 10...35 secunds, vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon taerget nun-spureet aelly, aell fues aedjaecent tu thaet aelly aere-a set oon Fure-a fur 1...5 secunds.
3028.concise: Ichu. (10...35 secunds.) Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...5 secunds) tu aedjaecent fues vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon taerget aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

3029.name: Blaedetoorn Reffraeeen (PfP)
3029.description: Ichu. Fur 20 secunds, taerget nun-spureet aelly haes +10...40 aermur aegaeeenst slaesheeng daemaege-a. Thees ichu is reaeppleeed ifery teeme-a a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly.
3029.concise: Ichu. (20 secunds.) Taerget aelly haes +10...40 aermur aegaeeenst slaesheeng daemaege-a. Renooael: Vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon thaet aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

3030.name: Seegnet ooff Retoorn (PfP)
3030.description: Seegnet. Resoorrect taerget paerty member veet 5...20% Heaelt und 1...4% Inergy fur iaech paerty member veetheen iaershut.
3030.concise: Seegnet. Resoorrects taerget paerty member (5...20% Heaelt und 1...4% Inergy fur iaech paerty member in iaershut).

3031.name: "Cun't Tuooch Thees!" (PfP)
3031.description: Shuoot. Fur 20 secunds, zee next 1...5 tuooch skeells used aegaeeenst yuoo fail.
3031.concise: Shuoot. (20 secunds.) Zee next 1...5 tuooch-runge-a skeells used aegaeeenst yuoo fail.

3032.name: "Stund Yuoor Gruoond!" (PfP)
3032.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...20 secunds, aell paerty members veetheen iaershut receeefe-a +24 aermur vhee nut mufeeng. Thees iffffect inds oon un aelly aeffffected by thees shuoot vhee thaet aelly aettaecks.
3032.concise: Shuoot. (5...20 secunds.) Paerty members in iaershut gaeeen +24 aermur vhee nut mufeeng. Inds fur un aelly iff thaet aelly aettaecks.

3033.name: "Ve-a Shaell Retoorn!" (PfP)
3033.description: Shuoot. Fur 10 secunds, vhenefer paerty members veetheen iaershut use-a a resoorrecshun skeell, zeeur faellee aelleees retoorn veet 10...75% mure-a Heaelt und 5...50% mure-a Inergy.
3033.concise: Shuoot. (10 secunds.) Vhenefer paerty members in iaershut use-a a resoorrecshun skeell, zeeur faellee aelleees retoorn veet 10...75% mure-a Heaelt und 5...50% mure-a Inergy.

3034.name: "Feend Zeeur Veaekness!" (PfP)
3034.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...20 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget aelly creeteecaels, thaet aelly aelsu inffleects a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds.
3034.concise: Shuoot. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget aelly inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) veet zee next creeteecael heet.

3035.name: "Nefer Geefe-a Up!"  (PfP)
3035.description: Shuoot. Aell aelleees veetheen iaershut und beloo 75% Heaelt gaeeen 1...10 Inergy.
3035.concise: Shuoot. Aelleees in iaershut gaeeen 1...10 Inergy. Oonly aeffffects aelleees beloo 75% Heaelt.

3036.name: "Help!" (PfP)
3036.description: Shuoot. Taerget nun-spureet aelly gaeeens 5...50 Heaelt. Fur 1...10 secunds, oozeer aelleees' spells taergeteeng thaet aelly caest 50% faester.
3036.concise: Shuoot. (1...10 secunds.) Taerget nun-spureet aelly gaeeens 5...50 heaelt, aelleeed spells taergeteeng zeem caest 50% faester.

3037.name: "Faell Baeck!" (PfP)
3037.description: Shuoot. Fur 4...10 secunds, aell aelleees veetheen iaershut gaeeen 5...15 Heaelt per secund vheele-a mufeeng und mufe-a 33% faester. "Faell Baeck!" inds oon un aelly aeffffected by thees shuoot vhee thaet aelly sooccessffoolly heets veet un aettaeck.
3037.concise: Shuoot. (4...10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut gaeeen 5...15 Heaelt per secund vheele-a mufeeng und mufe-a 33% faester. Inds fur un aelly iff thaet aelly heets veet un aettaeck.

3038.name: Aeguny (PfP)
3038.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...8 spureet. Thees spureet cooses 3...10 Heaelt luss iaech secund tu fues veetheen iaershut. Thees spureet luses 3...10 Heaelt fur iaech fue-a hoort in thees vaey. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...90 secunds.
3038.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...8 spureet (30...90 secund leeffespun). Cooses 3...10 Heaelt luss iaech secund tu fues in iaershut. Thees spureet luses 3...10 Heaelt fur iaech fue-a thaet luses Heaelt.

3039.name: Rejoofenaeshun (PfP)
3039.description: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaete-a a lefel 1...16 spureet. Thees spureet heaels aell paerty members veetheen iaershut fur 3...10 Heaelt iaech secund. Thees spureet luses 3...10 Heaelt fur iaech paerty member heaeled in thees vaey. Thees spureet deees aeffter 30...90 secunds.
3039.concise: Beendeeng Reetooael. Creaetes a lefel 1...16 spureet (30...90 secund leeffespun). Heaels paerty members in iaershut fur 3...10 iaech secund. Heaeleeng cust: thees spureet luses 3...10 Heaelt.

3040.name: Unzeem ooff Deesroopshun (PfP)
3040.description: Chunt. Fur 1...10 secunds, zee next aettaeck skeell used by iaech aelly veetheen iaershut aelsu interroopts un aecshun.
3040.concise: Chunt. (1...10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut interroopt un aecshun veet zeeur next aettaeck skeell.

3045.name: Cumffurt Uneemael (PfP)
3045.description: Skeell. Yuoo heael yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun fur 40...120 Heaelt. Iff yuoor cumpuneeun is deaed, it is resoorrected veet 10...58% Heaelt. Iff yuoo haefe-a Cumffurt Uneemael iqooeepped, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun veell traefel veet yuoo.
3045.concise: Skeell. Yuoor pet gaeeens 40...120 Heaelt. Resoorrects yuoor pet (10...58% Heaelt). Iff yuoo haefe-a Cumffurt Uneemael iqooeepped, yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun veell traefel veet yuoo.

3047.name: Melundroo's Aessoolt (PfP)
3047.description: Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts a Melundroo's Aessoolt thaet deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff thaet aettaeck streekes a fue-a veet un inchuntment, thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a +5...35 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a.
3047.concise: Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Deaels +5...35 mure-a daemaege-a tu taerget und fues aedjaecent tu taerget iff thees fue-a is inchunted.

3048.name: Shruood ooff Deestress (PfP)
3048.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30...60 secunds, iff yuoo aere-a beloo 50% Heaelt, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks.
3048.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30...60 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Nu iffffect unless yuoor Heaelt is beloo 50%.

3049.name: Unseee Foory (PfP)
3049.description: Stunce-a. Fur 15...60 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a blucked by Bleended fues.
3049.concise: Stunce-a. (15...60 secunds.) Yuoo cunnut be-a blucked by Bleended fues.

3050.name: Predaetury Bund (PfP)
3050.description: Shuoot. Fur 5...20 secunds, sooccessffool aettaecks by yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun heael yuoo fur 1...31 Heaelt.
3050.concise: Shuoot. (5...20 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 1...31 Heaelt vhenefer yuoor pet maekes a sooccessffool aettaeck.

3051.name: Inraeged Loonge-a (PfP)
3051.description: Ileete-a Pet Aettaeck. Yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aettempts un Inraeged Loonge-a thaet deaels +3...23 daemaege-a (maexeemoom bunoos 60) fur iaech rechaergeeng Beaest Maestery skeell.
3051.concise: Ileete-a Pet Aettaeck. Deaels +3...23 daemaege-a (maexeemoom 60) fur iaech ooff yuoor rechaergeeng Beaest Maestery skeells.

3053.name: Seegnet ooff Deaedly Curroopshun (PfP)
3053.description: Seegnet. Moost fulloo a dooael aettaeck. Taerget fue-a taekes 5...35 daemaege-a fur iaech cundeeshun oon thaet fue-a (maexeemoom 130 daemaege-a).
3053.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 5...35 daemaege-a (maexeemoom 130) fur iaech cundeeshun oon taerget fue-a. Moost fulloo a dooael aettaeck.

3054.name: Maesucheesm (PfP)
3054.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy vhenefer yuoo saecreeffeece-a Heaelt.
3054.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 1...3 Inergy vhenefer yuoo saecreeffeece-a Heaelt.

3058.name: Unhuly Feaest (PfP)
3058.description: Spell. Steael up tu 10...65 Heaelt frum up tu 1...4 fues in zee aerea.
3058.concise: Spell. Steaels 10...65 Heaelt frum 1...4 fue-as in zee aerea aeruoond yuoo.

3059.name: Seegnet ooff Aeguny (PfP)
3059.description: Seegnet. Yuoo sooffffer frum Bleedeeng fur 25 secunds. Aell neaerby fues taeke-a 10...70 daemaege-a.
3059.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 10...70 daemaege-a tu fues neaer yuoo. Yuoo begeen Bleedeeng (25 secunds).

3060.name: Iscaepe-a (PfP)
3060.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 1...8 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck aettaecks. Iscaepe-a inds iff yuoo maeke-a a melee-a aettaeck.
3060.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (1...8 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester und haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck. Inds iff yuoo maeke-a a melee-a aettaeck.

3061.name: Deaet Blussum (PfP)
3061.description: Dooael Aettaeck. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck. Iff it heets, Deaet Blussum streekes taerget fue-a fur +20...45 daemaege-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 20...45 daemaege-a.
3061.concise: Dooael Aettaeck. Deaels +20...45 daemaege-a. Aelsu aeffffects fues aedjaecent tu taerget fue-a. Moost fulloo un ooffff-hund aettaeck.

3062.name: Feenaele-a ooff Resturaeshun (PfP)
3062.description: Ichu. Fur 10...35 secunds, zee next 5 teeme-as thaet a chunt oor shuoot inds oon taerget nun-spureet aelly, thaet aelly is heaeled fur 15...75 Heaelt.
3062.concise: Ichu. (10...35 secunds.) Taerget aelly gaeeens 15...75 Heaelt zee next 5 teeme-as a shuoot oor chunt inds oon thaet aelly. Cunnut taerget spureets.

3063.name: Muntra ooff Resulfe-a (PfP)
3063.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5 secunds, yuoo cunnut be-a interroopted, boot iaech teeme-a yuoo vuoold haefe-a beee interroopted, yuoo luse-a 10...4 Inergy oor Muntra ooff Resulfe-a inds.
3063.concise: Stunce-a. (5 secunds.) Prefents interroopts aegaeeenst yuoo. Prefenshun cust: luse-a 10...4 Inergy oor Muntra ooff Resulfe-a inds.

3141.name: Leeghtneeng Refflexes (PfP)
3141.description: Stunce-a. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo haefe-a a 75% chunce-a tu bluck melee-a und prujecteele-a aettaecks, und yuoo aettaeck 33% faester. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3141.concise: Stunce-a. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester und haefe-a 75% chunce-a tu bluck.

3143.name: Renooeeng Smaesh (PfP)
3143.description: Haemmer Aettaeck. Iff Renooeeng Smaesh heets, it deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo heet a knucked-doon fue-a, yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy und thees aettaeck rechaerges instuntly.
3143.concise: Haemmer Aettaeck. Deaels +5...20 daemaege-a. Yuoo gaeeen 3 Inergy und thees aettaeck rechaerges instuntly iff taerget fue-a vaes knucked doon.

3144.name: Heael aes Oone-a (PfP)
3144.description: Ileete-a Skeell. Iff yuoo oor yuoor uneemael cumpuneeun aere-a beloo 75% Heaelt, yuoo aere-a but heaeled fur 25...145 Heaelt. Iff yuoor cumpuneeun is deaed, it is resoorrected veet 50% Heaelt.
3144.concise: Ileete-a Skeell. Heaels yuoo und yuoor pet fur 25...145. Iff yuoor pet is deaed, it is resoorrected veet 50% Heaelt. Nu iffffect iff neeezeer yuoo nur yuoor pet aere-a beloo 75% Heaelt.

3145.name: Glaess Aerroos (PfP)
3145.description: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. Fur 10...35 secunds, yuoor aerroos streeke-a fur +6...18 daemaege-a iff zeey heet und coose-a Bleedeeng fur 10...20 secunds iff zeey aere-a Blucked.
3145.concise: Ileete-a Prepaeraeshun. (10...35 secunds.) Yuoor aerroos deael +6...18 daemaege-a. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun iff blucked (10...20 secunds).

3147.name: Keee Aerroo (PfP)
3147.description: Boo Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, yuoo streeke-a fur +5...15 daemaege-a. Iff yuoo lund a creeteecael heet, yuoo deael un aeddeeshunael +5...30 daemaege-a.
3147.concise: Boo Aettaeck. Deaels +5...15 daemaege-a. Deaels +5...30 mure-a daemaege-a iff yuoo lund a creeteecael heet.

3148.name: Unzeem ooff Infy (PfP)
3148.description: Chunt. Fur 10 secunds, zee next aettaeck skeell used by iaech aelly veetheen iaershut deaels +10...20 daemaege-a aegaeeenst fues veet mure-a thun 50% Heaelt.
3148.concise: Chunt. (10 secunds.) Aelleees in iaershut du +10...20 daemaege-a veet zeeur next aettaeck skeell. Daemaege-a bunoos oonly aeppleees tu fues veet mure-a thun 50% Heaelt.

3149.name: Mendeeng Reffraeeen (PfP)
3149.description: Ichu. Fur 15 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +2...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Thees ichu is reaeppleeed ifery teeme-a a chunt oor shuoot inds oon yuoo.
3149.concise: Ichu. (15 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen +2...3 Heaelt regeneraeshun. Renooael: vhenefer a chunt oor shuoot inds oon yuoo.

3151.name: Impaethy (PfP)
3151.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a aettaecks, thaet fue-a taekes 15...45 daemaege-a.
3151.concise: Hex Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Taerget fue-a taekes 15...45 daemaege-a vhenefer it aettaecks.

3152.name: Creeppleeng Ungooeesh (PfP)
3152.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget mufes 50% slooer und sooffffers -2...6 Heaelt degeneraeshun.
3152.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 50% slooer und haes -2...6 Heaelt degeneraeshun.

3156.name: Suldeeer's Stunce-a (PfP)
3156.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 4...10 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 33% faester vheele-a under zee iffffects ooff a shuoot oor chunt.
3156.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (4...10 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 33% faester vheele-a under zee iffffects ooff a shuoot oor chunt.

3157.name: Destroocteefe-a Vaes Glaeeefe-a (PfP)
3157.description: Ileete-a Item Spell. Huld Glaeeefe-a's aeshes fur up tu 30...60 secunds. Vheele-a yuoo huld her aeshes, aell Reetooaeleest skeells haefe-a 10% aermur penetraeshun. Vhee yuoo drup her aeshes, aell fues in zee aerea aere-a stroock fur 15...85 leeghtneeng daemaege-a.
3157.concise: Ileete-a Item Spell. (30...60 secunds.) Yuoor Reetooaeleest skeells haefe-a 10% aermur penetraeshun. Drup iffffect: deaels 15...85 leeghtneeng daemaege-a tu aell fues in zee aerea.

3179.name: Muntra ooff Seegnets (PfP)
3179.description: Stunce-a. Fur 10...40 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +3 aermur fur iaech seegnet yuoo haefe-a iqooeepped. Vhenefer yuoo use-a a seegnet, yuoo gaeeen 5...60 Heaelt.
3179.concise: Stunce-a. (10...40 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +3 aermur fur iaech seegnet. Yuoo gaeeen 5...60 Heaelt iaech teeme-a yuoo use-a a seegnet.

3180.name: Shaetter Delooseeuns (PfP)
3180.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a Mesmer hex frum taerget fue-a. Iff a hex is remufed, thaet fue-a taekes 15...75 daemaege-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3180.concise: Spell. Remufes a Mesmer hex frum taerget fue-a. Remufael iffffect: 15...75 daemaege-a tu taerget und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu aell aedjaecent fues. Bork! Bork! Bork!

3181.name: Illooseeunaery Veaepunry (PfP)
3181.description: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. Fur 30 secunds, yuoor melee-a aettaecks neeezeer heet nur faeeel tu heet. Insteaed, Illooseeunaery Veaepunry deaels 20...60 daemaege-a tu yuoor taergets fur iaech melee-a aettaeck.
3181.concise: Ileete-a Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Deaels 20...60 daemaege-a tu fues in plaece-a ooff oozeer daemaege-a oor iffffects frum melee-a aettaecks. Yuoor melee-a aettaecks neeezeer heet nur faeeel tu heet.

3183.name: Meegraeeene-a (PfP)
3183.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 4...16 secunds, taerget fue-a sooffffers -1...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun und taekes 100% lunger tu aecteefaete-a skeells.
3183.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (4...16 secunds.) Cooses -1...8 Heaelt degeneraeshun und duoobles skeell aecteefaeshun teeme-a.

3184.name: Aeccoomoolaeted Paeeen (PfP)
3184.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 10...35 daemaege-a. Iff taerget fue-a is sooffffereeng frum 2 oor mure-a hexes, thaet fue-a sooffffers a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds.
3184.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...35 daemaege-a. Inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds) iff taerget fue-a haes 2 oor mure-a hexes. Bork! Bork! Bork!

3185.name: Psycheec Instaebeeleety (PfP)
3185.description: Ileete-a Spell. Interroopts zee taerget fue-a's aecshun. Iff thaet aecshun is a skeell, thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a knucked doon fur 2...3 secunds. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Faest Caesteeng 4 oor less.)
3185.concise: Ileete-a Spell. Interroopts un aecshun. Interroopshun iffffect: iff zee aecshun is a skeell, cooses knuckdoon fur 2...3 secunds oon taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Faest Caesteeng 5 oor heegher.

3186.name: Shaered Boordee (PfP)
3186.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a und aell fues in zee aerea aettaeck, caest spells, und mufe-a 33% slooer.
3186.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues in zee aerea ooff yuoor taerget (5...20 secunds). Zeese-a fues aettaeck, caest spells, und mufe-a 33% slooer.

3187.name: Stulee Speed (PfP)
3187.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 1...10 secunds, spells caest by zee taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 100% lunger tu caest. Spells yuoo caest thaet taerget zeese-a fues taeke-a 50% less teeme-a tu caest. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3187.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes aedjaecent fues (1...10 secunds). Duoobles spell caesteeng teeme-a. Spells yuoo caest oon hexed fues haefe-a -50% caesteeng teeme-a.

3188.name: Unnaetoorael Seegnet (PfP)
3188.description: Seegnet. Taerget fue-a taekes 10...60 daemaege-a. Iff thaet fue-a is under zee iffffects ooff a hex oor inchuntment, fues aedjaecent tu yuoor taerget taeke-a 10...60 daemaege-a. Aell yuoor nun-Mesmer skeells ixcept seegnets aere-a deesaebled fur 10 secunds.
3188.concise: Seegnet. Deaels 10...60 daemaege-a. Deaels 10...60 daemaege-a tu oozeer aedjaecent fues iff zee taerget is hexed oor inchunted. Yuoor nun-Mesmer skeells ixcept seegnets aere-a deesaebled (10 secunds).

3189.name: Spureetooael Paeeen (PfP)
3189.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a taekes 5...40 daemaege-a. Aell husteele-a soommuned creaetoores in zee aerea ooff thaet fue-a taeke-a 25...125 daemaege-a. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3189.concise: Spell. Deaels 5...40 daemaege-a. Deaels 25...125 daemaege-a tu husteele-a soommuned creaetoores in zee aerea ooff taerget fue-a.

3190.name: Froostraeshun (PfP)
3190.description: Hex Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, taerget fue-a caests spells 50% slooer und taekes 5...50 daemaege-a vhenefer interroopted.
3190.concise: Hex Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Cooses 50% slooer spell caesteeng. Taerget fue-a taekes 5...50 daemaege-a vhenefer interroopted. Bork! Bork! Bork!

3191.name: Meestroost (PfP)
3191.description: Hex Spell. Fur 6 secunds, zee next spell thaet taerget fue-a caests oon oone-a ooff yuoor aelleees faeeels und deaels 10...60 daemaege-a tu thaet fue-a und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu aell neaerby fues.
3191.concise: Hex Spell. (6 secunds.) Zee next spell thaet taerget fue-a caests oon oone-a ooff yuoor aelleees faeeels und deaels 10...60 daemaege-a tu taerget und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu neaerby fues.

3192.name: Inchunter's Cunoondroom (PfP)
3192.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a caests inchuntments 100...200% slooer. Iff taerget fue-a is nut under zee iffffects ooff un inchuntment vhee thees hex is aeppleeed, thaet fue-a taekes 10...100 daemaege-a und aell aedjaecent fues taeke-a 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a.
3192.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Cooses 100...200% slooer inchuntment caesteeng (10 secunds). Ineeteeael iffffect: iff taerget fue-a is nut inchunted deaels 10...100 daemaege-a tu taerget und 75% ooff thaet daemaege-a tu aedjaecent fues.

3193.name: Seegnet ooff Cloomseeness (PfP)
3193.description: Seegnet. Iff taerget fue-a is aettaeckeeng, thaet fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues aere-a interroopted und taeke-a 15...60 daemaege-a. Uny fues useeng aettaeck skeells aere-a knucked doon.
3193.concise: Seegnet. Interroopts un aettaeck fur taerget fue-a und aell aedjaecent fues. Interroopshun iffffect: deaels 15...60 daemaege-a; knucks doon fues useeng aettaeck skeells.

3194.name: Murrur ooff Deesenchuntment (PfP)
3194.description: Spell. Remufe-a oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Aell ooff thaet fue-a's paerty members aelsu luse-a thaet saeme-a inchuntment.
3194.concise: Spell. Remufes oone-a inchuntment frum taerget fue-a. Thaet fue-a's paerty members aelsu luse-a thees inchuntment.

3195.name: Vundereeng Iye-a (PfP)
3195.description: Hex Spell. Fur 4 secunds, zee next teeme-a taerget fue-a aettaecks, thaet aettaeck is interroopted und aell neaerby fues taeke-a 10...92 daemaege-a.
3195.concise: Hex Spell. (4 secunds.) Interroopts taerget fue-a's next aettaeck. Interroopshun iffffect: 10...92 daemaege-a tu neaerby fues.

3196.name: Caelcoolaeted Reesk (PfP)
3196.description: Hex Spell. Fur 3...12 secunds, taerget fue-a's aettaecks du +10 daemaege-a, boot zeere-a is a 50% chunce-a thaet zee daemaege-a frum iaech aettaeck veell be-a dune-a tu thaet fue-a insteaed. (Maexeemoom 15...60 daemaege-a.)
3196.concise: Hex Spell. Taerget fue-a dues +10 daemaege-a veet aettaecks (3...12 secunds). Zeere-a is a 50% chunce-a thaet zee daemaege-a frum iaech aettaeck (maexeemoom 15...60) veell be-a dune-a tu thaet fue-a insteaed. Bork! Bork! Bork!

3204.name: Deffy Paeeen (PfP)
3204.description: Ileete-a Stunce-a. Fur 20 secunds, yuoo haefe-a un aeddeeshunael 90...300 Heaelt und un aeddeeshunael 20 aermur.
3204.concise: Ileete-a Stunce-a. (20 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +90...300 maexeemoom Heaelt und +20 aermur.

3232.name: Heael Paerty (PfP)
3232.description: Spell. Heael inture-a paerty fur 30...75 Heaelt.

3233.name: Spueel Feectur (PfP)
3233.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 3...15 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a aettaecks oor caests a spell oon a creaetoore-a veet less Heaelt thaet fue-a luses 15...75 Heaelt.
3233.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (3...15 secunds.) Cooses 15...75 Heaelt luss vhenefer taerget fue-a aettaecks oor caests spells oon a creaetoore-a veet less Heaelt.

3234.name: Feeseeuns ooff Regret (PfP)
3234.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 10...30 daemaege-a vhenefer zeey use-a a skeell und 5...40 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a iff nut under zee iffffects ooff unuzeer Mesmer hex.
3234.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Aelsu hexes fues aedjaecent tu taerget (10 secunds). Zeese-a fues taeke-a 10...30 daemaege-a vhenefer zeey use-a a skeell und 5...40 aeddeeshunael daemaege-a iff nut under zee iffffects ooff unuzeer Mesmer hex.

3251.name: Fux Fungs (PfP)
3251.description: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck. Fux Fungs cunnut be-a blucked und streekes fur +10...25 daemaege-a iff it heets. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3251.concise: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Deaels +10...25 daemaege-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck.

3252.name: Veeld Streeke-a (PfP)
3252.description: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck streekes fur +10...35 daemaege-a und uny stunce-a beeeng used by taerget fue-a inds. Thees aettaeck cunnut be-a blucked. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3252.concise: Ooffff-Hund Aettaeck. Deaels +10...35 daemaege-a. Remufes taerget fue-a's stunce-a. Unbluckaeble-a. Moost fulloo a leaed aettaeck.

3263.name: Buneesheeng Streeke-a (PfP)
3263.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Iff it heets, thees aettaeck deaels 10...60 huly daemaege-a. It deaels duooble-a daemaege-a tu soommuned creaetoores. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3263.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Deaels 10...60 huly daemaege-a. Deaels duooble-a daemaege-a tu soommuned creaetoores. Bork! Bork! Bork!

3264.name: Tveen Muun Sveep (PfP)
3264.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Yuoo luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment und gaeeen 10...20 Heaelt. Iff un inchuntment is lust in thees vaey, yuoo cunnut be-a blucked, yuoo streeke-a tveece-a, veet iaech streeke-a dueeng 25% less daemaege-a thun nurmael, und yuoo gaeeen un aeddeeshunael 10...30 Heaelt.
3264.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Remufe-a 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Gaeeen 10...20 Heaelt. Remufael iffffect: unbluckaeble-a, aettaeck tveece-a, iaech streeke-a dueeng 25% less daemaege-a, und gaeeen 10...30 mure-a Heaelt.

3265.name: Irreseesteeble-a Sveep (PfP)
3265.description: Scyzee Aettaeck. Deael +3...15 daemaege-a und luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff yuoo luse-a un inchuntment in thees vaey, Irreseesteeble-a Sveep cunnut be-a blucked und remufes a stunce-a.
3265.concise: Scyzee Aettaeck. Deaels +3...15 daemaege-a. Remufe-a 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: unbluckaeble-a, remufes a stunce-a.

3266.name: Peeuoos Aessoolt (PfP)
3266.description: Melee-a Aettaeck. Yuoo remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff a Derfeesh inchuntment vaes remufed, thees skeell rechaerges 75% faester und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 15...40 daemaege-a.
3266.concise: Melee-a Aettaeck. Remufes 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael Iffffect: thees skeell rechaerges 75% faester und aedjaecent fues taeke-a 15...40 daemaege-a.

3269.name: Gooeedeeng Hunds (PfP)
3269.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 20 secunds, yuoor next 0...3 aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked. Vhee aecteefaeted, thees skeell remufes zee Bleendness cundeeshun.
3269.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (20 secunds.) Yuoor next 0...3 aettaecks cunnut be-a blucked. Ineeteeael iffffect: remufes Bleendness.

3270.name: Aefaetaer ooff Dvaeyna (PfP)
3270.description: Ileete-a Furm. Fur 10...90 secunds, yuoor aettaecks deael huly daemaege-a. Vhenefer yuoo use-a a Derfeesh aettaeck skeell, yuoo luse-a 1 hex. Vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment, yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 5...50 Heaelt. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.
3270.concise: Ileete-a Furm. (10...90 secunds.) Deael huly daemaege-a. Yuoo luse-a 1 hex vhenefer yuoo use-a a Derfeesh aettaeck skeell. Heael yuoorselff fur 5...50 Heaelt vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.

3271.name: Aefaetaer ooff Melundroo (PfP)
3271.description: Ileete-a Furm. Fur 10...90 secunds, yuoo haefe-a +100 Heaelt, +30 ilementael aermur, und yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment yuoo luse-a 2 cundeeshuns. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.
3271.concise: Ileete-a Furm. (10...90 secunds.) Yuoo haefe-a +100 maexeemoom Heaelt, +30 ilementael aermur, und yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Coore-a 2 cundeeshuns frum yuoorselff vhenefer yuoo luse-a a Derfeesh inchuntment. Thees skeell is deesaebled fur 45 secunds.

3272.name: Mysteec Heaeleeng (PfP)
3272.description: Spell. Yuoo aere-a heaeled fur 5...65 Heaelt. Aelsu heaels aell inchunted paerty members fur 5...65 Heaelt.
3272.concise: Spell. Heaels yuoo fur 5...65. Heaels aell inchunted paerty members fur 5...65 Heaelt.

3273.name: Seegnet ooff Peeuoos Restraeeent (PfP)
3273.description: Seegnet. Luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment und Creepple-a taerget fue-a 5...15 secunds. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, thees skeell rechaerges 50% faester.
3273.concise: Seegnet. (5...15 secunds.) Creepples taerget fue-a und remufes 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: rechaerges 50% faester.

3289.name: Fefered Dreaems (PfP)
3289.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 5...15 secunds, vhenefer taerget fue-a sooffffers frum a noo cundeeshun, aell fues in zee aerea sooffffer frum thaet cundeeshun aes vell.
3289.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (5...15 secunds.) Fues in zee aerea aelsu haefe-a uny noo cundeeshuns thaet taerget fue-a aecqooures.

3346.name: Oora ooff Thurns (PfP)
3346.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Aell neaerby fues begeen Bleedeeng fur 5...15 secunds. Fur 30 secunds, thees inchuntment dues nutheeng. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, aell neaerby fues aere-a Creeppled fur 3...8 secunds.
3346.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Ineeteeael iffffect: inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...15 secunds) oon neaerby fues. Ind iffffect: inffleects Creeppled cundeeshun (3...8 secunds) oon neaerby fues.

3347.name: Doost Cluaek (PfP)
3347.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Aell neaerby fues aere-a stroock fur 10...40 iaert daemaege-a. Fur 30 secunds, yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, aell neaerby fues aere-a Bleended fur 1...4 secunds.
3347.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (30 secunds.) Yuoor aettaecks deael iaert daemaege-a. Ineeteeael iffffect: deaels 10...40 iaert daemaege-a tu neaerby fues. Ind iffffect: inffleects Bleendness cundeeshun (1...4 secunds) oon neaerby fues.

3348.name: Lyssa's Haeste-a (PfP)
3348.description: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 3...15 secunds, yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments rechaerge-a 33% faester. Vhee yuoo aecteefaete-a thees inchuntment, aell aedjaecent fues aere-a interroopted. Vhee thees inchuntment inds, aell aedjaecent fues aere-a interroopted. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Veend Praeyers 5 oor heegher.
3348.concise: Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (3...15 secunds.) Yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments rechaerge-a 33% faester. Ineeteeael Iffffect: interroopts aell aedjaecent fues. Ind Iffffect: interroopts aell aedjaecent fues. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Veend Praeyers 5 oor heegher.)

3365.name: Oonslooght (PfP)
3365.description: Ileete-a Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. Fur 2...8 secunds, yuoo aettaeck und gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a 25% faester.
3365.concise: Ileete-a Flaesh Inchuntment Spell. (2...8 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck und gaeeen aedrenaeleene-a 25% faester.

3366.name: Heaert ooff Foory (PfP)
3366.description: Stunce-a. Fur 2...10 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 25% faester.

3367.name: Vuoondeeng Streeke-a (PfP)
3367.description: Ileete-a Scyzee Aettaeck. Iff thees aettaeck heets, taerget fue-a sooffffers frum Bleedeeng fur 5...20 secunds, und yuoo luse-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, taerget fue-a aelsu sooffffers frum a Deep Vuoond fur 5...20 secunds.
3367.concise: Ileete-a Scyzee Aettaeck. Inffleects Bleedeeng cundeeshun (5...20 secunds). Remufes 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Remufael iffffect: inffleects Deep Vuoond cundeeshun (5...20 secunds).

3368.name: Peeuoos Foory (PfP)
3368.description: Stunce-a. Remufe-a 1 Derfeesh inchuntment. Fur 1...5 secunds, yuoo aettaeck 25% faester. Iff un inchuntment vaes remufed, thees stunce-a laests tveece-a aes lung.
3368.concise: Stunce-a. (1...5 secunds.) Yuoo aettaeck 25% faester und remufe-a 1 ooff yuoor Derfeesh inchuntments. Remufael iffffect: thees stunce-a laests tveece-a aes lung.

3373.name: Illooseeun ooff Haeste-a (PfP)
3373.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...11 secunds, yuoo mufe-a 33% faester. Vhee Illooseeun ooff Haeste-a inds, yuoo becume-a Creeppled fur 3 secunds.
3373.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...11 secunds.) Yuoo mufe-a 33% faester. Ind iffffect: yuoo aere-a Creeppled (3 secunds).

3374.name: Illooseeun ooff Paeeen (PfP)
3374.description: Hex Spell. Fur 8 secunds, taerget fue-a haes -3...10 Heaelt degeneraeshun und taekes 3...10 daemaege-a iaech secund. Vhee Illooseeun ooff Paeeen inds oor is reaeppleeed, thaet fue-a is heaeled fur 36...120.
3374.concise: Hex Spell. (8 secunds.) Cooses -3...10 Heaelt degeneraeshun und taerget fue-a taekes 3...10 daemaege-a iaech secund. Ind iffffect: thaet fue-a is heaeled fur 36...120. Inds iff reaeppleeed.

3375.name: Oora ooff Resturaeshun (PfP)
3375.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 60 secunds, yuoo gaeeen 0...1 Inergy und aere-a heaeled fur 200...400% ooff zee Inergy cust iaech teeme-a yuoo caest a spell. Bork! Bork! Bork!
3375.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (60 secunds.) Yuoo gaeeen 0...1 Inergy und aere-a heaeled fur 200...400% ooff zee Inergy cust iaech teeme-a yuoo caest a spell.

3386.name: Veb ooff Deesroopshun (PfP)
3386.description: Hex Spell. Interroopt taerget fue-a. Fur 10 secunds, taerget fue-a is hexed veet Veb ooff Deesroopshun. Vhee thees hex inds, thaet fue-a is interroopted aegaeeen.
3386.concise: Hex Spell. (10 secunds.) Ineeteeael iffffect: interroopts a skeell. Ind iffffect: interroopts a skeell.

3396.name: Leeghtneeng Haemmer (PfP)
3396.description: Spell. Taerget fue-a is stroock fur 10...100 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. Leeghtneeng Haemmer haes 25% aermur penetraeshun.
3396.concise: Spell. Deaels 10...100 leeghtneeng daemaege-a. 25% aermur penetraeshun.

3397.name: Ilementael Flaeme-a (PfP)
3397.description: Inchuntment Spell. Fur 5...20 secunds, vhenefer yuoo aepply un Ilementael hex tu a fue-a, thaet fue-a is set oon fure-a fur 1...2 secunds.
3397.concise: Inchuntment Spell. (5...20 secunds.) Inffleects Boorneeng cundeeshun (1...2 secunds) vhenefer yuoo aepply un Ilementael hex tu a taerget.

3398.name: Sleeppery Gruoond (PfP)
3398.description: Spell. Iff taerget fue-a is Bleend oor mufeeng, thaet fue-a is knucked doon. (50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a veet Vaeter Maegeec 4 oor less.)
3398.concise: Spell. Cooses knuck-doon iff thees fue-a is Bleend oor mufeeng. 50% faeeeloore-a chunce-a unless Vaeter Maegeec 5 oor heegher.

3422.name: Teeme-a Vaerd
3422.description: Ileete-a Vaerd Spell. Yuoo creaete-a a Teeme-a Vaerd aet yuoor coorrent lucaeshun. Fur 6...20 secunds, nun-spureet aelleees in thees aerea caest spells 15...20% faester und rechaerge-a skeells 15...20% faester. PfE-a Skeell
